title: In Search of the Ingredients of Open-Endedness: Replicating Picbreeder with Large Vision-Language Models
comment: 26 pages, 21 figures, to be published at GECCO 2026
summary: We are in the midst of large-scale industrial and academic efforts to automate the processes of scientific, technological and creative production through AI-driven assistants. Historically, a fundamental property of these processes in their human form has been their open-endedness: their capacity for generating a seemingly endless supply of novel and meaningful new forms. Do artificial agents have any capacity for such fruitful unguided discovery? To answer this question, we turn to Picbreeder, the canonical exemplar of human-driven open-ended search, in which users collaboratively generated a diverse library of images through interactive evolution of small neural networks. We replicate Picbreeder, replacing human users with frontier Vision Language Models (VLMs). We observe clear qualitative differences between the output of our system and the historical human baseline, and attempt to characterize them using metrics of phylogenetic complexity and visual and semantic salience and novelty. In an effort to identify some of the causal factors contributing these differences, we study the addition of exploratory noise to the agents' selection process, of behavioral diversity between agents, and of narrative momentum in the form of memory of past actions. We make our code available at https://github.com/smearle/picbreeder-vlm.

AI.tldr: 本文使用视觉语言模型(VLM)替代人类用户来复制Picbreeder系统，研究AI代理是否具备开放式探索和创造性发现的能力，并与人类基线进行对比分析。
AI.motivation: 探索AI驱动助手在科学、技术和创意生产自动化中的开放式探索能力，即AI是否能够像人类一样进行无指导的、持续产生新颖有意义结果的过程。
AI.method: 复制Picbreeder系统，用前沿视觉语言模型(VLM)替代人类用户进行交互式进化，通过小型神经网络协作生成图像。研究了探索性噪声、代理间行为多样性、以及记忆形式的叙事动量等因素的影响。
AI.result: AI系统与人类基线在输出上存在明显定性差异，通过系统发育复杂度、视觉和语义显著性与新颖性等指标进行了表征。
AI.conclusion: AI代理在开放式探索能力上与人类存在显著差异，引入探索性噪声、行为多样性和记忆机制可以影响这些差异。
idea_en: A method for automated open-ended creative discovery using Vision Language Models (VLMs) to replace human evaluators in interactive evolutionary systems, enabling AI-driven generation of diverse visual outputs without human intervention.
A technique for introducing exploratory noise into VLM-based selection processes within evolutionary algorithms to enhance the novelty and diversity of generated creative artifacts.
A system for maintaining narrative momentum through memory of past actions in VLM-driven evolutionary search, enabling more coherent and directed creative exploration over time.
A method for injecting behavioral diversity between multiple VLM agents in collaborative evolutionary systems to simulate human-like creative divergence.
A framework for measuring phylogenetic complexity and visual/semantic salience in AI-generated creative works to quantitatively compare machine and human creative output.
idea_ch: 一种使用视觉语言模型(VLM)替代人类评估者的自动化开放式创意发现方法，使AI驱动系统能够在无需人类干预的情况下生成多样化视觉输出。
一种在进化算法中将探索性噪声引入VLM选择过程的技术，用于增强生成创意作品的多样性和新颖性。
一种通过记忆过去行为在VLM驱动的进化搜索中维持叙事动量的系统，实现随时间更连贯和有方向的创意探索。
一种在协作进化系统中向多个VLM代理注入行为多样性的方法，模拟人类式的创意发散过程。
一种衡量AI生成创意作品的系统发育复杂度及视觉/语义显著性的框架，用于定量比较机器与人类创意输出之间的差异。

title: Confidence Calibration in Large Language Models
summary: We investigate the calibration of large language models' (LLMs') confidence across diverse tasks. The results of our preregistered study show that the current crop of LLMs are, like people, too sure they are right: confidence exceeds accuracy, on average. Importantly, however, this tendency is moderated by a powerful hard-easy effect, wherein overconfidence is greatest on difficult tests; by contrast, easy tests actually show substantial underconfidence. We develop LifeEval, a test for evaluating model calibration across levels of difficulty.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在不同任务上的校准情况，发现它们和人类一样往往过度自信，且这种倾向受到难易效应的影响——在困难测试中过度自信，在简单测试中反而信心不足。作者还开发了LifeEval测试来评估模型在不同难度水平上的校准。
AI.motivation: 探究大型语言模型在不同难度任务上的置信度校准情况，比较其与人类认知偏差的相似性。
AI.method: 通过预注册研究，分析LLMs在不同任务上的置信度与准确率的关系，开发LifeEval测试评估跨难度水平的模型校准。
AI.result: 当前LLMs平均而言过度自信（置信度超过准确率），但存在明显的难易效应：困难测试中过度自信，简单测试中反而信心不足。
AI.conclusion: LLMs的置信度校准存在与人类类似的偏差模式，LifeEval可用于评估模型在不同难度下的校准表现。
idea_en: A method for calibrating LLM confidence based on task difficulty level, adjusting confidence scores downward for hard tasks and upward for easy tasks to achieve better calibration.
LifeEval: A standardized evaluation framework for assessing model calibration across multiple difficulty tiers, enabling systematic comparison of confidence-accuracy alignment.
An adaptive confidence calibration system that dynamically adjusts model's expressed confidence based on real-time difficulty estimation of the input query.
idea_ch: 一种基于任务难度级别的LLM置信度校准方法：对困难任务降低置信度分数，对简单任务提高置信度分数，从而实现更好的校准效果。
LifeEval：一种跨多个难度层级评估模型校准的标准框架，能够系统比较置信度与准确率的一致性。
一种自适应置信度校准系统：根据输入查询的实时难度估计，动态调整模型表达的置信度水平。

title: How Much Thinking is Enough? Quantifying and Understanding Redundancy in LLM Reasoning
summary:
Reasoning-capable large language models solve hard problems by emitting long chains of thought, paying heavily in latency, GPU time, and energy. Casual inspection of their traces reveals extensive reformulation, verification, and circular self-reflection, yet how much of this deliberation is actually necessary has never been measured at scale or explained from first principles. This paper closes both gaps.
  We formalise reasoning redundancy directly in terms of the reasoning model itself: the redundancy of a correct trace is the largest fraction of its trailing segmented steps that can be truncated while $π$, forced to terminate thinking and emit a final answer, still produces the correct answer. A large-scale quantification across four frontier reasoning models and two mathematical benchmarks shows that step-level redundancy is consistently high -- between 61% and 93% across the 8 (model, benchmark) conditions we study, with the median critical prefix equal to a single segmented step in six of the eight conditions -- that the finding is robust to the choice of judge family, and that although $ρ$ decreases with problem difficulty on MATH-500, all four models remain substantially redundant ($ρ\in [46\%, 85\%]$) even on the hardest Level-5 problems.
  We then prove that this redundancy is a structural consequence of length-agnostic outcome rewards, not a model-specific artefact: under any such reward, no finite expected stopping time is optimal. The result holds regardless of RL algorithm, base model, data distribution, or whether the policy is obtained via RL or distillation; over-thinking is therefore not a bug to be patched in individual models but a structural property of how current reasoning models are trained. Code: https://github.com/zhiyuanZhai20/how-much-thinking-is-enough

AI.tldr: 本文通过形式化定义推理冗余度，系统量化了前沿推理大模型在数学问题上的冗余思维链，发现61%-93%的推理步骤是冗余的；并从理论上证明，这种过度思考是长度无关结果奖励的结构性后果，而非模型特有的人工痕迹。
AI.motivation: 推理模型（如Chain-of-Thought模型）生成极长的思维链，耗费大量延迟、GPU时间和能量，但其中多少推理是真正必要的从未被大规模测量或从第一性原理解释。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义推理冗余度：正确轨迹中可被截断的最大尾部步长比例，使得强制停止推理并输出最终答案的模型仍能给出正确答案。2) 在四个前沿推理模型和两个数学基准上进行大规模量化。3) 从理论上证明冗余性是长度无关结果奖励的结构性后果。
AI.result: 步骤级冗余度在61%-93%之间，8种（模型，基准）条件下中位数关键前缀在6种条件下仅为单个分段步骤；冗余度随问题难度增加而降低，但在最难的Level-5问题上仍在46%-85%之间。
AI.conclusion: 过度思考不是可以在单个模型中修复的Bug，而是当前推理模型训练方式的结构性属性。
idea_en: A method for measuring reasoning redundancy in large language models by defining redundancy as the maximum fraction of trailing segmented steps that can be truncated while the forced-termination model still produces the correct answer.
A computational framework for quantifying critical prefix length in reasoning traces across frontier models and benchmarks.

A theoretical proof establishing that reasoning redundancy is a structural consequence of length-agnostic outcome rewards, independent of RL algorithm, base model, data distribution, or training method.
A method for adaptively truncating reasoning chain-of-thought based on critical prefix detection to reduce latency and computational cost without sacrificing answer accuracy.
A system for dynamic early termination of reasoning in LLMs by identifying the minimal sufficient reasoning prefix for a given problem instance.
idea_ch: 一种测量大型语言模型推理冗余度的方法，将冗余度定义为在强制终止模型仍能输出正确答案的前提下，可被截断的尾部分段步骤的最大比例。
一种在前沿模型和基准上量化推理轨迹关键前缀长度的计算框架。
一项理论证明：推理冗余度是长度无关结果奖励的结构性后果，与强化学习算法、基础模型、数据分布或训练方法无关。
一种基于关键前缀检测自适应截断推理链的方法，可在不牺牲答案准确性的情况下降低延迟和计算成本。
一种通过识别问题实例的最小充分推理前缀，实现LLM推理动态提前终止的系统。

title: Context: Proactive Goal-Directed Intelligence via Composable Sandboxed Programs, Declarative Wiring, and Structured Interaction
comment: 7 pages; third in a series with arXiv:2501.XXXXX (Magarshak Machine / SPACER) and arXiv:2502.XXXXX (Grokers)
summary: We present Context, the intelligence layer of the Magarshak Architecture, which replaces reactive query-response chatbots with proactive goal-directed agents that advance shared tasks without waiting for user prompts. The architecture rests on three mutually reinforcing mechanisms. Write-time context assembly precomputes enriched typed attributes via Groker agents, assembling interaction context as a deterministic pure function of graph state; context blocks are byte-identical across turns between semantic changes, enabling near-100% KV-cache reuse. Composable sandboxed wisdom programs form a governed library of LM-generated imperative programs declaratively wired to goal types via typed stream relations, composed via phase ordering, and executed at interaction time without further LM calls. Proactive goal stream state machines drive conversations toward terminal states by inspecting graph state and emitting structured interaction content (option arrays, governance affordances, clarification prompts) without awaiting user input. We prove six formal results: the Context Stability Theorem, bounding per-turn LM cost as a function of semantic change rate; a Program Composition Correctness Theorem; a Declarative Wiring Soundness Theorem; the Proactive Dominance Theorem, proving proactive agents weakly dominate reactive agents on expected turns-to-terminal-state; Coordination Overhead Elimination and Quality Preservation, establishing Pareto improvements in multi-participant goal chats; and a Cross-Platform Vote Consistency Theorem. Implemented in the open-source Qbix / Safebox / Safebots stack.

AI.tldr: 提出Context智能层，将被动问答聊天机器人重构为主动目标导向智能体，通过预计算上下文、可组合沙箱程序、主动状态机三大机制，实现无需用户提示即可推进共享任务，并给出六个形式化证明。
AI.motivation: 传统查询-响应的聊天机器人被动等待用户输入，效率低下且无法主动推进任务。需要一种新架构让智能体能够无需用户提示即可主动驱动对话向目标状态演进。
AI.method: 1) 写时上下文组装：通过Groker代理预计算丰富的类型化属性，将交互上下文作为图状态的确定性纯函数，语义未变化时上下文块字节一致，实现接近100%的KV缓存复用。2) 可组合沙箱智慧程序：LM生成的命令式程序组成受控库，通过类型化流关系声明式地连接到目标类型，经相位排序组合，交互时执行无需额外LM调用。3) 主动目标流状态机：通过检查图状态并发出结构化交互内容（选项数组、治理权限、澄清提示），无需等待用户输入即驱动对话走向终止状态。
AI.result: 提出六个形式化定理：上下文稳定性定理（每轮LM成本为语义变化率的函数）、程序组合正确性定理、声明式连接可靠性定理、主动主导定理（主动智能体在期望轮数上弱主导被动智能体）、协调开销消除与质量保持定理（多方参与者目标聊天中的帕累托改进）、跨平台投票一致性定理。已在开源Qbix/Safebox/Safebots栈中实现。
AI.conclusion: Magarshak架构的Context层通过写时组装、可组合程序、主动状态机三个相互增强的机制，实现了从被动反应式到主动目标导向的范式转变，在效率、正确性、主导性等方面均有形式化保证，适合构建复杂的多参与者目标驱动交互系统。
idea_en: Write-time context assembly with Groker agents that precomputes enriched typed attributes as a deterministic pure function of graph state, enabling byte-identical context blocks across turns between semantic changes for near-100% KV-cache reuse

Composable sandboxed wisdom programs forming a governed library of LM-generated imperative programs declaratively wired to goal types via typed stream relations, composed via phase ordering and executed without further LM calls at interaction time

Proactive goal stream state machines that drive conversations toward terminal states by inspecting graph state and emitting structured interaction content (option arrays, governance affordances, clarification prompts) without awaiting user input
Context Stability Theorem bounding per-turn LM cost as a function of semantic change rate, enabling predictable and minimal computational expenditure in agent interactions
Program Composition Correctness Theorem and Declarative Wiring Soundness Theorem providing formal guarantees for program composition and connection correctness
Proactive Dominance Theorem proving proactive agents weakly dominate reactive agents on expected turns-to-terminal-state, establishing theoretical advantage of proactive architecture
Cross-Platform Vote Consistency Theorem ensuring consistent voting outcomes across different platform implementations in multi-participant goal chats
idea_ch: 基于Groker代理的写时上下文组装方法：将交互上下文作为图状态的确定性纯函数，在语义未变化时生成字节一致的上下文块，实现接近100%的KV缓存复用，大幅降低LM调用成本
可组合沙箱智慧程序系统：由LM生成的命令式程序组成受控程序库，通过类型化流关系声明式连接到目标类型，经相位排序组合后在交互时执行，无需额外LM调用
主动目标流状态机：通过检查图状态并自动发出结构化交互内容（选项数组、治理权限、澄清提示），无需等待用户输入即可驱动对话向终止状态演进
上下文稳定性定理：将每轮LM成本量化为语义变化率的函数，为智能体交互的计算开销提供可预测性和最小化保障
程序组合正确性与声明式连接可靠性定理：形式化证明组合程序及其声明式连接的正确性和可靠性
主动主导定理：形式化证明主动智能体在到达终止状态的期望轮数上弱主导被动智能体，为主动架构提供理论优势
跨平台投票一致性定理：保证多方参与者目标聊天中不同平台实现产生一致的投票结果

title: Toward Reliable Design of LLM-Enabled Agentic Workflows: Optimizing Latency-Reliability-Cost Tradeoffs
summary: Modern AI systems increasingly rely on workflows composed of multiple interacting agents, some powered by large language models (LLMs) and others by conventional computational modules. This paper analyzes the fundamental tradeoffs between latency, reliability, and cost in LLM-enabled agentic workflows. We introduce performance models for both LLM and non-LLM agents that capture the relationship between computational effort and output quality, incorporating the impact of reasoning and output tokens for LLM agents using a parametric exponential reliability function. Then, we study the design of sequential workflows under latency and cost constraints. Main results include a water-filling token allocation policy and characterizations of optimal workflow reliability in terms of shadow prices.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM代理和传统计算模块组成的多代理工作流，分析了延迟、可靠性和成本之间的基本权衡，提出了性能模型，并研究了顺序工作流的设计。
AI.motivation: 现代AI系统越来越多地使用由多个交互代理组成的工作流，包括LLM驱动和传统计算模块，但缺乏对这些工作流中延迟、可靠性和成本之间权衡的系统分析。
AI.method: 为LLM和非LLM代理引入性能模型，使用参数化指数可靠性函数捕捉LLM代理中推理和输出令牌与输出质量的关系；研究延迟和成本约束下的顺序工作流设计，提出注水令牌分配策略和最优工作流可靠性的影子价格表征。
AI.result: 提出了注水令牌分配策略（water-filling token allocation policy），以及以影子价格形式表征的最优工作流可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 为LLM赋能的代理工作流提供了理论分析框架，揭示了延迟、可靠性和成本之间的定量关系，并给出了优化策略。
idea_en: Water-filling token allocation policy for optimal distribution of computational tokens across sequential LLM agents under latency/cost constraints
Parametric exponential reliability function for modeling LLM agent output quality as a function of reasoning and output tokens
Shadow price-based characterization of optimal workflow reliability in multi-agent systems
Performance model integrating LLM and non-LLM agents for joint latency-reliability-cost tradeoff analysis
idea_ch: 一种注水令牌分配策略，在延迟和成本约束下优化顺序LLM代理间的计算令牌分配
一种参数化指数可靠性函数，用于建模LLM代理的输出质量与推理令牌和输出令牌数量的关系
基于影子价格的多代理工作流最优可靠性表征方法
一种集成LLM代理与非LLM代理的性能模型，用于联合分析延迟、可靠性与成本之间的权衡

title: Quantum Frog: Emergent Cooperation and Difficulty Scaling in a Quantized-Time Cooperative Game
summary: We introduce \emph{Quantum Frog}, a two-player cooperative game built on a novel \emph{quantized-time} mechanic in which the environment advances only when a player acts. Inspired by the classic arcade game Frogger, Quantum Frog requires two frogs to cross an 8$\times$8 grid of traffic and reach the far side together. We use reinforcement learning (RL) as an analytical lens to answer four design questions: (1) how does game difficulty scale with traffic density, (2) what is the optimal single-agent policy and why, (3) how large is the cooperation gap between independent and cooperative two-agent play, and (4) what joint strategy emerges when agents are incentivised to cooperate? We train agents through five escalating stages, Tabular Q-Learning, Deep Q-Network (\DQN), Independent \DQN~(\IDQN), and Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimisation (\MAPPO\ with a centralised critic), evaluating each against traffic densities of one to six cars. Our key findings are: (i) the quantized-time mechanic makes a \emph{rush strategy} (moving directly upward at every step) universally optimal, as time exposure to traffic is minimised; (ii) adding an uncoordinated second player is harder than sextupling the traffic for a single expert player; (iii) cooperative training recovers +32--34 percentage points of joint success rate relative to independent agents and reduces episode length from $\sim$90 to $\sim$6 steps; and (iv) the emergent cooperative strategy is synchronised rushing, not complex positional coordination, illustrating that shared incentives alone suffice to align agents in time-critical cooperative tasks. These findings provide concrete, empirically grounded guidance for the commercial design of Quantum Frog and offer broader insights into the role of environment mechanics in shaping multi-agent learning dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍量子蛙（Quantum Frog）——一款基于"量子化时间"机制的双人合作游戏，并利用强化学习分析其难度、最优策略、合作差距及涌现策略。关键发现：量化时间机制使"冲刺策略"成为最优；未协作双人比六倍车流量更难；协作训练提升成功率32-34个百分点；涌现策略为同步冲刺。
AI.motivation: 通过量子蛙游戏的设计与分析，研究量化时间机制对合作游戏难度、最优策略及多智能体协作动力学的影响，为商业游戏设计和多智能体学习提供实证指导。
AI.method: 采用五阶段强化学习训练：表格Q学习→深度Q网络(DQN)→独立DQN(IDQN)→带集中式评论家的多智能体PPO(MAPPO)，在1-6辆车流量密度下评估，回答四个设计问题。
AI.result: (1)量化时间机制使"冲刺策略"(每步直接向上)最优；(2)未协作双人游戏比单专家面对六倍车流更难；(3)协作训练相比独立训练提升32-34个百分点成功率，将回合长度从~90步降至~6步；(4)涌现的合作策略是同步冲刺而非复杂位置协调。
AI.conclusion: 量化时间机制显著影响最优策略和协作难度；共享激励足以在时间关键型合作任务中实现智能体对齐；为量子蛙的商业化设计和多智能体环境机制设计提供指导。
idea_en: A quantized-time game mechanic where game environment only advances when a player acts, enabling precise time-risk control in cooperative gameplay
A cooperative two-player grid navigation system with synchronized rushing strategy as emergent optimal behavior under quantized-time constraints
A multi-stage RL training pipeline (Tabular Q-Learning -> DQN -> IDQN -> MAPPO) for analyzing game difficulty scaling and cooperation gaps
A method for measuring cooperation gap in multi-agent games by comparing independent vs. cooperative training success rates across varying traffic densities
A centralized-critic multi-agent training framework that achieves 32-34 percentage point improvement in joint success rate over independent agents in time-critical cooperative tasks
idea_ch: 一种量子化时间游戏机制：环境仅在玩家行动时推进，实现合作游戏中的精确时间风险控制
一种双人合作网格穿越系统：在量子化时间约束下，同步冲刺策略作为涌现的最优合作行为
一种多阶段强化学习训练流水线（表格Q学习→DQN→IDQN→MAPPO），用于分析游戏难度缩放和合作差距
一种测量多智能体游戏中合作差距的方法：通过比较独立训练与协作训练在不同车流密度下的成功率差异
一种集中式评论家多智能体训练框架：在时间关键型合作任务中，相比独立智能体实现32-34个百分点的联合成功率提升

title: BODHI: Precise OS Kernel Specification Inference
summary: The formal verification of operating system kernels requires precise specifications that capture the intended behavior of system calls. Writing these specifications manually demands deep domain expertise, motivating the use of large language models (LLMs) to automate the process. However, in OSV-Bench, a benchmark of 245 specification generation tasks derived from the Hyperkernel OS kernel, the best reported Pass@1 is 55.10%. We propose a domain knowledge prompting method (BODHI), which augments the standard few-shot prompt with a structured C-to-Python translation guide covering 15 categories of domain-specific translation patterns. Inspired by Structured Chain-of-Thought (SCoT) prompting, the guide organizes translation by separation of concerns, addressing pre-condition extraction and post-condition generation as distinct categories. Evaluated on nine models from six providers (Anthropic, Mistral, Amazon, DeepSeek, Meta, Alibaba), covering dense, mixture-of-experts and reasoning architectures, BODHI improves every model tested, with gains ranging from +11% to +32%. The best configuration (Claude Opus 4.6 + BODHI) reaches 96.73% Pass@1. BODHI reduces both syntax and semantic errors, with the strongest effect on models that have sufficient instruction-following capability to utilize structured reference material. These results demonstrate that domain knowledge injection is a model-agnostic technique that substantially bridges the gap between general-purpose code generation and formal specification synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出BODHI领域知识提示方法，通过结构化C-to-Python翻译指南（涵盖15类领域特定模式）提升LLM生成操作系统内核形式化规格说明的能力，在Hyperkernel的245个规格生成任务中，最佳配置（Claude Opus 4.6 + BODHI）达到96.73% Pass@1，比基线提升11%-32%。
AI.motivation: 操作系统内核形式化验证需要精确的系统调用规格说明，手动编写需要深厚领域知识，现有LLM方法在OSV-Bench基准上Pass@1仅55.10%，自动化程度不足。
AI.method: 提出BODHI领域知识提示方法，在标准少样本提示基础上，增加结构化C-to-Python翻译指南，涵盖15类领域特定翻译模式，并受Structured Chain-of-Thought启发，按关注点分离原则组织翻译指南，分别处理前置条件提取和后置条件生成。
AI.result: 在9个模型（覆盖6家供应商的密集、混合专家和推理架构）上测试，BODHI使所有模型提升11%-32%，最佳配置Claude Opus 4.6 + BODHI达到96.73% Pass@1。BODHI同时减少语法错误和语义错误，对具有足够指令遵循能力的模型效果最强。
AI.conclusion: 领域知识注入是一种模型无关的技术，能显著缩小通用代码生成与形式化规格合成之间的差距。
idea_en: A domain knowledge prompting method (BODHI) that augments few-shot prompts with a structured C-to-Python translation guide covering 15 categories of domain-specific translation patterns for OS kernel formal specification generation.
A Structured Chain-of-Thought inspired separation-of-concerns approach that organizes specification generation into distinct categories: pre-condition extraction and post-condition generation.
A model-agnostic technique (BODHI) that injects domain knowledge into LLM prompts to improve Pass@1 rate from 55.10% to 96.73% on OS kernel formal verification specification tasks.
A method to reduce both syntax and semantic errors in LLM-generated formal specifications through structured domain knowledge injection.
idea_ch: 一种领域知识提示方法(BODHI)，通过结构化C-to-Python翻译指南（涵盖15类领域特定翻译模式）增强少样本提示，用于操作系统内核形式化规格生成。
基于结构化思维链的关注点分离方法，将规格生成任务按前置条件提取和后置条件生成组织为不同类别。
一种模型无关的领域知识注入技术(BODHI)，将形式化验证规格生成任务的Pass@1从55.10%提升至96.73%。
通过结构化领域知识注入减少LLM生成的形式化规格中语法错误和语义错误的方法。

title: When Correct Beliefs Collapse: Epistemic Resilience of LLMs under Clinical Pressure
summary: Despite strong medical benchmark accuracy, LLMs can exhibit severe multi-turn sycophancy in clinical dialogue, abandoning initial correct diagnosis under escalating pressure. We propose \textbf{\textsc{Med-Stress}}, a targeted stress test framework that evaluates belief stability under escalating pressure. Across nine frontier large language models (LLMs), we find a clear dissociation between medical knowledge and robustness: high initial diagnostic capability does not imply high belief stability, yielding large knowledge-robustness gaps for several LLMs. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a lightweight inference-time defense, \textbf{\texttt{RBED}} (\textbf{R}ole-\textbf{B}ased \textbf{E}pistemic \textbf{D}efense), and \textbf{\texttt{R-FT}} (\textbf{R}esilience-oriented \textbf{F}ine-\textbf{T}uning), a training-time approach that internalizes evidence-based resistance to pressure. Experiments show that \textbf{\texttt{R-FT}} nearly eliminates belief change and substantially improves robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Med-Stress压力测试框架评估LLM在临床对话中的信念稳定性，发现高诊断能力不等于高鲁棒性，并提出RBED（推理时防御）和R-FT（训练时微调）两种方法提升模型抗压能力。
AI.motivation: LLMs在临床对话中存在严重的多轮迎合问题（sycophancy），即在不断升级的压力下放弃原本正确的诊断，现有评估缺乏对这类信念稳定性的系统测试。
AI.method: 1) 提出Med-Stress压力测试框架，评估模型在逐步升级压力下的信念稳定性；2) 对比9个前沿LLM，揭示知识-鲁棒性差距；3) 提出RBED（基于角色的认知防御）和R-FT（面向韧性的微调）两种缓解方法。
AI.result: 高初始诊断能力不等于高信念稳定性，存在显著的知识-鲁棒性差距；R-FT近乎消除信念改变，大幅提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 医疗LLM不仅需要诊断知识，还需要信念稳定性；R-FT是一种有效的抗压训练方法，可作为评估和安全部署的关键环节。
idea_en: Med-Stress stress testing framework: A systematic method to evaluate LLM belief stability under escalating pressure in clinical dialogues, capable of quantifying the knowledge-robustness gap across different models.

Role-Based Epistemic Defense (RBED): A lightweight inference-time defense mechanism that maintains diagnostic stability by anchoring the model's responses to its initial evidence-based reasoning under external pressure.

Resilience-oriented Fine-Tuning (R-FT): A training-time approach that enhances LLMs' evidence-based resistance to clinical pressure through specialized fine-tuning, nearly eliminating belief change behavior.
idea_ch: Med-Stress压力测试框架：一种系统性的方法，用于评估LLM在临床对话中面对逐步升级压力时的信念稳定性，能够量化不同模型的知识-鲁棒性差距。
基于角色的认知防御（RBED）：一种轻量级推理时防御机制，通过将模型响应锚定到初始基于证据的推理上，在外部压力下维持诊断稳定性。
面向韧性的微调（R-FT）：一种训练时方法，通过专门的微调增强LLM在临床压力下基于证据的抵抗能力，几乎消除了信念改变行为。

title: Practical Quantum CIM Empowerment via All-Domestic-Core Agentic Large Model
summary: Quantum computing devices are recognized as powerful tools for solving NP-complete problems. However, the intricacy of their modeling presents notable barriers for non-specialists, while the tedious iteration of constraint weights and modeling methodologies also consumes substantial effort on the part of experts. To address these challenges, this study integrates a femtosecond laser-pumped Coherent Ising Machine (CIM) with an LLM-driven agentic system by leveraging the LangGraph and LangChain frameworks. Comprehensive investigations demonstrate that large language models (LLMs) can effectively perform such tasks in modeling as QUBO/Ising model calibration, constraint weight decision iteration and rapid validation of literature-reported schemes. Notably, all these tasks can be fully implemented based on domestic large models, combined with domestically developed CIM hardware, we truly achieve the practical empowerment of quantum CIM that fully relies on all-domestic agentic large models and hardware. This work successfully realizes robust technological integration, laying a solid foundation for subsequent research. Nevertheless, it also identifies the persisting challenges in the two cutting-edge fields of large models and quantum computing at the current stage. Encouragingly, we unexpectedly discover a promising new paradigm where accumulated knowledge from agent-assisted quantum computing iterations reciprocally enhances the agent's own problem-solving capability, thereby addressing these challenges.

AI.tldr: 本研究将飞秒激光泵浦的相干伊辛机(CIM)与基于LLM的智能体系统(利用LangGraph和LangChain框架)相结合，实现了量子计算建模的自动化。通过国产大模型和国产CIM硬件，完成了QUBO/Ising模型校准、约束权重决策迭代和文献方案验证，并发现了一个新范式：智能体辅助量子计算迭代积累的知识能反向增强智能体自身的问题解决能力。
AI.motivation: 量子计算设备虽能解决NP完全问题，但建模复杂性对非专业人员构成显著障碍，且约束权重迭代和建模方法繁琐耗时，亟需自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 将飞秒激光泵浦的CIM与LLM驱动的智能体系统结合，基于LangGraph和LangChain框架实现QUBO/Ising模型校准、约束权重决策迭代和文献方案验证。
AI.result: LLM能有效执行建模任务，所有任务可基于国产大模型和国产CIM硬件完全实现，实现了全自主国产智能体大模型和硬件的量子CIM实用化赋能。
AI.conclusion: 成功实现了稳健的技术集成，发现了一种有前景的新范式：智能体辅助量子计算迭代积累的知识可反向增强智能体自身的问题解决能力。
idea_en: An LLM-driven agentic system integrated with a femtosecond laser-pumped Coherent Ising Machine (CIM) for automated QUBO/Ising model calibration and constraint weight iteration.
A method for rapid validation of literature-reported quantum computing schemes using large language models (LLMs) within a LangGraph and LangChain framework.
A fully domestic (China-localized) quantum computing empowerment system combining domestically-developed large models with domestically-manufactured CIM hardware.
A reciprocal learning paradigm where knowledge accumulated from agent-assisted quantum computing iterations enhances the agent's own problem-solving capabilities.
An automated constraint weight decision iteration system for Coherent Ising Machines leveraging LLM-based reasoning and decision-making.
idea_ch: 一种集成飞秒激光泵浦相干伊辛机(CIM)与LLM驱动智能体的系统，用于自动化QUBO/Ising模型校准和约束权重迭代
一种基于LangGraph和LangChain框架、利用大语言模型快速验证文献报道量子计算方案的方法
一种全自主国产化量子计算赋能系统，结合国产大模型与国产CIM硬件实现端到端量子计算
一种互惠学习范式：智能体辅助量子计算迭代过程中积累的知识反向增强智能体自身的问题解决能力
一种基于LLM推理和决策的相干伊辛机自动约束权重决策迭代系统

title: Operationalizing Reconstructive Authority: Runtime Construction, Dependency Resolution, and Execution Gating in Autonomous Agent Systems
comment: Agent Governance Series, Paper P6. Companion papers on arXiv: P0 (2604.17511), P1 (2603.18829), P2 (2604.17517). P3/4 and P5 submitted concurrently (pending arXiv IDs). Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.19699460
summary:
Autonomous agent systems fail not only due to incorrect decisions, but due to executing decisions whose authority no longer holds at runtime. Prior work defined Reconstructive Authority (RAM) as a condition for valid execution: actions are permitted only if authority can be constructed from current state.
  This paper addresses enforcement at runtime: how to enforce this condition in a running system.
  We introduce a runtime execution model in which authority is evaluated at action time and execution is conditioned on its constructibility. This extends the execution state space beyond admit/deny with a third state, halt, representing cases where authority is undefined due to incomplete or uncertain observability.
  We define a concrete execution protocol including dynamic dependency resolution, authority reconstruction, and explicit decision semantics. We further introduce a Recovery Loop that integrates drift detection (IML) with execution control (ACP), allowing the system to suspend execution, acquire missing information, and re-attempt authority reconstruction.
  We show that this model guarantees safety -- no action is executed without constructible authority -- and conditional liveness: execution resumes when authority-defining variables become observable.
  This work operationalizes reconstructive authority as a runtime enforcement mechanism, providing the execution semantics required to apply RAM in real systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种运行时执行模型，确保仅在当前状态可构建权威（Reconstructive Authority）时才允许执行动作，并引入第三状态"halt"处理权威未定义的情况，结合漂移检测与恢复循环保证安全性和有条件活性。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体系统不仅因错误决策失败，更因执行在运行时权威已失效的决策而失败。需要一种运行时机制来强制执行"权威可构建性"条件。
AI.method: 提出运行时执行模型：在动作执行时评估权威，扩展执行状态空间为admit/halt/deny三态；定义具体执行协议，包括动态依赖解析、权威重构和显式决策语义；引入恢复循环，集成漂移检测（IML）与执行控制（ACP），允许暂停执行、获取缺失信息并重试权威重构。
AI.result: 模型保证安全性（无动作在无可构建权威时执行）和有条件活性（当权威定义变量可观测时恢复执行）。
AI.conclusion: 将可重构权威作为运行时强制执行机制，提供了在真实系统中应用RAM所需的执行语义。
idea_en: A runtime execution model extending decision space to three states (admit/halt/deny) where authority is evaluated at action time based on constructibility from current state
An execution protocol with dynamic dependency resolution and authority reconstruction that conditions execution on constructible authority at runtime
A Recovery Loop integrating drift detection (IML) with execution control (ACP) enabling system suspension, missing information acquisition, and re-attempt of authority reconstruction
idea_ch: 一种运行时执行模型，将决策空间扩展为三态（admit/halt/deny），在动作执行时基于当前状态的可构建性评估权威
一种包含动态依赖解析和权威重构的执行协议，运行时以权威可构建性为条件控制执行
一种集成漂移检测（IML）与执行控制（ACP）的恢复循环机制，允许系统暂停执行、获取缺失信息并重试权威重构

title: Fuzzy, Neutrosophic, and Uncertain Graph Theory: Properties and Applications
comment: 326 pages. Publisher: Neutrosophic Science International Association (NSIA) Publishing House. ISBN: 978-197250204-4
summary: This book presents a comprehensive and systematic survey of graph theory under uncertainty, with particular emphasis on the unifying role of the uncertain graph framework. It reviews fundamental concepts, structural properties, graph classes, and graph parameters within fuzzy, neutrosophic, and related models, while also introducing a wide range of extensions such as uncertain digraphs, hypergraphs, superhypergraphs, and dynamic graphs. In addition to theoretical developments, the book explores practical applications, including uncertain molecular graphs, decision-making systems, graph neural networks, knowledge graphs, and cognitive maps. By organizing diverse uncertainty-aware graph models within a common perspective, this work provides a coherent framework for understanding their relationships, capabilities, and applications in complex systems.

AI.tldr: 该书系统综述了不确定性图论，以不确定性图框架为核心，统一了模糊图、中智图等模型，并扩展到有向图、超图、超超图、动态图等，同时涵盖分子图、决策系统、图神经网络、知识图谱和认知地图等应用。
AI.motivation: 现有图论研究多基于精确数据，而现实世界充满不确定性（模糊、不一致、不完整信息）。缺乏一个统一的框架来整合各种不确定性图模型，理解它们之间的关系、能力和应用。
AI.method: 采用系统综述方法，以不确定性图框架作为统一视角，梳理模糊图、中智图等基础概念、结构性质、图类和图参数，并从理论基础扩展到有向图、超图、超超图、动态图等扩展模型，最后探讨实际应用。
AI.result: 构建了一个统一的不确定性图理论体系，揭示了不同不确定性图模型之间的内在联系和层次关系，并展示了其在分子图、决策系统、图神经网络、知识图谱和认知地图等多个领域的应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性图框架为理解和应用复杂系统中的不确定性图模型提供了一个连贯的理论基础，有助于推动图论在不精确信息环境下的发展和应用。
idea_en: A unified uncertain graph framework that systematically integrates fuzzy, neutrosophic, and other uncertainty-aware graph models under a common mathematical structure
Uncertain hypergraph and superhypergraph models for representing higher-order uncertainty relationships beyond pairwise connections
Uncertain dynamic graph models that capture temporal evolution of uncertainty in graph structures
Uncertain graph neural network architecture that incorporates uncertainty-aware graph representations for learning under incomplete or imprecise data
Uncertain cognitive map framework that models causal relationships with multiple types of uncertainty (fuzzy, neutrosophic)
Uncertain molecular graph representation for chemical compounds with imprecise or uncertain bonding information
idea_ch: 一种统一的不确定性图框架，将模糊图、中智图等多种不确定性图模型纳入共同的数学结构
不确定性超图和超超图模型，用于表示超越成对连接的高阶不确定性关系
不确定性动态图模型，捕捉图结构中不确定性随时间的演化
不确定性图神经网络架构，结合不确定性感知的图表示在不完整或不精确数据下进行学习
不确定性认知地图框架，使用多种不确定性类型（模糊、中智）建模因果关系
不确定性分子图表示方法，用于处理化合物中不精确或不确定的化学键信息

title: BoxLitE: A Faithful Knowledge Base Embedding Based on Convex Optimization
comment: 28 pages. Full version of paper accepted to KR 2026 (23nd International Conference on Principles of Knowledge Representation and Reasoning). Track: KR meets Machine Learning and Explanation
summary: Knowledge base (KB) embeddings aim at combining the capability of classical knowledge graph embeddings to generalize the information present in facts, the ABox, with conceptual knowledge represented in an ontology language, the TBox. Several authors have recently explored the idea of mapping concepts to convex regions in a vector space. This is useful to represent hierarchies, typically present in TBoxes, since more general concepts can be mapped to larger regions, containing those regions associated with more specific concepts. However, the power of convexity is rarely leveraged during the actual learning tasks. Here, we introduce BoxLitE, a KB embedding model for DL-Lite$^{\mathcal{H}}$ that allows for convex optimization. We show that for any satisfiable DL-Lite$^{\mathcal{H}}$ KB, there is a BoxLitE embedding that is a weakly faithful model. As a proof of concept, we show how to formulate the KB embedding task as a convex optimization problem and how to obtain embeddings with such desirable faithfulness properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BoxLitE，一种用于DL-Lite^H知识库的嵌入模型，通过将概念映射到凸区域（盒子）实现凸优化，并证明其弱忠实性。
AI.motivation: 现有知识库嵌入方法很少利用凸区域表示的优势来进行学习任务，尤其是对于包含TBox公理（如层级结构）的DL-Lite逻辑族。
AI.method: 提出BoxLitE模型，将ABox中的事实与TBox中的概念分别映射到向量空间中的凸区域（盒子），并形式化为凸优化问题，实现弱忠实嵌入。
AI.result: 证明了任何可满足的DL-Lite^H知识库都存在一个BoxLitE弱忠实嵌入，并通过凸优化获得该嵌入。
AI.conclusion: BoxLitE成功将凸区域表示与知识库嵌入结合，在保证弱忠实性的同时实现了凸优化训练，为后续可解释推理奠定基础。
idea_en: A method for embedding DL-Lite^H knowledge bases using axis-aligned convex boxes (hyperrectangles) to represent TBox concepts and ABox instances, enabling convex optimization for training.
A weakly faithful embedding technique that maps each DL-Lite^H ontology concept to a convex region such that subsumption relationships correspond to geometric containment of boxes.
A convex optimization formulation for knowledge base embedding that guarantees the existence of a satisfiable embedding for any consistent DL-Lite^H KB.
A Box embedding model (BoxLitE) that simultaneously represents ABox facts and TBox axioms in a unified vector space with provable faithfulness properties.
idea_ch: 一种使用坐标轴对齐的凸盒（超矩形）表示DL-Lite^H知识库中TBox概念和ABox实例的嵌入方法，支持凸优化训练。
一种弱忠实嵌入技术，将DL-Lite^H本体中的每个概念映射到凸区域，使得概念间的包含关系对应于盒子的几何包含关系。
一种针对知识库嵌入的凸优化形式化方法，保证任何一致DL-Lite^H知识库都存在可满足嵌入。
BoxLitE模型，在统一向量空间中同时表示ABox事实和TBox公理，并具有可证明的忠实性属性。

title: Authority Inversion in LLM-Mediated Ubiquitous Systems: When Models Trust Users Over Sensors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly fuse heterogeneous inputs in ubiquitous systems. Yet, how LLMs implicitly allocate authority when sensor measurements and user claims conflict remains unexamined, raising critical reliability concerns for deployments where physical sensing must retain priority. Unlike explicit traditional fusion, LLMs bury authority allocation within learned representations. We discover this allocation is severely format-dependent: numerical sensor data fails to integrate into answer-relevant model directions, allowing natural-language claims to dominate the final decision, a phenomenon we term \textbf{Authority Inversion}.To diagnose and mitigate this, we develop a geometric framework of context integration, introduce two computable audit metrics, specifically the Context Integration Ratio (CIR) and Authority Alignment Index (AAI), and propose Geometric Authority Calibration (GAC), an inference-time layer-level intervention to suppress misplaced user authority. Evaluating four models (4B to 35B parameters, three architectures) across four datasets totaling 576 conflict instances reveals extreme inversion: on numerical tasks, models exhibit near-zero sensor trust (AAI = -0.805, Cohen's d = -2.14), unaffected by model capacity. Validating our geometric framework, theory-guided causal injection flips 80.2\% of incorrect decisions (vs. <0.4\% for random controls). Practically, GAC improves HAR accuracy from 0 -- 1.6\% to 21.9 -- 27.5\%, outperforming prompting baselines. Ultimately, authority allocation in LLM-mediated systems must be explicitly audited and application-specifically configured rather than left implicit.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM在融合传感器数值和自然语言用户描述时，存在严重的"权威反转"现象——自然语言支配数值传感器数据。作者提出几何框架、两个审计指标(CIR, AAI)和推理时层级干预方法GAC，成功将HAR准确率从0-1.6%提升至21.9-27.5%。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地融合异构输入（传感器+用户描述），但未明确检查当传感器测量与用户声称冲突时如何隐含分配权威，这存在严重可靠性隐患。
AI.method: 提出几何框架分析上下文集成；引入两个可计算审计指标：上下文集成比(CIR)和权威对齐指数(AAI)；提出几何权威校准(GAC)，一种推理时层级别干预方法，抑制不合理用户权威。
AI.result: 在4个模型（4B-35B参数，3种架构）、4个数据集、576个冲突实例上：AAI=-0.805, Cohen's d=-2.14；理论引导的因果注入翻转80.2%错误决策；GAC将HAR准确率从0-1.6%提升到21.9-27.5%。
AI.conclusion: LLM中介系统中的权威分配必须显式审计和应用特定配置，不能保持隐含状态。
idea_en: A method for detecting Authority Inversion in LLM-based multi-modal fusion systems using Context Integration Ratio (CIR) and Authority Alignment Index (AAI) metrics
Geometric Authority Calibration (GAC): an inference-time layer-level intervention that suppresses misplaced user authority when sensor data and natural language claims conflict
A geometric framework for analyzing context integration in LLMs that models how different input modalities compete for representational authority
Causal injection technique guided by geometric theory to flip incorrect model decisions in multi-modal fusion scenarios
System and method for explicit audit and application-specific configuration of authority allocation in LLM-mediated systems with heterogeneous inputs
idea_ch: 基于上下文集成比(CIR)和权威对齐指数(AAI)的LLM多模态融合系统中权威反转检测方法
几何权威校准(GAC)：推理时层级别干预方法，在传感器数据与自然语言冲突时抑制不当的用户权威
分析LLM中上下文集成的几何框架，建模不同输入模态如何在表示空间中竞争权威
基于几何理论引导的因果注入技术，在多模态融合场景中翻转模型错误决策
LLM异构输入系统中权威分配的显式审计与应用特定配置方法及系统

title: DRIVE: Modeling Skills at the Reasoning and Interaction Levels for Web Agents under Continual Learning
summary: Web agents require both high-level reasoning (for task decomposition) and low-level interactions (for page elements manipulation) to conduct different tasks. However, these knowledge types differ fundamentally: reasoning knowledge (e.g., booking a flight requires first searching for routes) is abstract and transferable across websites, while interaction knowledge (e.g., clicking the Search button at a specific coordinate on Site A) depends heavily on page-specific contexts. Existing methods store experiences uniformly. This creates a dilemma: abstract representations lose executability on concrete pages, while concrete representations fail to generalize across domains. This entanglement limits capability accumulation: on new websites, agents either fail to recognize reusable task logic due to surface-level differences or attempt infeasible actions from outdated page structures. To disentangle them, we propose DRIVE, a dual-level skill modeling framework separating historical experience into natural language reasoning skills, which capture transferable task logic, and programmatic interaction skills, grounding abstract actions to executable operations. A scene-aware coordination mechanism adaptively retrieves and invokes these dual-level skills based on task semantics. DRIVE also uses skill-level reflection to identify hierarchy-specific failure modes, enabling targeted skill library expansion and refinement. Experiments across five WebArena domains show DRIVE attains an average task success rate of 52.8%, exceeding the skill-free baseline by 7.3 percentage points. Further ablations show reasoning and interaction skills provide distinct, complementary benefits, supporting separation of transferable task logic from executable page-level operations.

AI.tldr: DRIVE提出双层次技能模型，将Web agent的经验分离为自然语言推理技能（可迁移的任务逻辑）和程序化交互技能（可执行的操作），通过场景感知协调机制动态调用，解决统一表示导致的可迁移性与可执行性之间的冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将Web agent的经验统一存储，导致抽象表示在具体页面上缺乏可执行性，而具体表示又无法跨域泛化。这种纠缠限制了能力积累，新网站上的agent要么因表面差异无法识别可复用的任务逻辑，要么因页面结构过时而尝试不可行的操作。
AI.method: 提出DRIVE框架，包含：(1) 双层次技能模型——将历史经验分离为自然语言推理技能（捕获可迁移的任务逻辑）和程序化交互技能（将抽象动作锚定到可执行操作）；(2) 场景感知协调机制——基于任务语义自适应检索和调用双层次技能；(3) 技能级反思——识别层次特定的失败模式，实现针对性技能库扩展和精炼。
AI.result: 在五个WebArena领域的实验中，DRIVE达到平均52.8%的任务成功率，超过无技能基线7.3个百分点。消融实验证明推理技能和交互技能提供不同且互补的收益。
AI.conclusion: 将可迁移的任务逻辑与可执行的页面级操作分离是有效的，双层次技能模型能更好地支持Web agent的能力积累和跨域泛化。
idea_en: A dual-level skill modeling framework for web agents that separates historical experience into natural language reasoning skills (capturing transferable task logic) and programmatic interaction skills (grounding abstract actions to executable page-specific operations).
A scene-aware coordination mechanism that adaptively retrieves and invokes dual-level skills based on task semantics, enabling dynamic selection between reasoning and interaction skills.
A skill-level reflection method that identifies hierarchy-specific failure modes for reasoning skills versus interaction skills, enabling targeted skill library expansion and refinement.
idea_ch: 一种双层次技能建模框架，将Web agent的历史经验分离为自然语言推理技能（捕获可迁移的任务逻辑）和程序化交互技能（将抽象动作锚定到页面特定的可执行操作）。
一种场景感知协调机制，基于任务语义自适应检索和调用双层次技能，实现推理技能与交互技能之间的动态选择与协同。
一种技能级反思方法，分别识别推理技能与交互技能的层次特定失败模式，实现针对性技能库扩展和精炼。

title: Residual Drift Dominates Contradiction in Multi-Turn Constraint Reasoning
comment: Published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Reasoning and Planning for LLMs. 18 pages. ICLR page: https://iclr.cc/virtual/2026/10017484 Code: https://github.com/kaons-research/drift-bench
summary: How do multi-turn reasoning systems fail? The expected answer is logical contradiction, in which the system's maintained state becomes unsatisfiable. We show that the dominant mode is instead satisfiable drift, where the internal state stays consistent while the returned answer silently violates prior commitments. We build DRIFT-Bench (Decomposing Reasoning Into Failure Types), a solver-instrumented benchmark of 816 test problems across three constraint domains, and evaluate four methods on it across four open-weight models (8B-120B parameters). MUS-Repair, which feeds minimal unsatisfiable subsets back to the generator, is strongest in every setting (+1.8 to +15.0 pp over the best non-MUS baseline). But the central finding is what repair leaves behind. After structured feedback, models rarely contradict themselves. They forget. Residual errors are 98-100% satisfiable drift across all settings, while contradiction drops to near zero. Reliable multi-turn systems must separately validate that the returned answer respects the maintained state. Code is available at https://github.com/kaons-research/drift-bench.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多轮推理系统的主要失败模式不是逻辑矛盾，而是"可满足漂移"——系统状态一致但回答悄悄违反先前承诺。作者构建DRIFT-Bench基准，提出MUS-Repair方法，发现结构化反馈后残差错误98-100%是可满足漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有研究认为多轮推理系统失败的主要原因是逻辑矛盾（状态不可满足），但作者观察发现实际失败模式不同，需要系统性地分类和量化失败类型。
AI.method: 1. 构建DRIFT-Bench基准（816个测试问题，3个约束域），使用求解器标注失败类型；2. 提出MUS-Repair方法（将最小不可满足子集反馈给生成器）；3. 在4个开放权重模型（8B-120B参数）上评估4种方法。
AI.result: MUS-Repair在所有设置中表现最强（比最佳非MUS基线高+1.8到+15.0个百分点）。核心发现：结构化反馈后，模型很少产生矛盾，而是遗忘——残差错误中98-100%是可满足漂移，矛盾几乎降至零。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的多轮推理系统必须单独验证返回的回答是否尊重已维护的状态。可满足漂移是比逻辑矛盾更普遍且更隐蔽的失败模式。
idea_en: A method for decomposing multi-turn reasoning failures into typed categories (contradiction vs. satisfiable drift) using a solver-instrumented benchmark, enabling systematic diagnosis of model behavior.
MUS-Repair: A technique that feeds minimal unsatisfiable subsets (MUS) of constraints back to the generator for iterative repair, improving multi-turn reasoning consistency.

A validation framework that separately checks whether a model's returned answer respects the maintained state across turns, addressing satisfiable drift errors that standard contradiction detection misses.
A benchmark (DRIFT-Bench) with 816 test problems across three constraint domains, instrumented with solvers to automatically classify failure types in multi-turn reasoning.
idea_ch: 一种将多轮推理失败分解为类型化类别（矛盾 vs. 可满足漂移）的方法，使用求解器标注的基准进行系统诊断模型行为。
MUS-Repair技术：将最小不可满足子集（MUS）反馈给生成器进行迭代修复，提高多轮推理一致性。
一种验证框架，单独检查模型返回的回答是否尊重跨轮次维护的状态，解决标准矛盾检测无法捕获的可满足漂移错误。
DRIFT-Bench基准：包含三个约束域的816个测试问题，使用求解器自动分类多轮推理中的失败类型。

title: MEMOR-E: In-Context and Fine-Tuned LLM Personalization for Alzheimer's Assistive Robotics
summary: Alzheimer's disease is a neurodegenerative disorder marked by progressive declines in memory and language that reduce independence in daily life, motivating socially assistive robotic support. This paper presents MEMOR-E, a mobile quadruped robot with an interactive tablet interface that assists patients and caregivers through medication reminders, routine guidance, memory oriented interactions, and companionship. We evaluated the feasibility of fine tuning large language models (LLMs) to emulate stage consistent cognitive behavior and interpret responses across standard neuropsychological language tasks, using audio transcriptions from 235 Alzheimer's patients and synthetically generated healthy controls. We also report findings on using in context learning (ICL) in LLMs, where a second LLM produced domain and severity level cognitive error summaries. Our results show that MEMOR-E can generate stage aware, non diagnostic cognitive summaries that support personalized assistive interactions, while explainable AI mechanisms translate model outputs into transparent, human readable evidence to enable caregiver oversight and trustworthy human robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍MEMOR-E，一款集成平板界面的移动四足机器人，通过微调大语言模型实现阿尔茨海默病患者的分阶段认知行为模拟与个性化辅助护理，并利用可解释AI机制提供透明、非诊断性的认知摘要以支持人机交互。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病导致记忆和语言能力进行性下降，患者日常生活独立性降低，亟需社交辅助机器人的支持来提供药物提醒、常规指导、记忆互动和陪伴。
AI.method: 采用移动四足机器人MEMOR-E配交互平板；微调大语言模型以模拟阶段一致的认知行为；利用235名患者的音频转录和合成健康对照数据进行上下文学习（ICL）；第二个LLM生成领域和严重程度级别的认知错误摘要；可解释AI机制将模型输出转化为透明、可读的证据。
AI.result: MEMOR-E能够生成阶段感知的、非诊断性的认知摘要，支持个性化辅助交互；可解释AI机制实现了透明的、人类可读的输出，保障了护理人员的监督和可信人机交互。
AI.conclusion: 证明了通过LLM微调和ICL可实现对阿尔茨海默病患者的认知行为模拟与个性化辅助，可解释AI增强了护理人员的信任和监管能力。
idea_en: A mobile quadruped robot integrated with an interactive tablet for Alzheimer's patient care, combining physical mobility with touch-based cognitive interaction interfaces.
Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) to emulate stage-consistent cognitive behaviors of Alzheimer's patients across standard neuropsychological language tasks.
Using in-context learning (ICL) with a second LLM to generate domain-specific and severity-level cognitive error summaries for personalized assessment.
An explainable AI mechanism that translates LLM cognitive outputs into transparent, human-readable evidence for caregiver oversight in human-robot interaction.
A method for generating stage-aware, non-diagnostic cognitive summaries from patient audio transcriptions using fine-tuned LLMs.
idea_ch: 一种集成交互式平板界面的移动四足机器人系统，结合物理移动性与触控认知交互界面，专用于阿尔茨海默病患者的辅助护理。
通过微调大语言模型，在标准化神经心理学语言任务中模拟阿尔茨海默病患者的分阶段一致认知行为的方法。
利用上下文学习技术，由第二个大语言模型生成领域特定和严重程度级别的认知错误摘要，用于个性化评估。
一种可解释AI机制，将大语言模型的认知输出转化为透明、人类可读的证据，支持护理人员在人与机器人交互中的监督。
基于患者音频转录文本，利用微调后的大语言模型生成阶段感知的、非诊断性认知摘要的方法。

title: A Dynamical Framework for Cognitive Processes Based on Transformations and Semantic Equivalence
summary:
This paper proposes a structural and dynamical framework for modeling cognitive processes within a cybernetic perspective. Cognitive states are represented as elements of a state space evolving through an iterative update rule of the form
  \[
  X_{t+1} = π\big(F(f(X_t))\big),
  \]
  where $f$ describes internal transformations, $F$ represents interpretative mappings, and $π$ enforces semantic equivalence.
  The model is interpreted as a feedback system integrating transformation, observation, and stabilization. A categorical formulation is introduced to capture compositional structure, while the associated dynamics are analyzed through fixed-point arguments and contraction conditions ensuring stability.
  To demonstrate the operational character of the framework, a computational illustration is provided, together with a qualitative analysis of the induced dynamics. A concrete linguistic application shows how context-dependent interpretation can be modeled as a trajectory toward a stable semantic class.
  The proposed approach connects dynamical systems, category theory, and cognitive modeling, and provides a unified representation of cognition as a feedback-driven process evolving toward invariant interpretations.

AI.tldr: 本文在控制论视角下提出了一种认知过程的结构与动力学框架，通过迭代更新规则X_{t+1} = π(F(f(X_t)))建模认知状态演化，结合范畴论与不动点论证，最终以语言应用示例展示了上下文依赖解释如何收敛到稳定的语义类别。
AI.motivation: 传统认知模型缺乏对动态反馈与语义稳定性的统一描述，本文旨在将动力系统、范畴论与认知建模结合，建立一种反馈驱动的认知过程统一表示框架。
AI.method: 提出状态空间迭代更新规则X_{t+1} = π(F(f(X_t)))，其中f为内部变换，F为解释映射，π为语义等价约束；引入范畴论刻画组合结构；通过不动点论证与收缩条件分析稳定性；并进行计算实例与语言应用验证。
AI.result: 构建了认知过程的反馈系统模型，通过不动点分析保证了稳定性，并通过计算实例和上下文语义分类的语言应用证明了框架的操作可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功将动力系统、范畴论与认知建模统一，展示了认知作为反馈驱动、朝向不变解释演化的过程，为认知科学的形式化建模提供了新路径。
idea_en: A feedback-driven cognitive state evolution method using iterative update rule X_{t+1} = π(F(f(X_t))) for modeling context-dependent interpretation as a trajectory toward stable semantic class.
A categorical composition structure for cognitive process that enables formal analysis of compositional semantics through transformation, observation, and stabilization mappings.
A semantic equivalence enforcement mechanism (π) that ensures cognitive state transitions converge to invariant interpretations via fixed-point and contraction conditions.
A unified dynamical system framework integrating internal transformation (f), interpretative mapping (F), and semantic stabilization (π) for modeling cognitive feedback loops.
idea_ch: 一种基于迭代更新规则X_{t+1} = π(F(f(X_t)))的反馈驱动认知状态演化方法，将上下文依赖解释建模为通向稳定语义类别的轨迹
一种认知过程的范畴组合结构，通过变换、观察和稳定映射实现组合语义的形式化分析
一种语义等价强制机制π，通过不动点与收缩条件确保认知状态转换收敛到不变解释
一种集成内部变换f、解释映射F和语义稳定化π的统一动力系统框架，用于建模认知反馈回路

title: Spacetime Formation under Requirements: Contextual Realization and Form-Dependent Probability
summary:
Quantum cognition often explains order effects, contextuality, and violations of the law of total probability by replacing classical probability with quantum probability on a fixed event structure. This paper proposes a different interpretation: quantum probability is the fixed-spacetime projection of contextual spacetime formation under finite-state requirements.
  The framework begins not with time, space, objects, or probabilities, but with requirements such as finite representational capacity, single-state semantic stability, context-sensitive intervention, avoidance of explicit context labels, coherent world-formation, and intersubjective transformability. When these requirements cannot be realized within a single global Boolean event structure, the mismatch appears, under fixed-spacetime projection, as noncommutativity, interference, and quantum-like probability.
  Building on prior single-state approaches to contextuality, we reinterpret classical contextual bookkeeping cost as the fixed-spacetime shadow of contextual spacetime formation. Auxiliary memory or context labels in a classical representation correspond, in this account, to holonomy-like mismatch among locally Boolean logic-worlds. The interference term is the cross term generated when locally classical realization contributions are nontrivially glued and projected back into a fixed classical spacetime form.
  The result is a transcendental-operational realist account: objecthood, eventhood, probability, and spacetime are treated as forms of realization under requirements, while objectivity is defined by invariants preserved across observer- and history-dependent spacetime formations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出量子概率并非基础性的，而是有限制条件（如有限表征容量、单状态语义稳定性等）下，语境性时空形成在固定时空投影下的表现。量子概率的干涉项、非对易性等特征，源于局部布尔逻辑世界之间的整体性不匹配在固定经典时空中的投影。
AI.motivation: 现有量子认知研究用量子概率替代经典概率来解释顺序效应、语境性等问题，但仍在固定事件结构上运作。本文试图提供一种更根本的解释：量子概率不是概率论的替换，而是有限制条件下时空形成在固定时空投影中的表现。
AI.method: 从基本要求（有限表征容量、单状态语义稳定性、上下文敏感干预、避免显式上下文标签、连贯世界形成、主体间可转换性）出发，论证这些要求在固定布尔事件结构下无法实现时，投影到固定时空会表现为非对易性、干涉和类量子概率。通过将经典上下文记账成本重新解释为语境时空形成的固定时空阴影，干涉项被理解为局部经典实现贡献在非平凡胶合后投影回固定时空形式的交叉项。
AI.result: 提出了一个超越性的操作实在论框架：对象性、事件性、概率和时空均被视为要求下的实现形式，客观性由跨观察者和历史依赖的时空形成中不变的不变量定义。量子概率的异常特征被解释为限制条件导致的时空形成不匹配的投影现象。
AI.conclusion: 量子认知中的概率异常不是由于概率论本身的替换，而是由于有限制条件下语境时空形成与固定时空投影之间的结构性不匹配。这提供了一个新的视角来理解量子认知中的语境性和顺序效应。
idea_en: A method for modeling cognitive contextuality by representing contextual spacetime formation under finite-state requirements, then projecting onto a fixed classical spacetime structure to generate quantum-like interference patterns without assuming quantum probability as fundamental.

A system for detecting and quantifying representational capacity mismatch by measuring the holonomy-like deviation between locally Boolean logic-worlds when projected onto a fixed spacetime coordinate system.

A technique for eliminating explicit context labels in cognitive models by encoding context through the geometric mismatch between local classical realizations and their non-trivial gluing into a global structure.

A framework for defining cognitive objectivity as invariants preserved across observer-dependent and history-dependent spacetime formations, enabling intersubjective validation without requiring a universal Boolean event structure.

A computational method for generating interference terms in cognitive probability calculations by computing cross terms from locally classical contributions that are nontrivially glued and projected back into a fixed classical spacetime form.
idea_ch: 一种通过在有穷状态要求下表示语境时空形成，然后投影到固定经典时空结构来生成类量子干涉模式的认知语境性建模方法，无需将量子概率视为基础性假设。
一种通过测量局部布尔逻辑世界投影到固定时空坐标系时的和乐型偏差来检测和量化表征容量不匹配的系统。
一种在认知模型中消除显式上下文标签的技术，通过将局部经典实现及其非平凡胶合到全局结构时的几何不匹配作为上下文的编码方式。
一种将认知客观性定义为跨观察者依赖和历史依赖的时空形成中不变量的框架，实现无需通用布尔事件结构的主体间验证。
一种通过计算非平凡胶合后投影回固定经典时空形式的局部经典贡献的交叉项，在认知概率计算中生成干涉项的计算方法。

title: Right-Sizing Communication and Recommendation Set Size in AI-Assisted Search
summary:
We model the interaction between a user and an AI driven recommendation system. The user initiates the process by conveying preference information through a costly and noisy message. The AI assistant, acting as a Bayesian agent, interprets the user's message to form a posterior belief about their true preferences and make product recommendations. In particular, it determines how many recommendations to present so as to maximize the user's expected utility from their final choice, while accounting for the search cost induced by the size of the recommendation set. We use mutual information based cost functions to model the two distinct costs incurred by the user during the interaction: (i) a communication cost, which increases with the precision of their preference message, and (ii) a search cost, which increases with the size of the recommendation set provided by the AI assistant.
  We study products and preferences which live in d dimensional space, and ask how the user's expected payoff can be maximized. For large d, we characterize how optimal message precision and recommendation set size depend on the cost parameters, under two distinct distributions from which recommendations can be sampled from the product universe: (i) Bayes' posterior belief, and (ii) an optimized tilted distribution. Under the posterior sampling scheme (i), we identify a hybrid regime, in which an efficient interaction policy requires jointly optimizing the amount of information (in bits) conveyed by the user and the number of recommendations provided by the AI assistant. In the tilted sampling scheme (ii), our results show that the optimal interaction policy uses only one of communication and search, favoring whichever of them is less costly.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个AI推荐系统与用户交互的数学模型，分析用户在发送偏好信息（有成本且含噪声）与AI给出推荐列表（用户需承担搜索成本）之间的权衡。在高维空间中，研究了两种推荐采样策略（后验采样与倾斜采样）下，如何优化信息传递精度和推荐集大小以最大化用户期望收益。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统多关注推荐算法本身，忽视了用户在"表达偏好"和"浏览推荐结果"两个环节中承担的成本。本文旨在从经济学角度建模用户-推荐系统交互中的沟通成本与搜索成本，探索最优交互策略。
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯框架，将用户偏好建模为d维空间中的向量。用户发出带噪声的消息，AI作为贝叶斯智能体更新后验信念。采用基于互信息的成本函数分别建模沟通成本（消息精度越高成本越高）和搜索成本（推荐集越大成本越高）。研究了两种采样策略：后验采样和优化倾斜采样。
AI.result: 在后验采样策略下，存在一种"混合机制"，需要同时优化用户传达的信息量（比特数）和推荐列表数量。在倾斜采样策略下，最优策略只使用沟通或搜索中的一种，选择成本更低的那种。
AI.conclusion: 推荐系统的交互策略设计需要权衡用户的沟通成本与搜索成本，不同推荐采样策略会导致截然不同的最优交互方案。
idea_en: A recommendation system and method based on mutual information cost optimization, characterized by modeling both user communication cost and search cost using mutual information, and jointly optimizing the precision of user preference expression and the number of AI recommendations to maximize expected user utility.

A tilted sampling-based recommendation method that, under high-dimensional preference spaces, selects an optimal interaction strategy between communication and search paths based on cost parameter comparison, selecting only the lower-cost path.

A hybrid regime interaction policy for Bayesian recommendation systems, where the system simultaneously determines the optimal number of information bits for user preference expression and the optimal size of the recommendation set under a posterior sampling scheme.

A method for dynamically adjusting the granularity of user preference input and recommendation list size based on cost parameters in high-dimensional product spaces, applicable to AI-driven e-commerce or content recommendation platforms.
idea_ch: 一种基于互信息成本优化的推荐系统与方法，其特征在于使用互信息分别建模用户沟通成本与搜索成本，联合优化用户偏好表达精度与AI推荐数量以最大化用户期望效用。
一种倾斜采样推荐方法，在高维偏好空间下，根据成本参数比较在沟通路径与搜索路径之间选择最优交互策略，仅选择成本更低的单一路径。
一种贝叶斯推荐系统的混合机制交互策略，在后验采样方案下，系统同时确定用户偏好表达的最优信息比特数和AI推荐集的最优数量。
一种基于成本参数动态调节用户偏好输入粒度与推荐列表大小的方法，适用于AI驱动的电商或内容推荐平台。

title: Accelerating Long-Tail Generation in Synchronous RLHF Training via Adaptive Tensor Parallelism
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has become a key post-training paradigm for improving model quality. However, the synchronous three-stage RLHF pipeline is often bottlenecked by the generation stage, where response-length skew causes the effective batch size to shrink rapidly during decoding, leaving GPUs underutilized while a few long responses remain unfinished. Mainstream frameworks employ a static tensor parallelism (TP) configuration that cannot adapt to changing batch characteristics, leaving substantial performance headroom unexplored. We propose PAT, an adaptive TP method that dynamically reconfigures TP during the generation stage of each RLHF iteration. PAT introduces two key techniques. First, a predictor-guided online reconfiguration method decides both the reconfiguration point and the target TP configuration based on offline profiling, triggering reconfiguration only when the predicted latency benefit outweighs the reconfiguration overhead. Second, a lightweight online reconfiguration mechanism updates only the states and layouts affected by TP changes: it adapts unfinished decoding states through a cost-model-based choice between KV-cache migration and recomputation, performs in-place weight resharding, and reuses cached communication groups. We implement PAT on top of SGLang and integrate it with the VeRL framework. Evaluations on LLaMA3.1-8B and Qwen3-14B using DeepScaleR show that PAT reduces generation latency by up to 34.6% and end-to-end RLHF training iteration latency by up to 27.2% compared to the original VeRL setup.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAT，一种在RLHF生成阶段动态调整张量并行度（TP）的自适应方法，通过预测引导的在线重配置和轻量级状态迁移机制，有效解决长响应导致的GPU利用不均衡问题，最高可减少34.6%生成延迟和27.2%端到端训练迭代延迟。
AI.motivation: 同步三阶段RLHF流程中，生成阶段因响应长度差异导致有效batch size急剧缩减，GPU在等待少数长响应完成时处于低利用率状态，而现有静态TP配置无法适应这种动态变化的batch特征。
AI.method: 1）预测引导的在线重配置方法：基于离线性能分析，在重配置收益大于开销时触发TP调整；2）轻量级在线重配置机制：通过基于成本模型的KV-cache迁移/重计算选择、原地权重重分片、通信组缓存复用等，仅更新受TP变化影响的状态和布局。
AI.result: 基于SGLang和VeRL框架，在LLaMA3.1-8B和Qwen3-14B上的DeepScaleR评估显示，生成延迟降低34.6%，端到端RLHF训练迭代延迟降低27.2%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应动态TP重配置能有效缓解RLHF生成阶段的资源瓶颈，且轻量级状态迁移机制可实现高效在线调整。
idea_en: Predictor-guided online TP reconfiguration method that dynamically decides when and how to adjust tensor parallelism based on offline profiling and predicted latency benefits.
Cost-model-based KV-cache migration vs. recomputation selection mechanism for adapting unfinished decoding states during TP reconfiguration.
In-place weight resharding technique that avoids full model redistribution when changing tensor parallelism configuration.
Cached communication group reuse mechanism that eliminates overhead of re-establishing communication groups after TP reconfiguration.
Adaptive batch-aware TP switching that triggers reconfiguration only when the predicted latency benefit outweighs the reconfiguration overhead.
idea_ch: 预测引导的在线TP重配置方法：基于离线性能分析预测延迟收益，在收益大于开销时才触发TP动态调整，避免无效重配置。
基于成本模型的KV-cache迁移/重计算选择机制：在TP变化时，通过成本模型智能选择迁移或重计算未完成的解码状态，最小化状态迁移开销。
原地权重重分片技术：改变张量并行度时无需重新分发完整模型，仅对权重进行原地重分片，极大降低重配置开销。
通信组缓存复用机制：TP重配置后复用已缓存的通信组，避免重新建立通信组的额外开销。
自适应batch特征感知的TP切换方法：根据生成阶段中剩余未完成响应的变化特征，动态调整并行度以最大化GPU利用率。

title: Stop Comparing LLM Agents Without Disclosing the Harness
summary: This position paper argues that, for long-horizon tasks evaluated across models with comparable frontier capability, the agent execution harness, namely the infrastructure layer that governs context construction, tool interaction, orchestration, and verification around a language model, is often a stronger determinant of agent performance than the model it wraps. We formalize and defend the Binding Constraint Thesis: in this regime, performance variance is governed more by harness configuration than by model choice, and current evaluation protocols therefore systematically misattribute harness-level gains to model improvements. We support this thesis along three lines. First, a control-theoretic formalization treats the harness as the controller of a closed-loop dynamical system and the LLM as the stochastic policy it governs, which explains why small harness changes can produce performance shifts that exceed those obtained by substituting one model for another. Second, published benchmarks, industry deployments, and a controlled variance decomposition show that harness-induced variance can substantially exceed model-induced variance, including cases of model ranking reversal. Third, we propose a harness-aware evaluation framework with a disclosure standard and a variance decomposition protocol. Until harness specifications are disclosed, leaderboard comparisons for long-horizon agents should be treated as incomplete and potentially misleading.

AI.tldr: 本文论证在长时域任务中，代理执行框架（harness）对性能的影响往往超过底层语言模型本身，并提出"绑定约束论题"，认为当前评估协议系统性地将框架层面的增益错误归因于模型改进。
AI.motivation: 针对长时域任务中，不同前沿能力模型的代理性能评估存在系统性偏差：现有评估体系未区分性能提升是来自模型改进还是执行框架优化，导致对模型能力的错误归因。
AI.method: 通过三条论证线索支持论点：1) 控制理论形式化，将框架视为闭环动力系统的控制器，LLM为受控随机策略；2) 基于已发表基准、行业部署和受控方差分解的实验证据；3) 提出框架感知的评估框架，包含披露标准和方差分解协议。
AI.result: 发现框架诱导的方差可显著超过模型诱导的方差，包括出现模型排名反转的情况。
AI.conclusion: 在框架规范被充分披露之前，长时域代理的排行榜比较应被视为不完整且可能具有误导性。
idea_en: A harness-aware evaluation framework with disclosure standards for agent execution infrastructure components, including context construction, tool interaction, orchestration, and verification protocols.
A variance decomposition protocol that systematically separates harness-induced performance variance from model-induced variance in long-horizon agent tasks.

A control-theoretic formalization method treating the agent execution harness as a controller in a closed-loop dynamical system with LLM as the stochastic policy, enabling systematic harness optimization.
A standardized disclosure format for agent harness specifications to enable fair model comparison across different evaluation setups.
Method for detecting model ranking reversal caused by harness configuration changes, providing corrected rankings based on harness-aware evaluation.
idea_ch: 一种具有披露标准的框架感知评估框架，用于代理执行基础设施组件（包括上下文构建、工具交互、编排和验证协议）的标准化披露。
一种方差分解协议，系统地将长时域代理任务中框架诱导的性能方差与模型诱导的方差分离。
一种控制理论形式化方法，将代理执行框架视为闭环动力系统的控制器，LLM作为随机策略，实现框架的系统性优化。
一种代理框架规范的标准化披露格式，确保不同评估设置下的公平模型比较。
一种检测由框架配置变化引起的模型排名反转的方法，基于框架感知评估提供修正后的排名。

title: Methods for Formal Verification of Agent Skills: Three Layers Toward a Mechanically Checkable Capability-Containment Proof
summary:
The companion paper introduced a four-level verification lattice on agent-skill manifests (unverified, declared, tested, formal) and left the top level aspirational. This
  paper closes that gap. We give a precise semantics for skill behaviour faithful to how a skill is consumed by an LLM-driven runtime (a deterministic script-side reachable
  through a non-deterministic LLM-side), state the verification problem as a capability-containment property over that semantics, and present three composable methods that
  together raise a skill from declared or tested to formal: (1) sound static capability-containment analysis of the script-side via abstract interpretation over a small effect
  lattice; (2) a refinement type system for tool-call envelopes that mechanically rejects any call whose statically-inferred capability is not in the manifest's declared set;
  (3) SMT-bounded model checking against the parent paper's biconditional correctness criterion, with the bound chosen so any counter-example fitting the runtime's
  transaction-buffer horizon is exhibited as a concrete trace. We prove the three layers composed soundly cover the parent paper's threat model modulo a single residual (the
  LLM's freedom to refuse to act) that the parent paper's runtime biconditional catches at session boundary. The methods reuse existing well-engineered tools (Z3, Semgrep,
  CodeQL, refinement-type checkers, mechanised proof assistants) rather than asking operators to build new ones, and the proof-carrying artifact extends the existing SKILL.md
  convention. All three methods plus the bundle producer and re-checker ship as zero-dependency JavaScript modules in the open-source enclawed framework
  (https://github.com/metereconsulting/enclawed; project page https://www.enclawed.com/), with 53 unit tests and an end-to-end CLI demo on a sample skill.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套三层可组合的形式化验证方法，将智能体技能清单从"已声明/已测试"提升至"形式化验证"级别，通过抽象解释、细化类型系统和SMT有界模型检测，实现了对LLM驱动运行时技能行为的精确语义验证，并开源实现了零依赖JavaScript工具链。
AI.motivation: 上一篇论文提出了四层验证格(未验证、已声明、已测试、形式化)，但顶层形式化验证只是愿景。本文旨在填补这一空白，为技能行为提供精确语义，并实现从声明/测试到形式化验证的自动升级。
AI.method: (1) 基于抽象解释的脚本端静态能力包含分析；(2) 工具调用封装的细化类型系统，自动拒绝静态推断能力超出清单声明集的调用；(3) 针对双条件正确性准则的SMT有界模型检测，边界由运行时事务缓冲区范围决定。三层方法组合使用现有成熟工具(Z3、Semgrep、CodeQL等)，以零依赖JavaScript模块形式实现。
AI.result: 证明了三个验证层组合后完整覆盖了上一篇论文的威胁模型，仅剩一个残余(LLM拒绝行动的自主权)，该残余由运行时双条件机制在会话边界捕获。工具链包含53个单元测试和端到端CLI演示。
AI.conclusion: 成功将形式化验证从愿景变为现实，通过组合现有工具实现了可落地的技能行为形式化验证方案，并以开源框架形式发布。
idea_en: A three-layer composable formal verification method for LLM agent skill manifests, comprising static capability-containment analysis via abstract interpretation, a refinement type system for tool-call envelope rejection, and SMT-bounded model checking against biconditional correctness criteria.
A proof-carrying artifact extending the SKILL.md convention that bundles formal verification proofs alongside skill manifests for verifiable LLM agent behavior.
A deterministic script-side reachable through non-deterministic LLM-side semantics for modeling skill behavior faithful to LLM-driven runtime consumption.
Capability-containment verification as a property over skill semantics, using abstract interpretation over a small effect lattice for sound static analysis.
A refinement type system for tool-call envelopes that mechanically rejects calls whose statically-inferred capability exceeds the declared set in the manifest.
SMT-bounded model checking with transaction-buffer horizon bound selection, ensuring any counter-example fitting the runtime's buffer is exhibited as a concrete trace.
Zero-dependency JavaScript modular implementation of formal verification toolchain for LLM agent skills, enabling easy integration into existing workflows.
idea_ch: 一种用于LLM智能体技能清单的三层可组合形式化验证方法，包括基于抽象解释的静态能力包含分析、工具调用封装的细化类型系统拒绝机制，以及针对双条件正确性准则的SMT有界模型检测。
一种扩展SKILL.md约定的证明携带工件，将形式化验证证明与技能清单捆绑在一起，实现可验证的LLM智能体行为。
一种通过非确定性LLM端可达的确定性脚本端语义模型，忠实于LLM驱动运行时对技能行为的消费方式。
将能力包含验证建模为技能语义上的属性，使用小效应格上的抽象解释进行可靠的静态分析。
一种工具调用封装的细化类型系统，自动拒绝静态推断能力超出清单声明集的调用。
基于事务缓冲区范围选择边界的SMT有界模型检测，确保任何符合运行时缓冲区大小的反例都以具体轨迹形式展示。
零依赖JavaScript模块化实现的LLM智能体技能形式化验证工具链，便于集成到现有工作流中。

title: Machine Psychometrics: A Mathematical Psychology of Artificial Intelligence
summary: Artificial agents now generate behavior rich enough to invite trust, surprise, and concern, yet our evaluation tools still privilege capability scores over psychological structure. This paper argues that the philosophical impasse between two symmetrical errors (Artificial Mind Blindness, which dismisses psychological organization in non-biological systems, and Artificial Mind Projection, which infers human-like inner life from fluent behavior alone) can be circumvented not by resolving the consciousness question, but by introducing a disciplined measurement layer beneath it. Drawing on Michael Levin's continuum view of cognition as goal-directed competency across substrates, and on the methodological repertoire of mathematical psychology (Item Response Theory, Signal Detection Theory, Bayesian cognitive modeling, calibration analysis, cognitive-bias batteries), the paper develops Machine Psychometrics as a measurement science of latent behavioral, metacognitive, communicative, and self-modeling dispositions in artificial agents. Its operational core is the Machine Mindprint: a multidimensional, domain-bounded, versioned profile spanning calibration, source integrity, suggestibility resistance, context stability, expressive alignment, tool integrity, drift monitoring, and distributional grounding. A complementary Trust Protocol turns Mindprints into deployment decisions through probe batteries, perturbation testing, reliability and validity analysis, and longitudinal monitoring across high-stakes domains. The philosophical contribution is a third stance, Artificial Mind Discipline, that neither anthropomorphizes nor dismisses, neither presupposes consciousness nor forecloses it. The aim is not to humanize artificial agents, but to understand them precisely because they are not human, through measurement before judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"机器心理测量学"(Machine Psychometrics)，建立一套测量人工智能体潜在心理特质的科学框架，核心是"机器心智印"(Machine Mindprint)——一种多维度的行为、元认知、沟通和自我建模倾向的量化档案，并配套"信任协议"(Trust Protocol)指导AI系统部署决策。
AI.motivation: 当前AI评估过度关注能力分数而忽视心理结构，存在两个对称性错误：人工心智盲视(忽视非生物系统中的心理组织)和人工心智投射(从流畅行为推断类人内心生活)。需要引入介于两者之间的测量层。
AI.method: 基于Michael Levin的认知连续体观和数学心理学工具(项目反应理论、信号检测理论、贝叶斯认知建模、校准分析、认知偏差测试组)，开发多维机器心智印，涵盖校准、来源完整性、抗暗示性、上下文稳定性、表达对齐、工具完整性、漂移监测和分布基础等维度。配套信任协议包含探针测试组、扰动测试、信效度分析和纵向监测。
AI.result: 提出了一种可操作的测量框架"机器心智印"和"信任协议"，将部署决策建立在系统的测量基础之上。
AI.conclusion: 提出了第三种立场"人工心智纪律"(Artificial Mind Discipline)，既不拟人化也不否认，既不断言意识也不排除意识，目标不是将AI人性化，而是理解它们的独特性——通过测量而非先入为主的判断。
idea_en: A Machine Mindprint system that generates multidimensional behavioral and cognitive profiles for AI agents, including dimensions of calibration, source integrity, suggestibility resistance, context stability, expressive alignment, tool integrity, drift monitoring, and distributional grounding
A Trust Protocol for AI deployment decisions that integrates probe batteries, perturbation testing, reliability and validity analysis, and longitudinal monitoring across high-stakes domains
A method for measuring latent cognitive dispositions in artificial agents using Item Response Theory and Signal Detection Theory adapted from mathematical psychology
A cognitive bias battery system specifically designed to detect and measure cognitive biases in AI agents rather than humans
A calibration analysis framework that assesses the gap between AI agents' confidence and their actual performance accuracy
idea_ch: 机器心智印系统：为AI智能体生成多维行为和认知特征档案，涵盖校准度、来源完整性、抗暗示性、上下文稳定性、表达对齐、工具完整性、漂移监测和分布基础等维度
信任协议：一套AI部署决策系统，整合探针测试组、扰动测试、信效度分析和纵向监测，适用于高风险领域
基于项目反应理论和信号检测理论的AI潜在认知倾向测量方法，改编自数学心理学
专为AI智能体设计的认知偏差测试系统，用于检测和量化AI中的认知偏差而非人类偏差
校准分析框架：评估AI智能体的置信度与实际表现准确性之间的差距

title: From Accuracy to Auditability: A Survey of Determinism in Financial AI Systems
summary: Deploying machine learning in regulated financial environments -- credit risk, fraud detection, and anti-money laundering -- exposes critical vulnerabilities in algorithmic reproducibility. While early financial ML addressed statistical challenges such as backtest overfitting, deep neural networks and Generative AI have introduced mechanical nondeterminism rooted in hardware and architecture. This survey provides a systems perspective on reproducibility failures across three modalities now dominant in financial AI: tabular models (post-hoc explanation variance), graph networks (stochastic sampling and temporal asynchrony), and LLM-based agentic workflows (batch-dependent divergence and trajectory drift). We supplement the literature analysis with first-party experiments on public financial datasets -- quantifying explanation rank instability in credit scoring, prediction flip rates in GNN-based fraud detection, and tensor-parallel-induced output divergence in LLM entity extraction. We propose a layered evaluation framework linking modality-specific metrics (RBO, D_cos, TDI, PSD) to audit readiness, and empirically validate the complementarity of logit-level and semantic-level determinism measures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统调查了金融AI中三类模型（表格模型、图神经网络、LLM智能体工作流）的不可重现性问题，并通过实验量化了硬件与架构导致的机械非确定性，提出了分层评估框架。
AI.motivation: 在受监管的金融环境中，机器学习模型（信用风险、欺诈检测、反洗钱）面临算法可重现性挑战。传统统计过拟合问题已被关注，但深度神经网络和生成式AI引入的硬件与架构层面的机械非确定性尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 1）文献调查三类金融AI模型的可重现性失效模式；2）在公开金融数据集上进行第一手实验，量化解释排名不稳定性、预测翻转率和张量并行导致的输出发散；3）提出分层评估框架，将模态特定指标（RBO, D_cos, TDI, PSD）与审计就绪度关联。
AI.result: 实验证实了信用评分解释排名不稳定、GNN欺诈检测预测翻转率、LLM实体提取中张量并行导致的输出发散等具体问题；验证了logit级与语义级确定性度量之间的互补性。
AI.conclusion: 金融监管环境需要针对模态特定的非确定性建立量化评估与审计框架，以确保AI系统的可重现性和合规性。
idea_en: A layered evaluation framework for auditing machine learning determinism in regulated financial environments, linking modality-specific metrics (RBO, D_cos, TDI, PSD) to audit readiness levels.
A method for quantifying explanation rank instability in tabular credit scoring models using Rank-Biased Overlap (RBO) as a reproducibility metric.
A technique for measuring prediction flip rates in Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based fraud detection systems due to stochastic sampling and temporal asynchrony.
A system for detecting and mitigating tensor-parallel-induced output divergence in LLM-based entity extraction for financial document processing.
A complementary determinism measurement approach combining logit-level (numerical) and semantic-level (embedding-based) divergence metrics for LLM agentic workflows in finance.
A modality-specific auditing protocol for financial AI systems that maps reproducibility metrics to regulatory compliance requirements.
idea_ch: 一种用于受监管金融环境中审计机器学习确定性的分层评估框架，将模态特定指标（RBO、D_cos、TDI、PSD）映射到审计就绪度等级。
一种利用排名偏态重叠（RBO）作为可重现性度量指标，量化表格信用评分模型中解释排名不稳定性的方法。
一种测量基于图神经网络（GNN）的欺诈检测系统中因随机采样和时间异步性导致的预测翻转率的技术。
一种用于检测和缓解LLM金融实体提取中张量并行引起的输出发散的系统。
一种结合logit级（数值型）和语义级（嵌入型）发散度量的互补性确定性测量方法，适用于金融领域的LLM智能体工作流。
一种面向金融AI系统的模态特定审计协议，将可重现性指标映射到监管合规要求。

title: QUIVER: A Formal Framework for Quantifying Perturbation Propagation and Bifurcation in Compound AI Systems
summary: Compound AI systems that chain multiple LLM calls into directed computation graphs are now the dominant architecture for production AI. Although these architectures leverage heterogeneous nodes with mixed-mode outputs, no existing framework quantifies how perturbations propagate through such pipelines, where nodes are stochastic and execution paths can diverge structurally. We introduce QUIVER, a formal framework for measuring perturbation propagation in graph-structured LLM pipelines. The framework defines: (1) a sensitivity matrix with type-dispatched distance metrics that classifies edges as amplifiers, absorbers, or threshold-sensitive, complemented by occurrence-lift; (2) trajectory divergence decomposing variation into value drift, structural path divergence, and iteration count divergence; (3) bifurcation thresholds identifying the smallest perturbation that causes structural execution path changes; and (4) distribution faithfulness, quantifying when per node evaluation datasets diverge from production distributions. We validate on two production enterprise pipelines and a public DSPy multihop QA pipeline, three structurally distinct architectures. Across 8,200+ instrumented traces (32,000+ pair comparisons), we demonstrate that QUIVER reveals distinct sensitivity profiles across architectures, distinguishes mechanistically different cascade patterns producing identical divergence rates, predicts nodes prone to trajectory bifurcation from observational data alone, and localizes stale evaluation artifacts to specific node-field categories that aggregate metrics cannot surface.

AI.tldr: QUIVER是一个形式化框架，用于量化图结构LLM管道中扰动的传播，通过敏感度矩阵、轨迹散度、分岔阈值和分布忠实度四个维度分析混合节点和结构路径变化。
AI.motivation: 现有工作缺乏量化扰动如何在结构可变的随机节点管道中传播的框架，而生产级AI系统普遍采用多LLM调用的复合计算图架构，需要理解扰动如何影响系统行为。
AI.method: 定义了四个核心组件：(1)敏感度矩阵，包含类型分派距离度量和occurrence-lift；(2)轨迹散度，分解为值漂移、结构路径散度和迭代计数散度；(3)分岔阈值，识别导致路径变化的最小扰动；(4)分布忠实度，量化评估数据集与生产分布的偏离程度。
AI.result: 在8200+条仪器化轨迹（32000+对比较）上验证，揭示不同架构的敏感度特征，区分产生相同散度率的因果级联模式，从观测数据预测轨迹分岔节点，定位评估伪影到特定节点-字段类别。
AI.conclusion: QUIVER能够揭示聚合指标无法发现的细粒度扰动传播模式，为复合AI系统的鲁棒性分析和调试提供了有效工具。
idea_en: A perturbation propagation measurement framework for graph-structured LLM pipelines with type-dispatched distance metrics that classifies edges as amplifiers, absorbers, or threshold-sensitive using occurrence-lift.
A trajectory divergence decomposition method that quantifies variation into three orthogonal components: value drift, structural path divergence, and iteration count divergence.
A bifurcation threshold mechanism that identifies the minimal perturbation causing structural execution path changes in stochastic LLM computation graphs.
A distribution faithfulness metric for quantifying when per-node evaluation datasets diverge from production distributions in compound AI systems.
A sensitivity matrix approach that captures how perturbations propagate through heterogeneous nodes with mixed-mode outputs in directed computation graphs.
idea_ch: 用于图结构LLM管道的扰动传播测量框架，采用类型分派距离度量，通过occurrence-lift将边分类为放大器、吸收器或阈值敏感型。
轨迹散度分解方法，将变异量化分解为三个正交分量：值漂移、结构路径散度和迭代计数散度。
分岔阈值机制，识别导致随机LLM计算图中结构执行路径变化的最小扰动。
分布忠实度度量，用于量化复合AI系统中每个节点评估数据集与生产分布之间的偏离程度。
敏感度矩阵方法，捕捉扰动如何通过具有混合模式输出的异质节点在有向计算图中传播。

title: Low-Cost Labels, Reliable Choices: Rollout-Calibrated Hyper-Heuristics for Job Shop Scheduling
summary: Learning-assisted hyper-heuristics can select among dispatching rules while preserving the feasibility and interpretability of constructive Job Shop Scheduling Problem (JSSP) heuristics. Their main computational cost lies in label generation rather than model fitting, since each supervised label usually requires rolling out candidate rules from a partial schedule. We study this label-cost problem together with a reliability problem: a learned selector should not switch away from a strong default rule unless the predicted gain is credible. The proposed selector uses regret-normalized rollout labels, a contextual KNN uncertainty estimate, and a gate that acts only when the predicted improvement exceeds an uncertainty-adjusted margin. We also vary rollout depth and breadth to measure the cost-quality trade-off. On synthetic JSSP instances, the gated selector achieves the lowest mean RPD among learned selectors, remains close to the best fixed dispatching rule, and reduces Random-HH mean RPD by more than an order of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于遗憾归一化Rollout标签、上下文KNN不确定性估计和门控机制的监督学习方法，用于作业车间调度问题中的超启发式选择，在保持可解释性的同时显著降低了计算成本，并将随机超启发式的平均相对百分比偏差降低了一个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 解决学习辅助超启发式在JSSP中的两个核心问题：(1) 标签生成计算成本高昂（每个标签需要对候选规则进行完整rollout）；(2) 学习选择器的可靠性问题，即不应轻易偏离强默认规则，除非预测收益可信。
