AI.method: (1) 使用遗憾归一化（regret-normalized）rollout标签；(2) 采用上下文KNN（contextual KNN）进行不确定性估计；(3) 引入门控机制（gate），仅在预测改进超过不确定性调整后的阈值时才切换规则；(4) 变化rollout深度和广度以权衡计算成本与质量。
AI.result: 在合成JSSP实例上，门控选择器在所有学习型选择器中实现了最低的平均RPD，接近最佳固定调度规则，并将Random-HH的平均RPD降低了一个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性感知的门控机制，可以在保持高可靠性的同时显著降低超启发式学习的计算开销，为JSSP的实际应用提供了可行的方案。
idea_en: Regret-normalized rollout labels for supervised learning of dispatching rule selection in JSSP, which provides better training signal than raw rollout costs.
Contextual KNN-based uncertainty estimation method for predicting the reliability of dispatching rule performance in scheduling problems.
Uncertainty-adjusted gating mechanism that switches dispatching rules only when predicted improvement exceeds an uncertainty margin, ensuring reliability.
Variable-depth and variable-breadth rollout strategy for cost-quality trade-off in label generation for scheduling hyper-heuristics.
Gated hyper-heuristic selector achieving order-of-magnitude reduction in mean RPD compared to Random-HH while remaining competitive with best fixed rules.
idea_ch: 基于遗憾归一化的Rollout标签生成方法，用于JSSP调度规则选择的监督学习，相比原始rollout成本提供更优的训练信号
上下文KNN不确定性估计方法，用于预测调度规则在调度问题中的性能可靠性
不确定性调整的门控机制，仅在预测改进超过不确定性边界时才切换调度规则，确保可靠性
可变深度与可变广度的Rollout策略，在标签生成中实现计算成本与质量的有效权衡
门控超启发式选择器，将随机超启发式的平均RPD降低一个数量级以上，同时保持与最佳固定规则接近的性能

title: LGMT: Logic-Grounded Metamorphic Testing for Evaluating the Reasoning Reliability of LLMs
comment: Zheng Zheng is the corresponding author
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on logical reasoning benchmarks, yet their reliability remains uncertain. Existing evaluations rely on static benchmarks, which fail to assess robustness under logically equivalent transformations and often overestimate reasoning capability. We propose LGMT (Logic-Grounded Metamorphic Testing), an oracle-free framework that leverages first-order logic (FOL) to evaluate LLM reasoning. By deriving metamorphic relations from formal logical equivalences, LGMT constructs semantically invariant test cases and detects reasoning defects through cross-case consistency checking. Experiments on six state-of-the-art LLMs show that LGMT exposes substantial hidden defects missed by traditional reference-based evaluations. We further find that models are particularly sensitive to symbol-level and conclusion-level variations, and that advanced prompting such as Few-shot CoT only partially mitigates these issues. These results suggest that LLM evaluation should move beyond isolated correctness toward robustness under logical invariance. LGMT provides a principled and scalable approach for diagnosing reasoning failures.

AI.tldr: 提出LGMT框架，利用一阶逻辑的变体关系对LLM的推理鲁棒性进行无偏测试，发现模型在逻辑等价变换下存在严重缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有静态基准测试无法评估LLM在逻辑等价变换下的鲁棒性，往往高估其推理能力，需要更可靠的评估方法。
AI.method: 基于一阶逻辑推导变体关系，构建语义不变但句法/结构变化的测试用例，通过跨用例一致性检查检测推理缺陷，无需人工标注参考答案。
AI.result: 在6个SOTA LLM上，LGMT暴露了大量传统评测无法发现的隐含缺陷；模型对符号级和结论级变化尤为敏感；Few-shot CoT等高级提示方法仅能部分缓解问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM评估应从单点正确性转向逻辑不变性下的鲁棒性评估，LGMT提供了可扩展的推理缺陷诊断方案。
idea_en: Logic-Grounded Metamorphic Testing (LGMT) framework using first-order logic (FOL) to generate semantically invariant test cases for evaluating LLM reasoning robustness
Method for deriving metamorphic relations from formal logical equivalences to detect reasoning defects via cross-case consistency checking without oracle
Systematic approach to measuring LLM sensitivity to symbol-level and conclusion-level logical variations
Oracle-free evaluation technique that exposes hidden reasoning defects missed by reference-based benchmarks
idea_ch: 基于一阶逻辑的变体测试框架(LGMT)，通过逻辑等价关系生成语义不变但形式变化的测试用例评估LLM推理鲁棒性
从形式逻辑等价性推导变体关系的方法，通过跨用例一致性检查检测推理缺陷，无需人工标注参考答案
系统性测量LLM对符号级变化和结论级变化敏感度的评估方法
无参考标准(Orcale-free)的推理缺陷检测技术，能发现传统参考答案评测无法捕捉的隐藏缺陷

title: Why We Need World Models for AGI: Where LLMs Fail and How World Models May Outperform
summary: Large language models achieve strong performance in language generation and knowledge-intensive tasks, yet remain limited in settings requiring causal reasoning, persistent state tracking, and long-horizon planning. We argue that these limitations may arise from an objective-level mismatch between sequence prediction and reasoning over latent environment dynamics. To formalize this distinction, we introduce Latent Dynamics Inference (LDI), a conceptual perspective that interprets language and multimodal observations as partial evidence of underlying transition dynamics. To empirically investigate this perspective, we introduce Flux, a sequential reasoning environment specified entirely through natural-language rules. As a proof-of-concept case study, the rules are first compiled into an explicit state-transition simulator, illustrating that structured latent transition dynamics can, in some cases, be operationally extracted from textual rule descriptions. This enables a controlled comparison between the LLMs operating purely over textual observations and reinforcement-learning agents trained directly within the extracted latent state space. Within this case study, agents operating with explicit access to the latent state space exhibit substantially more stable behavior in long-horizon gameplay, achieving an aggregate win rate of approximately 79% versus 11% for LLMs. Qualitative analysis further reveals failure modes consistent with unstable persistent state tracking, including invalid actions, state-tracking errors, and short-horizon reasoning failures. The complete implementation of the Flux environment available at https://github.com/FeisalAlaswad/FLUX-RL-Agent Within the evaluated setting, these results suggest that strong sequence prediction alone may struggle to support robust long-horizon dynamic reasoning without mechanisms for persistent state tracking and transition modeling

AI.tldr: 论文提出Latent Dynamics Inference (LDI)视角，认为大语言模型在因果推理、持久状态跟踪和长程规划上的局限源于序列预测与潜在环境动态推理之间的目标不匹配。通过构建Flux环境（纯自然语言规则描述的序贯推理环境），对比LLM（纯文本观测）与强化学习智能体（显式访问潜在状态空间），发现后者在长程游戏中胜率约79%，远高于前者的11%，表明强序列预测难以支持鲁棒的长期动态推理。
AI.motivation: 揭示LLM在因果推理、持久状态跟踪和长程规划任务中表现受限的根本原因，即序列预测目标与推理潜在环境动态之间的结构性不匹配。
AI.method: 提出Latent Dynamics Inference (LDI)概念框架；构建Flux环境（纯自然语言规则定义的序贯推理环境）；将规则编译为显式状态转移模拟器；对比LLM（纯文本观测）与强化学习智能体（访问显式潜在状态空间）的性能。
AI.result: 强化学习智能体在长程游戏中胜率约79%，LLM仅约11%；LLM表现出无效动作、状态跟踪错误和短视推理失败等模式。
AI.conclusion: 强序列预测能力不足以支撑鲁棒的长期动态推理，需要持久状态跟踪和转移建模机制。
idea_en: A method for extracting explicit state-transition simulators from natural-language rule descriptions, enabling operational access to latent state dynamics for reinforcement learning agents.
A systematic comparison framework between LLM-based sequence prediction agents and latent-state-access reinforcement learning agents in long-horizon gameplay environments.
A sequential reasoning environment (Flux) specified entirely through natural-language rules, designed to benchmark persistent state tracking and causal reasoning capabilities.
A technique for compiling textual rule descriptions into structured latent transition dynamics representations for controlled experimentation.
A diagnostic methodology for identifying failure modes in LLMs including invalid actions, state-tracking errors, and short-horizon reasoning failures in dynamic environments.
idea_ch: 一种从自然语言规则描述中提取显式状态转移模拟器的方法，使强化学习智能体能够操作性访问潜在状态动态。
一种在长程游戏环境中比较基于LLM的序列预测智能体与访问潜在状态空间的强化学习智能体的系统性对比框架。
一种完全通过自然语言规则定义的序贯推理环境（Flux），用于基准测试持久状态跟踪和因果推理能力。
一种将文本规则描述编译为结构化潜在状态转移表示以进行受控实验的技术。
一种用于识别LLM在动态环境中失效模式的诊断方法，包括无效动作、状态跟踪错误和短视推理失败。

title: Saturating Scaling Laws for Equational Discovery: A Phenomenology of Growth Dynamics in Three Toy Substrates with Two Real-World Replications
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables, 2 algorithms. Code and data at https://github.com/fabio-rovai/saturating-scaling-laws (currently private; will be made public on acceptance)
summary: We investigate growth dynamics in deterministic equational discovery substrates. Across three toy domains (arithmetic, boolean, higher-order list; n=592 trajectories), short-range substrate sizes fit a power-law N(t) proportional to t^b. Within each substrate b is architecture-sensitive (cross-validated R^2 approximately 0.82); the regression does not transfer across substrates (arith+bool to list yields R^2 approximately -0.84). A heuristic mean-field closure model predicts a saturating power-law dN/dt = K N^k exp(-mu N) of which the pure power-law is the short-range approximation. Three robustness checks: bootstrap intervals on (k, mu) are tight in 4/5 toy trajectories and degenerate in 1/5; out-of-sample forecasting on toy data (fit first 100 epochs, predict next 400) is won by pure power-law 5/5, indicating the toy trajectories do not reach saturation; on two real-world growth proxies the result splits. New Mathlib/*.lean file additions per month (mathlib4, 60 months, 9701 files) support the saturating form on OOS forecasting by approximately 7x over pure power-law; Coq mathcomp monthly commits (129 months, 3083 commits) favour pure power-law on both tests with mu collapsing to zero. The dynamics are substrate-conditional at two levels: within-substrate architecture-to-b regressions do not transfer, and the preferred functional family for N(t) itself (pure vs. saturating power-law) differs by substrate. We propose "saturating power-law growth with substrate-conditional (k, mu), observable when the substrate has reached its saturation regime" as a working framing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了确定性等式发现基质中的增长动力学，发现短程基质大小服从幂律分布，并提出了一个饱和幂律增长模型，该模型在数学库（Mathlib）和Coq证明助手的实际数据中表现出不同的适用性。
AI.motivation: 理解并建模不同数学发现基质（算术、布尔、高阶列表）中的增长动力学，探索增长规律是否具有跨基质的可迁移性。
AI.method: 对三个玩具域（n=592条轨迹）进行增长动力学分析，拟合幂律分布；构建平均场闭合模型预测饱和幂律；通过自举置信区间、样本外预测和两个真实世界增长代理（Mathlib文件增长、Coq提交量）进行验证。
AI.result: 短程基质大小符合幂律分布；回归在基质内有效（R²≈0.82）但跨基质失效（R²≈-0.84）；纯幂律在玩具数据上5/5胜出；Mathlib数据支持饱和形式（比纯幂律好约7倍），Coq数据偏好纯幂律。
AI.conclusion: 增长动力学具有基质条件性：不同基质具有不同的架构-回归关系，且增长函数族（纯幂律vs饱和幂律）的选择也依赖于基质。提出"饱和幂律增长+基质条件性(k, mu)"作为工作框架。
idea_en: A method for predicting growth dynamics in deterministic equational discovery substrates using a saturating power-law model dN/dt = K N^k exp(-mu N), where parameters k and mu are substrate-conditional and determined via regression on short-range trajectory data.

A cross-substrate transfer learning diagnostic technique for growth dynamics: evaluating whether architecture-to-b regressions trained on one substrate (e.g., arithmetic+boolean) can predict growth in another substrate (e.g., higher-order lists), with negative R² indicating non-transferability.

A mean-field closure model for heuristic prediction of saturating power-law growth in discovery systems, where the pure power-law serves as a short-range approximation and the full model captures saturation effects.

A substrate-conditional growth classification framework that automatically determines whether a given discovery system follows pure power-law growth or saturating power-law growth based on out-of-sample forecasting performance comparison.
A bootstrap-based robustness checking method for growth model parameters (k, mu) that identifies tight vs. degenerate parameter intervals to assess whether the system has reached saturation regime.
idea_ch: 一种基于饱和幂律模型dN/dt = K N^k exp(-mu N)预测确定性等式发现基质中增长动力学的方法，其中参数k和mu具有基质条件性，通过短程轨迹数据的回归确定。
一种跨基质增长动力学迁移学习诊断技术：评估在一个基质（如算术+布尔）上训练的架构-参数回归是否能够预测另一基质（如高阶列表）中的增长，使用负R²指示不可迁移性。
一种用于发现系统中饱和幂律增长启发式预测的平均场闭合模型，其中纯幂律作为短程近似，完整模型捕获饱和效应。
一种基质条件性增长分类框架，通过比较样本外预测性能，自动确定给定发现系统是遵循纯幂律增长还是饱和幂律增长。
一种基于自举法的增长模型参数（k, mu）鲁棒性检查方法，通过识别紧致vs退化的参数区间来评估系统是否已到达饱和状态。

title: Beyond Predefined Learning Objects: A Thinking-Learning Interaction Model for Up-to-Date Autonomous Robot Learning
summary: Autonomous robots operating in open and changing environments cannot always rely on predefined inputs, outputs, and action routines. Although existing learning methods enable robots to improve their performance through environmental interaction, the objects of learning are often fixed in advance, such as input features, recognition outputs, network structures, task goals, or action sequences. This limits their ability to adapt when new features, new categories, or more efficient task routines appear during long-term operation. To address this problem, this paper proposes a thinking-learning interaction model for autonomous robots. The core idea is that thinking guides learning by identifying potential changes, selecting useful evidence, organizing training materials, and planning verification actions, while learning promotes thinking by updating task knowledge, feature-selection experience, action strategies, and future reasoning processes. Based on this bidirectional mechanism, the robot can gradually move beyond predefined learning settings and adapt its recognition relations and action relations through continuous interaction with the environment. Specifically, the proposed model supports adaptive input feature discovery, output category expansion, learning model update, and action routine reconstruction. Experimental results show that the proposed model improves the final recognition accuracy from 0.419 to 0.845 in feature adaptation, achieves higher new-category formation accuracy and model-update success rate, and reduces the average action length from 13.0 to 4.0 in action routine reconstruction. In learning-enhanced thinking, the useful evidence selection rate increases from 0.272 to 0.965, indicating that learning results can effectively improve future evidence selection and reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种思维-学习交互模型，使自主机器人能够超越预定义设置，通过识别潜在变化、选择有用证据、组织训练材料和规划验证动作，自适应地发现输入特征、扩展输出类别、更新学习模型和重构动作常规。
AI.motivation: 现有学习方法中，学习对象（输入特征、识别输出、网络结构、任务目标或动作序列）往往是预先固定的，导致机器人在长期运行中出现新特征、新类别或更高效任务常规时适应能力受限。
AI.method: 提出思维-学习双向交互模型：思维通过识别潜在变化、选择有用证据、组织训练材料和规划验证动作来引导学习；学习通过更新任务知识、特征选择经验、动作策略和未来推理过程来促进思维。
AI.result: 特征自适应中识别准确率从0.419提升至0.845；新类别形成准确率和模型更新成功率更高；动作常规重构中平均动作长度从13.0降至4.0；有用证据选择率从0.272提升至0.965。
AI.conclusion: 该模型使机器人能够逐步超越预定义学习设置，通过持续环境交互自适应调整识别关系和动作关系，实现长期自主适应。
idea_en: A thinking-learning interaction model for autonomous robots that enables adaptive discovery of input features beyond predefined settings
A method for output category expansion driven by thinking-guided identification of novel patterns
A bidirectional mechanism where thinking organizes training materials and plans verification actions to guide learning
A learning-enhanced reasoning process where updated task knowledge improves future evidence selection and action strategies
An action routine reconstruction technique that reduces average action length through continuous environment interaction
idea_ch: 一种使自主机器人能够超越预定义设置、自适应发现输入特征的思维-学习交互模型
一种由思维引导识别新颖模式驱动的输出类别扩展方法
一种双向机制：思维通过组织训练材料和规划验证动作来引导学习
一种学习增强型推理过程：更新的任务知识用于改进未来证据选择和动作策略
一种通过持续环境交互降低平均动作长度的动作常规重构技术

title: Towards trustworthy agentic AI: a comprehensive survey of safety, robustness, privacy, and system security
comment: 36 pages, 4 figures. Survey/review article on trustworthy agentic AI. Published in Academia AI and Applications, 2026
summary: Agentic AI systems -- Large Language Models (LLMs) augmented with planning, tool use, memory, and long-horizon interactions -- can execute complex tasks autonomously, but their multi-step trajectories introduce new failure modes that challenge trustworthiness. This survey provides a focused examination of trustworthy agentic AI through two core dimensions that are critical for high-risk deployments: Safety and Robustness, and Privacy and System Security. For each dimension, we clarify key concepts, identify where risks emerge along the agent workflow, and summarize stage-targeted mitigation strategies. Other trustworthiness aspects (value alignment, transparency, fairness, and accountability) are discussed as relevant context rather than parallel chapters. To support consistent comparison and deployment decisions, we consolidate evaluation into a unified metrics-and-benchmarks hub, emphasizing both outcome and process signals (e.g., constraint violations, trace completeness, and adversarial success rates) and offering scenario-to-metric guidance for release gating. We conclude by outlining open challenges such as self-evolving agents, runtime monitoring and verification, privacy-preserving personalization, and the trust-utility trade-off, and present a case study of real-world security failures in open-source agentic systems. Our goal is to serve as a practical reference for researchers and practitioners building trustworthy agentic systems in high-stakes environments.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性综述了可信赖的自主智能体AI系统（基于LLM扩展了规划、工具使用、记忆和长程交互能力），聚焦于安全与鲁棒性、隐私与系统安全两大核心维度，梳理了风险来源、缓解策略和评估基准，并提出了面向高风险管理场景的实践参考。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体AI系统在执行复杂任务时，多步轨迹引入了新的失效模式，挑战了系统的可信赖性，亟需系统性的安全性、鲁棒性、隐私和安全的分析与解决方案。
AI.method: 通过文献综述方式，从安全与鲁棒性、隐私与系统安全两个核心维度出发，沿着智能体工作流识别风险点，总结分阶段缓解策略，并整合统一的评估指标和基准体系。
AI.result: 建立了统一的指标与基准中心，强调结果信号和过程信号（如约束违例、轨迹完整性、对抗攻击成功率），提供场景到指标的发布门控指导，并呈现了开源智能体系统真实安全失败的案例研究。
AI.conclusion: 指出了开放挑战，包括自演化智能体、运行时监控与验证、隐私保护个性化、信任-效用权衡，为高风险环境下的可信自主智能体构建提供了实践参考。
idea_en: A stage-targeted mitigation framework that maps specific risks along the agent workflow (planning, tool use, memory, long-horizon interactions) to corresponding safety and robustness strategies.
A unified metrics-and-benchmarks hub integrating both outcome and process signals (constraint violations, trace completeness, adversarial success rates) for evaluating trustworthy agentic AI.
A scenario-to-metric guidance system for release gating decisions in high-risk agent deployments.
Runtime monitoring and verification mechanisms specifically designed for self-evolving agentic systems.
Privacy-preserving personalization techniques for agentic AI that maintain utility while protecting user data across long-horizon interactions.
idea_ch: 一种分阶段缓解策略框架，沿智能体工作流（规划、工具使用、记忆、长程交互）映射具体风险点，并对应安全与鲁棒性策略。
一种统一指标与基准中心，整合结果信号和过程信号（约束违例、轨迹完整性、对抗攻击成功率），用于评估可信自主智能体AI。
一种面向高风险智能体部署中发布门控决策的场景-指标指引系统。
专为自演化智能体系统设计的运行时监控与验证机制。
面向自主智能体AI的隐私保护个性化技术，在长程交互中保护用户数据的同时保持效用。

title: Reason--Imagine--Act: Closed-Loop LLM Decision Making with World Models for Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted by the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC 2026). 8 pages, 2 figures
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are promising for autonomous driving, but semantics-only decision policies can yield physically unsafe behavior in dynamic traffic. Existing methods either perform online language reasoning without explicit dynamics verification or use world models mainly in offline pipelines, leaving a gap between semantic intent and physical feasibility at decision time. We propose Reason--Imagine--Act (RIA), a closed-loop framework that couples an LLM reasoner with an action-conditioned world model for online safety verification. At each step, the LLM proposes an action template and candidate sub-actions, the world model performs short-horizon rollouts, and a safety scorer selects the safest executable action with feedback to the next reasoning step. Under a unified CARLA point-goal protocol (1000 episodes), RIA achieves 80.05% route completion, 51.10% arrival rate, and 0.20% collision rate. Under the same closed-loop interface, RIA consistently outperforms training-free baselines, including CARLA TM and MADA, on core closed-loop metrics. For reproducibility, code is available at https://github.com/pku-smart-city/source_code/tree/main/RIA.

AI.tldr: 提出Reason-Imagine-Act (RIA)闭环框架，将LLM推理器与动作条件世界模型耦合，实现在线安全验证，在CARLA点目标协议下达到80.05%路径完成率、51.10%到达率和0.20%碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的自动驾驶方法存在语义决策与物理可行性之间的鸿沟：纯语义推理可能产生不安全行为，而世界模型多用于离线流程，缺乏在线动态验证机制。
AI.method: RIA框架包含三个步骤：(1) Reason: LLM推理器生成动作模板和候选子动作；(2) Imagine: 动作条件世界模型执行短时域 rollout 预测；(3) Act: 安全评分器选择最安全的可执行动作，并将反馈传递给下一步推理。
AI.result: 在统一CARLA点目标协议下（1000 episodes）：路径完成率80.05%，到达率51.10%，碰撞率0.20%，优于CARLA TM和MADA等无训练基线。
AI.conclusion: RIA通过LLM与世界模型的闭环耦合，弥合了语义意图与物理可行性之间的差距，有效提升了自动驾驶决策的安全性和执行可靠性。
idea_en: Closed-loop coupling of LLM reasoner with action-conditioned world model for online safety verification in autonomous driving
Action template and candidate sub-action generation by LLM with world model short-horizon rollouts for safety scoring
Safety scorer selecting safest executable action with feedback loop to next reasoning step
Unified CARLA point-goal protocol for standardized evaluation of LLM-based autonomous driving
idea_ch: 将LLM推理器与动作条件世界模型闭环耦合，实现在线安全验证的自动驾驶决策方法
LLM生成动作模板与候选子动作，结合世界模型短时域rollout进行安全评分的安全感知动作选择机制
安全评分器选择最安全可执行动作并将反馈传递给下一推理步骤的迭代闭环架构
基于统一CARLA点目标协议的标准化LLM自动驾驶评估体系

title: LC-ERD: Mining Latent Logic for Self-Evolving Reasoning via Consistency-Regulated Reward Decomposition
summary: The evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality process data. While self-alignment via endogenous rewards offers a solution, mining valid supervision faces three challenges: (1) Label Noise via Mimetic Bias, where rewards prioritize statistical likelihood over logical truth, creating a "correctness illusion" that masks compounding errors; (2) Coarse-Grained Supervision, where sparse global outcomes (e.g., in GRPO) fail to provide granular guidance, treating reasoning chains as monolithic; and (3) Distributional Collapse, where signals fail to generalize without amplifying pre-training biases. To address these, we introduce LC-ERD (Logic-Consistent Endogenous Reward Decomposition), a framework framing self-alignment as latent structure mining. We derive a Variational Logic Potential by aggregating consensus from the model's Latent Logic Expertise (LLE) to denoise the reasoning manifold, and introduce a Multi-Agent Value Decomposition protocol based on the IGM principle to quantify individual step utility. Experiments show LC-ERD delivers a robust self-evolution path, uncovering trade-offs between logic consistency and accuracy while identifying high-value reasoning patterns missed by standard rewards. Our code is available at https://github.com/Reinhardmannn/LC-ERD.

AI.tldr: LC-ERD通过变分逻辑势和多智能体价值分解框架，解决LLM自对齐过程中的标签噪声、粗粒度监督和分布坍缩问题，实现高质量推理过程数据挖掘。
AI.motivation: LLM推理发展受限于高质量过程数据稀缺。现有自对齐方法面临三个挑战：模仿偏差导致的标签噪声（奖励偏爱统计似然而非逻辑真值）、粗粒度监督（全局奖励无法提供细粒度指导）、分布坍缩（信号无法泛化且放大预训练偏差）。
AI.method: 提出LC-ERD框架：1) 变分逻辑势(Variational Logic Potential)：聚合模型潜在逻辑专家(Latent Logic Expertise, LLE)的共识来去噪推理流形；2) 基于IGM原理的多智能体价值分解协议(Multi-Agent Value Decomposition)，量化每个步骤的效用。
AI.result: 实验表明LC-ERD提供了稳健的自进化路径，揭示了逻辑一致性与准确性之间的权衡，并识别出标准奖励方法遗漏的高价值推理模式。
AI.conclusion: LC-ERD通过将自对齐问题重构为潜在结构挖掘，有效解决了推理过程数据稀缺问题，为LLM推理能力进化提供了新范式。
idea_en: A method for denoising reasoning manifolds by aggregating consensus from Latent Logic Expertise (LLE) within LLMs using a Variational Logic Potential, enabling logic-consistent endogenous reward generation.
A Multi-Agent Value Decomposition protocol based on the IGM (Individual Global Max) principle that quantifies individual step utility in reasoning chains at a granular level.
A self-alignment framework (LC-ERD) that frames reasoning process supervision as latent structure mining, allowing extraction of high-quality process data from model-generated reasoning chains.
A technique for identifying high-value reasoning patterns overlooked by standard reward methods by decomposing and analyzing trade-offs between logic consistency and accuracy during self-evolution.
idea_ch: 一种通过变分逻辑势(Variational Logic Potential)聚合LLM内部潜在逻辑专家(LLE)共识来去噪推理流形的方法，实现逻辑一致的内生奖励生成。
一种基于IGM(Individual Global Max)原理的多智能体价值分解协议，以细粒度量化推理链中每个步骤的效用。
一种将推理过程监督重构为潜在结构挖掘的自对齐框架(LC-ERD)，能够从模型生成的推理链中提取高质量过程数据。
一种通过分解和分析自进化过程中逻辑一致性与准确性之间的权衡，识别标准奖励方法遗漏的高价值推理模式的技术。

title: EvoSci: A Bio-Inspired Multi-Agent Framework for the Evolution of Scientific Discovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs), have shown strong potential in scientific discovery, yet existing methods still face substantial challenges in the design of research workflows and multi-role collaboration mechanisms. To mitigate these issues, we propose EvoSci, a multi-agent scientific collaboration framework, which integrates bio-inspired evolution with knowledge graph modeling. To iteratively generate, evaluate, and refine research ideas, EvoSci incorporates multiple role-based agents, including mentor, researcher, and reviewer. By combining collaborative reasoning, shared memory, and evolutionary feedback, EvoSci significantly enhances the coherence and creativity of scientific exploration. Experiments on real-world research topics demonstrate that EvoSci significantly outperforms strong baselines in LLM-based structured peer-review and comparative ranking evaluations, achieving the highest overall peer-review score (ICLR 4.90) and top ranking (Top-10 = 54). These results suggest its superiority in both scientific idea generation and continuous discovery.

AI.tldr: EvoSci是一个结合生物进化思想与知识图谱建模的多智能体科学协作框架，通过多角色智能体（导师、研究员、审稿人）协作推理、共享记忆和进化反馈，迭代生成、评估和优化科研想法，在ICLR结构化同行评审和排名评估中取得最优成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在科学研究中面临研究工作流设计和多角色协作机制的挑战，缺乏系统化的科研想法迭代优化方法。
AI.method: 提出EvoSci多智能体科学协作框架，集成生物进化机制与知识图谱建模，包含导师(memtor)、研究员(researcher)、审稿人(reviewer)等多角色智能体，通过协作推理、共享记忆和进化反馈实现科研想法的迭代生成、评估和优化。
AI.result: 在真实研究主题上，EvoSci在结构化同行评审中获得最高ICLR评分(4.90)和最高Top-10排名(54)，显著优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: EvoSci在科学想法生成和持续发现方面具有优越性，证明了多角色协作与进化机制在AI科学发现中的有效性。
idea_en: Multi-agent scientific collaboration framework with bio-inspired evolution for iterative research idea generation, evaluation and refinement
Role-based agent system (mentor, researcher, reviewer) with collaborative reasoning and shared memory for scientific discovery
Integration of knowledge graph modeling with evolutionary feedback for enhanced coherence and creativity in scientific exploration
LLM-based structured peer-review evaluation mechanism using evolutionary optimization to rank and select research ideas
idea_ch: 一种基于生物进化启发的多智能体科学协作框架，用于科研想法的迭代生成、评估与优化
包含导师、研究员、审稿人多角色的智能体系统，结合协作推理与共享记忆实现科学发现
知识图谱建模与进化反馈相结合的方法，增强科学探索的连贯性和创造力
基于LLM的结构化同行评审评估机制，通过进化优化对科研想法进行排序和筛选

title: Breaking the Chains of Probability: Neutrosophic Logic as a New Framework for Epistemic Uncertainty in Large Language Models
comment: Published in Neutrosophic Sets and Systems, Vol. 99 (2026). Author's preprint version. Open code and data available at: github.com/mleyvaz/neutrosophic-llm-logic
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are predominantly governed by probabilistic frameworks in which the sum of outcome probabilities is constrained to unity. This architectural limitation, often imposed by Softmax layers, leads to a collapse of uncertainty that makes it difficult to differentiate between epistemic uncertainty, paradox, and vagueness. We present an empirical investigation of the application of Neutrosophic Logic, a framework that treats Truth (T), Indeterminacy (I), and Falsity (F) as three independent dimensions, to model epistemic states in LLMs. We conducted experiments on a family of four OpenAI GPT models across five linguistic phenomena: logical paradoxes, epistemic ignorance, vagueness, ethical contradictions, and future contingencies, under three prompting strategies: neutrosophic, probabilistic, and entropy-derived. Our findings reveal that the neutrosophic approach, by allowing T+I+F > 1, a state we term hyper-truth, provides a richer representation of a model's internal state. In 35% of evaluations, hyper-truth emerged spontaneously, predominantly under ethical contradiction and logical paradox. We demonstrate that this approach preserves truth values in fuzzy contexts and offers a robust method for identifying and quantifying internal model conflict. We conclude that the integration of neutrosophic evaluation layers is a critical step toward more transparent, reliable, and ethically aware AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将中智逻辑（Truth/Indeterminacy/Falsity三独立维度）应用于大语言模型，替代传统概率框架，以更好区分认知不确定性、悖论和模糊性。实验发现中智方法可产生T+I+F>1的"超真"状态，在伦理矛盾和逻辑悖论场景中尤为显著，为模型内部冲突的量化提供了新方法。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM基于概率框架（Softmax层），结果概率之和为1，导致不确定性坍缩，难以区分认知不确定性、悖论和模糊性。需要更丰富的表征框架来捕捉模型内部的冲突与不确定状态。
AI.method: 将中智逻辑（Truth/Indeterminacy/Falsity三个独立维度）引入LLM评估，在四种OpenAI GPT模型上对五种语言现象（逻辑悖论、认知无知、模糊性、伦理矛盾、未来偶然性）进行实验，采用三种提示策略（中智式、概率式、熵导出式）。
AI.result: 1) 中智方法允许T+I+F>1的"超真"状态；2) 35%的评估中自发出现超真状态，主要出现在伦理矛盾和逻辑悖论场景；3) 该方法能在模糊上下文中保持真值，并提供量化模型内部冲突的稳健方法。
AI.conclusion: 中智评估层的集成是迈向更透明、可靠和具有伦理意识的AI系统的关键步骤。
idea_en: Neutrosophic evaluation layer for LLMs that represents Truth, Indeterminacy, and Falsity as three independent dimensions, breaking the probability sum constraint of Softmax
Hyper-truth state detection mechanism (T+I+F>1) for identifying and quantifying internal model conflict and ethical contradictions
Neutrosophic prompting strategy that elicits richer internal state representations from LLMs compared to probabilistic or entropy-based prompting
idea_ch: 基于中智逻辑的LLM评估层：将真值、不确定性、假值作为三个独立维度，打破Softmax概率和约束
超真状态（T+I+F>1）检测机制：用于识别和量化模型内部冲突及伦理矛盾
中智提示策略：相比概率式或熵导出式提示，能激发LLM更丰富的内部状态表征

title: EvoCode-Bench: Evaluating Coding Agents in Multi-Turn Iterative Interactions
comment: Work in Progress; 32 pages, 10 figures, preprint
summary: Coding agents are increasingly used as iterative development partners, but most benchmarks still evaluate one specification followed by one final assessment. This leaves out a basic question: can an agent keep its own codebase working as requirements change? We introduce EvoCode-Bench, a benchmark of 26 stateful coding tasks and 227 evaluated rounds. Each task preserves the agent's workspace for 5-15 rounds, states requirements through observable behavior, and uses cumulative executable tests to check new requirements and still-active prior ones. We evaluate 13 coding agents with two metrics: MT@4, a four-attempt fail-stop multi-round score, and SR, a single-round score from a reference-completed prior state. For most agents, SR exceeds MT@4 by 22-40 points. The gap also changes rankings: the highest-SR agent (78.9) ranks only third in persistent execution (44.0 MT@4). Even the strongest agents achieve only about 50% success on multi-turn metrics, and aggregate pass rate drops below half of round-1 performance by round 5. Failure analysis shows tier-dependent behavior: weaker agents fail early, while stronger agents survive long enough to expose specification-tracking and regression failures. We release the benchmark data and Harbor multi-turn infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 提出EvoCode-Bench基准测试，评估编码代理在多轮需求变更下的持续开发能力，发现多数代理在多轮指标上表现显著下降，最强代理也仅约50%成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要评估单次规格说明后的最终结果，忽略了编码代理在需求持续变化场景下维持代码库正常工作的基本问题。
AI.method: 构建26个有状态编码任务和227轮评估，每任务包含5-15轮需求变更，通过累积可执行测试同时验证新需求和之前活跃的需求。使用MT@4（四次尝试失败停止的多轮分数）和SR（单轮分数）两种指标评估13个编码代理。
AI.result: 多数代理SR比MT@4高22-40分；排名发生变化，最高SR代理(78.9)在持续执行中仅排第三(44.0 MT@4)；最强代理多轮指标仅约50%成功率；累计通过率到第5轮降至第1轮的一半以下。
AI.conclusion: 现有编码代理在需求持续变化场景下表现不佳，多轮评估揭示了代理在规范追踪和回归失败方面的层次化缺陷，表明需要改进编码代理的持续开发能力。
idea_en: A multi-round cumulative testing method for coding agents that preserves workspace state across 5-15 requirement change rounds, using executable test suites to simultaneously validate new and previously active requirements.
A fail-stop multi-round scoring metric (MT@4) that evaluates coding agents over four attempts per round, providing a persistent execution performance measurement distinct from single-round scores.

A stateful coding task benchmark design where requirements are stated through observable behavior rather than specification text, enabling automated verification of requirement compliance over multiple rounds.

A tier-dependent failure analysis system that distinguishes between early-stage failures in weaker agents and specification-tracking/regression failures in stronger agents during multi-turn coding tasks.
idea_ch: 一种面向编码代理的多轮累积测试方法，在5-15轮需求变更中保持工作区状态，使用可执行测试套件同时验证新需求和先前活跃需求。
一种失败停止多轮评分指标(MT@4)，每轮允许四次尝试，提供与单轮评分不同的持续执行性能测量方法。
一种基于可观察行为而非规格文本描述需求的有状态编码任务基准设计，支持跨多轮自动验证需求合规性。
一种分层依赖的失败分析系统，在多轮编码任务中区分弱代理的早期失败和强代理的规范追踪/回归失败模式。

title: SkillEvolBench: Benchmarking the Evolution from Episodic Experience to Procedural Skills
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents accumulate rich episodic trajectories while solving real-world tasks, but it remains unclear whether such experience can be distilled into reusable procedural skills. We introduce SkillEvolBench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating this step from experience reuse to skill formation. It contains 180 tasks across six real-world agent environments, organized into role-conditioned task families with shared latent procedures. Agents learn from acquisition tasks, update an external skill library using compacted trajectories and verifier feedback, and then face frozen deployment tasks testing context shift, adversarial shortcuts, and composition. By comparing self-generated and curated-start skill evolution against no-skill and raw-trajectory controls, SkillEvolBench separates procedural abstraction from base capability, curated prior knowledge, and direct reuse of episodic traces. Across ten model configurations and three agent harnesses, we find that current agents often adapt locally but rarely form robust reusable skills. Skill-based conditions can improve acquisition or replay, and individual models sometimes gain on specific deployment axes, but these gains are unstable under frozen deployment. Raw-trajectory reuse frequently outperforms distilled skills, suggesting that current abstraction procedures discard contextual and procedural cues that remain useful for future tasks. Capacity and cost analyses further show that writing more skills or larger Tier-3 resource libraries is not sufficient: additional updates can improve coverage while introducing episode-specific drift and procedural clutter. These findings position SkillEvolBench as a testbed for measuring when one-off experience becomes durable procedural knowledge rather than task-local memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillEvolBench基准，评估LLM代理能否将任务经验提炼为可复用的程序化技能。实验表明当前代理大多只能局部适应，难以形成鲁棒的可复用技能，原始轨迹复用反而优于蒸馏技能。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理在解决实际任务时积累了丰富的经验轨迹，但不清楚这些经验能否被蒸馏成可复用的程序化技能。现有研究缺乏系统性的基准来区分经验复用与真正的技能形成。
AI.method: 构建SkillEvolBench基准，包含180个任务、6个真实世界代理环境，组织为角色条件化的任务族。代理从获取任务中学习，更新外部技能库（利用压缩轨迹+验证器反馈），然后在冻结部署任务中测试上下文迁移、对抗性捷径和组合能力。通过自我生成vs策展起始技能进化、无技能vs原始轨迹控制等对比来分离程序化抽象能力。
AI.result: 当前代理常能局部适应但很少形成鲁棒可复用技能。基于技能的条件有时能改善获取或回放，但收益不稳定。原始轨迹复用常优于蒸馏技能，说明当前抽象过程丢弃了有用的上下文和程序化线索。增加技能数量或更大资源库不足以解决问题。
AI.conclusion: SkillEvolBench可作为测试一次性经验是否转化为持久程序化知识而非任务局部记忆的基准。
idea_en: A method for decomposing episodic agent trajectories into compacted procedural skill representations using hierarchical abstraction, where trajectory steps are clustered into reusable action templates via latent procedure discovery
A skill evolution framework with verifier feedback loop that iteratively refines skill library entries by comparing compressed action sequences against execution outcomes in acquired tasks

An adversarial shortcut detection mechanism for evaluating skill robustness, where deployment tasks are modified with context shifts to test whether learned skills generalize beyond training conditions
A compositional skill assembly system that enables agents to combine multiple procedural skills from a library to solve novel tasks requiring multi-step procedures
A role-conditioned task family generation method that automatically creates tasks sharing latent procedures but varying in surface context, enabling systematic evaluation of procedural abstraction
A curated-start vs self-generated skill evolution comparison protocol that separates the effects of prior knowledge from genuine skill acquisition in agent learning
idea_ch: 一种利用层次抽象将代理的阶段性经验轨迹分解为压缩程序化技能表示的方法，通过潜在过程发现将轨迹步骤聚类为可复用的动作模板
一种带有验证器反馈循环的技能进化框架，通过比较压缩动作序列与获取任务中的执行结果来迭代优化技能库条目
一种用于评估技能鲁棒性的对抗性快捷检测机制，通过上下文偏移修改部署任务以测试学习技能能否泛化到训练条件之外
一种组合式技能组装系统，使代理能够从技能库中组合多个程序化技能来解决需要多步骤过程的新任务
一种角色条件化任务族生成方法，自动创建共享潜在过程但表面上下文不同的任务，实现程序化抽象能力的系统评估
一种策展起始与自我生成技能进化对比协议，将先验知识的影响与代理学习中真正的技能获取分离开来

title: MAPLE: Multi-State Aggregated Policy Evaluation for AlphaZero in Imperfect-Information Games
comment: Accepted by the IEEE Conference on Games (IEEE CoG 2026)
summary: Imperfect-information games (IIGs) are challenging, as players must make decisions without fully observing the true game state. While AlphaZero has achieved remarkable success in perfect-information games, extending it to IIGs remains difficult. Existing search-based approaches, such as Perfect Information Monte Carlo (PIMC), suffer from strategy fusion, while Information Set Monte Carlo Tree Search (IS-MCTS) incurs high computational cost when combined with neural networks. In this paper, we propose Multi-State Aggregated PoLicy Evaluation (MAPLE), a tree search method that aggregates policy and value evaluations from multiple sampled world states within a single search tree, combining the advantages of PIMC and IS-MCTS while maintaining a controllable computational cost. We further incorporate a Siamese-based sampling strategy to select informative world states from the information set. Experiments on Phantom Go and Dark Hex show that MAPLE significantly outperforms the PIMC-based AlphaZero baseline, achieving Elo improvements of 291 and 136, respectively. These results demonstrate that MAPLE is an effective approach for AlphaZero-style learning in imperfect-information games.

AI.tldr: 提出MAPLE，一种结合PIMC和IS-MCTS优势的多状态聚合策略评估树搜索方法，用于将AlphaZero扩展到不完美信息游戏。
AI.motivation: 将AlphaZero从不完美信息游戏扩展到不完美信息游戏面临困难：PIMC存在策略融合问题，IS-MCTS结合神经网络计算成本高。
AI.method: 提出MAPLE（Multi-State Aggregated PoLicy Evaluation），在单个搜索树中聚合来自多个采样世界状态的策略和价值评估，并采用基于Siamese的采样策略选择信息集中的信息性世界状态。
AI.result: 在Phantom Go和Dark Hex上，MAPLE显著优于基于PIMC的AlphaZero基线，Elo提升分别为291和136。
AI.conclusion: MAPLE是AlphaZero风格学习在不完美信息游戏中的有效方法。
idea_en: Multi-State Aggregated Policy Evaluation (MAPLE): A tree search method that aggregates policy and value evaluations from multiple sampled world states within a single search tree for imperfect-information games.
Siamese-based sampling strategy for selecting informative world states from an information set to improve search efficiency and accuracy.
Combining advantages of PIMC and IS-MCTS while maintaining controllable computational cost for neural network-based tree search in imperfect-information games.
Enhanced AlphaZero framework adapted for imperfect-information games using multi-state aggregation search.
idea_ch: 多状态聚合策略评估（MAPLE）：一种在单一搜索树内聚合来自多个采样世界状态的策略和价值评估的树搜索方法，用于不完美信息游戏。
基于Siamese的采样策略：从不完全信息集中选择信息性世界状态，以提高搜索效率和准确性。
结合PIMC和IS-MCTS优势的方法，同时保持可控计算成本，用于不完美信息游戏中基于神经网络的树搜索。
增强型AlphaZero框架：通过多状态聚合搜索适配不完美信息游戏场景。

title: HyperGuide: Hyperbolic Guidance for Efficient Multi-Step Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Multi-step reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models: single-pass generation is efficient but lacks accuracy; tree-search methods explore multiple paths but are computation-heavy. We address this gap by distilling reasoning progress into a hyperbolic geometric signal that guides step-by-step generation. Our approach is motivated by a structural observation: in combinatorial reasoning trees, solution-bearing states are few while dead ends are exponentially numerous. The hyperbolic space matches this asymmetry, with compact volume near the origin and exponentially expanding capacity toward the boundary, so that distance-to-origin naturally encodes solution proximity while angular separation distinguishes branches requiring different next operations. We train a lightweight head to project LLM hidden states into this space, then fine-tune a low-rank adapter interactively on its own reasoning attempts to act on the injected signal. Across multiple benchmarks, the geometric signal yields consistent gains, with larger improvements on deeper reasoning chains. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yuyuliu11037/HyperGuide.

AI.tldr: 提出通过将推理进度蒸馏为双曲几何信号来引导大语言模型逐步推理，在保持单步生成效率的同时提升多步推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法中，单步生成高效但准确性不足，树搜索虽准确但计算开销大。双曲空间天然匹配推理树中解状态稀少而死路指数级增长的不对称结构，可作为一种高效引导信号。
AI.method: 训练轻量级头将LLM隐藏状态投影到双曲空间，利用到原点的距离编码解接近度、角度分离区分不同分支；通过低秩适配器在自推理尝试中交互式微调，使模型根据注入的几何信号调整生成步骤。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上取得一致改进，推理链越深提升越大。
AI.conclusion: 双曲几何信号能有效引导LLM多步推理，在保持效率的同时提升准确性，深度推理场景优势更明显。
idea_en: A method for distilling reasoning progress in large language models into a hyperbolic geometric signal to guide step-by-step generation, where distance-to-origin encodes solution proximity and angular separation distinguishes different reasoning branches.

A lightweight projection head that maps LLM hidden states into hyperbolic space, combined with a low-rank adapter fine-tuned interactively on the model's own reasoning attempts to act on the injected geometric signal.

Using hyperbolic space's asymmetric volume property (compact near origin, exponentially expanding toward boundary) to naturally match the asymmetry of combinatorial reasoning trees where solution-bearing states are few and dead ends are numerous.
idea_ch: 一种将大语言模型推理进度蒸馏为双曲几何信号的方法，利用到原点的距离编码解接近度、角度分离区分不同推理分支，引导逐步生成。
一种轻量级投影头，将LLM隐藏状态映射到双曲空间，并结合低秩适配器在模型自身推理尝试中交互式微调，使模型根据注入的几何信号调整生成过程。
利用双曲空间的不对称体积特性（原点附近紧凑、边界方向指数扩展）匹配组合推理树中解状态稀少而死路指数级增长的不对称结构，从而高效引导推理方向。

title: Neuro-Inspired Inverse Learning for Planning and Control
summary: We present a neuro-inspired framework for embodied planning and control. Building on three principles that enable fast and highly effective goal-directed behavior in the mammalian brain - paired forward/inverse internal models, open-loop multi-step motor commands, and sequential, hierarchical organization of action - our Inverter framework uses learned components, trained end-to-end through Inverse Learning (IL) and supplemented where natural by analytic or algorithmic modules; we formalize IL and delineate it from supervised, reinforcement, and imitation learning. IL bridges Reinforcement Learning (RL)-style amortization, which runs in a single forward pass but emits only one action at a time, and Optimal Control (OC)-style sequence planning over whole trajectories, but with iterative test-time computation. Single Inverters or hierarchical n=2 Inverter stacks match or improve on offline-RL and diffusion-planner baselines on all 3 maze2d and 6 antmaze D4RL variants by an average of +24.2% (range -1.9% to +78.2%), at one-to-two orders of magnitude less inference compute time. Distinctively, optimizing through the Figure of Merit (FoM) over the entire T-step action sequence - rather than per step - lets Inverters produce smooth, goal-coherent, trajectory-wide structure and reach control policies closer to the analytic optimum than the policy underlying the training data itself. We also identify a failure mode of IL: FoM hacking under narrow training-data coverage, which we mitigate by using random training data with broader coverage. As an application example, a Pulse Inverter synthesizes arbitrary single-qubit quantum gates with fidelity matching the standard iterative numerical baseline (GRAPE), at more than 1000x lower per-gate compute time. In summary, we conclude that IL enables a versatile class of world-interfaces, especially for latency- and resource-critical embodied AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受神经科学启发的Inverter框架，通过逆向学习（IL）实现高效目标导向规划与控制。IL桥接了强化学习的单步快速推理和最优控制的多步轨迹规划，在D4RL任务上平均提升24.2%，推理速度提升1-2个数量级，并成功应用于量子门合成。
AI.motivation: 哺乳动物大脑能够快速高效地进行目标导向行为，但现有AI方法存在短板：RL类方法每次只输出一个动作，缺乏轨迹级全局连贯性；最优控制（OC）类方法虽能规划完整轨迹但需要迭代计算，推理速度慢。作者希望提出一种兼具两者优势的框架。
AI.method: 提出Inverter框架，基于三个神经科学原则：前向/逆向内部模型对、开环多步运动命令、动作的顺序层次组织。核心是逆向学习（IL），通过Figure of Merit (FoM)在整个T步动作序列上优化，而非单步优化。支持单层或层次化n=2的Inverter堆叠。训练端到端，可结合解析/算法模块。
AI.result: 在D4RL的3个maze2d和6个antmaze变体上，单Inverter或层次化Inverter堆栈相比离线RL和扩散规划基线平均提升24.2%（范围-1.9%至+78.2%），推理计算时间降低1-2个数量级。Inverter产生的动作序列比训练数据更接近解析最优。量子门合成任务中，Pulse Inverter在保真度匹配GRAPE基线的同时，计算速度提升1000倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 逆向学习（IL）作为一种新型学习范式，桥接了RL的快速推理和OC的全局规划，特别适用于延迟敏感和资源受限的具身AI应用。文中也指出了IL的失败模式（在窄训练数据覆盖下出现FoM hacking），并通过使用更广泛覆盖的随机训练数据来缓解。
idea_en: A neuro-inspired Inverter framework using paired forward/inverse internal models that generates open-loop multi-step motor commands for embodied planning and control, trained end-to-end via Inverse Learning.

Inverse Learning (IL) as a novel learning paradigm that bridges Reinforcement Learning-style amortization (single forward pass, one action at a time) and Optimal Control-style sequence planning (whole trajectories with iterative computation).
Figure of Merit (FoM) optimization over an entire T-step action sequence rather than per-step optimization, enabling smooth, goal-coherent, trajectory-wide structure.
Hierarchical Inverter stack (n=2) that organizes actions sequentially and hierarchically for complex planning tasks.
Pulse Inverter for quantum gate synthesis that generates arbitrary single-qubit quantum gates with fidelity matching iterative numerical baselines at over 1000x lower per-gate compute time.
Failure mode identification and mitigation for Inverse Learning: FoM hacking under narrow training-data coverage, mitigated by using random training data with broader coverage.
A method of training learned components end-to-end supplemented by analytic or algorithmic modules within the Inverter framework.
idea_ch: 一种受神经科学启发的Inverter框架，使用成对的前向/逆向内部模型生成开环多步运动命令，通过逆向学习（IL）端到端训练，用于具身规划与控制。
逆向学习（IL）作为一种新型学习范式，桥接了强化学习风格的单步快速推理（单次前向传播、每次一个动作）和最优控制风格的整体轨迹规划（迭代计算）。
在整个T步动作序列上优化Figure of Merit (FoM)而非逐步优化的方法，产生平滑、目标一致、轨迹级连贯的结构。
层次化Inverter堆栈（n=2），实现动作的顺序层次化组织，用于复杂规划任务。
用于量子门合成的Pulse Inverter，能够以匹配迭代数值基线（GRAPE）的保真度生成任意单量子比特量子门，每个门计算时间降低1000倍以上。
逆向学习的失败模式识别与缓解方法：在窄训练数据覆盖下出现的FoM hacking，通过使用更广泛覆盖的随机训练数据来缓解。
在Inverter框架内，使用解析或算法模块补充端到端训练的学习组件的方法。

title: Palette: A Modular, Controllable, and Efficient Framework for On-demand Authorized Safety Alignment Relaxation in LLMs
summary: Current safety alignment of foundation models largely follows a \emph{one-size-fits-all} paradigm, applying the same refusal policy across users and contexts. As a result, models may refuse requests that are unsafe for general users but legitimate for authorized professionals, limiting helpfulness in specialized professional settings. Existing approaches either require costly realignment or rely on inference-time steering that suffers from imprecise control and added latency. To this end, we propose \textsc{Palette}, a modular, controllable, and efficient framework that selectively relaxes refusal behavior on authorized target domains while preserving standard safety elsewhere. Our method identifies a refusal direction via multi-objective search and internalizes it into the model through lightweight adaptation. \textsc{Palette} further supports modular composition: it learns domain-specific safety controls independently and composes them through parameter merging, enabling on-demand multi-domain authorization without retraining. Experiments across four safety benchmarks, multiple model variants, and both LLMs and VLMs show that \textsc{Palette} delivers precise safety control without sacrificing general utility, offering a practical path toward foundation models that adapt to diverse professional needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Palette框架，通过多目标搜索识别拒绝方向并轻量内化到模型中，实现可控、模块化的安全策略放松，允许在授权专业领域选择性放宽拒绝行为，同时保持通用场景的安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型的安全对齐采用"一刀切"范式，对所有用户和上下文应用相同的拒绝策略，导致在专业授权场景下过度拒绝合法请求，影响实用性。
AI.method: Palette通过多目标搜索识别拒绝方向，通过轻量适配内化到模型中；支持模块化组合：独立学习领域特定安全控制，通过参数合并实现按需多域授权，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在四个安全基准、多种模型变体、LLM和VLM上的实验表明，Palette能提供精准的安全控制，不牺牲通用效用。
AI.conclusion: Palette为面向多样化专业需求的基础模型提供了一条实用路径，实现精确的安全控制与领域自适应的平衡。
idea_en: A multi-objective search method for identifying a refusal direction in foundation models that can be internalized via lightweight adaptation
A modular controllable safety framework (Palette) with domain-specific safety controls learned independently and composed via parameter merging
A method for selective relaxation of refusal behavior on authorized target domains while preserving standard safety elsewhere through internalized refusal direction
idea_ch: 一种多目标搜索方法，用于识别基础模型中的拒绝方向，并通过轻量适配将其内化到模型中
一种模块化可控安全框架(Palette)，独立学习领域特定安全控制，通过参数合并实现按需组合
一种通过内化拒绝方向，在授权目标领域选择性放松拒绝行为、同时在通用场景保持标准安全性的方法

title: Inference Time Context Sparsity: Illusion or Opportunity?
summary: Sparsity has long been a central theme in LLM efficiency, but its role in context processing remains unresolved. As LLM workloads shift toward longer contexts and agentic interactions, the compute and memory bottlenecks of attention become increasingly critical, raising the question of whether these constraints are fundamental. Our position is that these constraints are artificial and unnecessary, and that the future of LLM inference lies in extreme but principled sparsity along the context dimension. This position is supported by several strands of empirical and theoretical evidence. First, we find the insistence on dense attention unreasonable, since in a long context a query effectively projects O(N) attention information into a hidden space of dimension d << N, making the process inherently lossy. Second, we perform an extensive study of sparsity in LLMs spanning 20 models across five model families, varying context lengths, and different sparsity levels. We empirically demonstrate a strong trend: current LLMs, despite not being trained for context sparsity, are remarkably robust to inference-time decode sparsity across tasks of varying complexity, including retrieval, multi-hop QA, mathematical reasoning, and agentic coding. Importantly, we also show that current hardware is already sufficient to realize substantial gains from this sparsity. For example, our sparse decode kernels accelerate large-context processing by up to 10x over FlashInfer at 50x sparsity levels on hardware such as the H100. Overall, these results position extreme context sparsity not as a heuristic, but as a principled foundation for LLM inference, training, and architecture design: one that is both feasible and beneficial, and a compelling direction for future systems.

AI.tldr: 本文主张在LLM推理中采用极端但有序的上下文稀疏性，认为密集注意力在长上下文中不必要且浪费，通过20个模型的实验证明现有LLM对推理时解码稀疏性高度鲁棒，且当前硬件（如H100）在50倍稀疏度下可实现高达10倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM处理长上下文和智能体交互越来越普遍，注意力的计算和内存瓶颈日益严重，本文质疑这些瓶颈是否是根本性的，并主张它们是人为且不必要的，目标是推动极端上下文稀疏性作为LLM推理的基础。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：指出密集注意力中一个query将O(N)的注意力信息投影到d维隐藏空间（d << N），本质上有损。2) 实证研究：覆盖20个模型、5个模型家族，在不同上下文长度和稀疏度下测试检索、多跳QA、数学推理、智能体编程等任务，验证推理时解码稀疏性的鲁棒性。3) 硬件实现：开发稀疏解码内核，在H100上实现高达10倍加速。
AI.result: 现有LLM虽未经稀疏性训练，但对推理时解码稀疏性高度鲁棒；稀疏解码内核在50倍稀疏度下实现比FlashInfer高达10倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: 极端上下文稀疏性不仅是可行的启发式方法，更可作为LLM推理、训练和架构设计的有原则基础，是未来系统的重要方向。
idea_en: Inference-time sparse attention decoding method that applies extreme but principled sparsity along the context dimension, enabling up to 10x speedup over standard attention kernels.
Hardware-optimized sparse decode kernels that exploit existing hardware capabilities to achieve significant acceleration (e.g., 50x sparsity on H100).
A universal sparsity robustness assessment framework for LLMs, testing across 20 models and 5 model families to determine task-specific optimal sparsity levels.
Method for performing long-context multi-hop QA, retrieval, mathematical reasoning, and agentic coding under extreme context sparsity without retraining.
Theoretical framework proving that dense attention in long contexts is inherently lossy due to the projection of O(N) attention information into a d-dimensional space (d << N).
idea_ch: 一种推理时稀疏注意力解码方法，在上下文维度上应用极端但有序的稀疏性，实现比标准注意力内核高达10倍的加速。
硬件优化的稀疏解码内核，利用现有硬件能力实现显著加速（如在H100上达到50倍稀疏度）。
一种通用的LLM稀疏鲁棒性评估框架，覆盖20个模型和5个模型家族，用于确定任务特定的最优稀疏度水平。
在极端上下文稀疏性下无需重新训练即可执行长上下文多跳问答、检索、数学推理和智能体编程的方法。
证明长上下文中密集注意力因将O(N)注意力信息投影到d维空间（d << N）而本质上是有损的理论框架。

title: EPPC-OASIS: Ontology-Aware Adaptation and Structured Inference Refinement for Electronic Patient-Provider Communication Mining in Secure Messages
summary: Secure patient-provider messages contain clinically important communication behaviors that are difficult to characterize manually at scale. The Electronic Patient-Provider Communication (EPPC) framework provides an ontology for coding these behaviors, but automated extraction remains challenging because predictions must preserve fine-grained code/sub-code structure while grounding annotations in message text. We developed EPPC-OASIS, an ontology-aware adaptation approach for structured EPPC extraction, and combined it with deployable inference-refinement procedures designed to improve the coherence of final annotations. EPPC-OASIS augments supervised fine-tuning with a Wasserstein alignment objective that encourages alignment between model representation neighborhoods and EPPC ontology-derived neighborhoods, while inference refinement uses verification, self-consistency, hybrid correction, and selection or ensembling to address residual prediction errors. We evaluated the framework on a de-identified corpus of secure patient-provider messages against prompting, supervised fine-tuning, preference-based, and robustness-oriented baselines across multiple open-weight language models. Across model families, the best deployable pipeline achieved 77.13% Code+Sub-code F1 and 63.83% Triplet F1, corresponding to modest but consistent absolute gains of +1.39 and +2.12 F1 points over the strongest supervised fine-tuning baseline. These results suggest that ontology-aware adaptation with structured inference refinement can support scalable retrospective EPPC mining, although external validation is needed before operational use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EPPC-OASIS框架，结合本体感知适配（Wasserstein对齐）与结构化推理精炼（验证、自一致性、混合修正、选择/集成），从医患消息中自动提取EPPC编码，在开源语言模型上实现Code+Sub-code F1 77.13%和Triplet F1 63.83%，超过强监督微调基线。
AI.motivation: 医患消息中蕴含临床重要沟通行为，但手动大规模标注成本高昂；现有EPPC本体提供了编码框架，但自动化提取需同时保持细粒度代码/子代码结构并锚定于原文，现有方法难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出EPPC-OASIS框架：1) 监督微调结合Wasserstein对齐目标，将模型表示邻域与EPPC本体派生邻域对齐；2) 推理精炼流程包括验证、自一致性、混合修正、选择或集成，用于修正残余预测错误。
AI.result: 在去标识化医患消息语料上，最佳流水线在Code+Sub-code F1达77.13%，Triplet F1达63.83%，相较最强监督微调基线分别提升+1.39和+2.12个F1点。
AI.conclusion: 本体感知适配结合结构化推理精炼可支持可扩展的回顾性EPPC挖掘，但投入实际使用前需外部验证。
idea_en: A method for ontology-aware language model fine-tuning that uses Wasserstein distance to align model representation neighborhoods with ontology-derived neighborhoods, enabling structured code/sub-code extraction from clinical text.

A structured inference refinement pipeline for sequence labeling that combines verification, self-consistency checking, hybrid correction, and selection/ensembling to improve coherence of predicted annotations.
A hybrid correction mechanism that leverages ontology constraints to detect and rectify residual prediction errors in fine-grained medical code extraction.
An ensemble selection strategy for clinical text annotation that adaptively chooses or combines multiple model inferences based on confidence and ontology consistency.
idea_ch: 一种本体感知的语言模型微调方法，利用Wasserstein距离将模型表示邻域与本体派生邻域对齐，实现从临床文本中提取结构化代码/子代码。
一种用于序列标注的结构化推理精炼流水线，结合验证、自一致性检查、混合修正和选择/集成，提升预测标注的一致性。
一种利用本体约束检测并修正细粒度医学代码提取中残余预测错误的混合修正机制。
一种面向临床文本标注的集成选择策略，基于置信度和本体一致性自适应地选择或组合多个模型推理结果。

title: A Sober Look at Agentic Misalignment in Automated Workflows
summary: We study a class of emergent misalignment in multi-agent systems (MAS), with a focus on automated workflows, which we refer to agentic misalignment. Although these systems can solve complex tasks, they often fail because agents act according to implicit proxy utilities that do not align with the intended human goals. We formally define these behaviors and analyze them within a Bayesian framework, showing that generic utilities naturally lead to posterior collapse of agents in automated workflows. To address this issue, we propose Agentic Evidence Attribution (AEA), a novel alignment paradigm that improves agent posteriors using context-specific evidence. AEA reasons over agent actions and provides structured evidence to correct misaligned behavior during collaboration. To better understand the role of evidence, we study two instantiations of AEA: self-reflection (internal evidence from the model) and weak-to-strong generalization (external evidence on the agentic trajectory). We show that a small evidence model effectively aligns the MAS by providing orthogonal failure attribution. Our results clarify the sources of agentic misalignment in automated workflows and show that evidence-based alignment can effectively improve agent collaboration and leads to reliable multi-agent systems built on automated workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体系统(MAS)中的新兴错位问题（称为"智能体错位"），提出了一种名为智能体证据归因(AEA)的对齐范式，通过上下文特定证据改善智能体后验分布，纠正自动化工作流中的错位行为。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统在自动化工作流中虽能解决复杂任务，但常因智能体依据与人类目标不一致的隐式代理效用行事而导致系统失败，亟需解决这种错位问题。
AI.method: 在贝叶斯框架下形式化定义智能体错位行为，提出智能体证据归因(AEA)范式，通过自反思（内部证据）和弱到强泛化（外部证据）两种实例化方式，利用小证据模型提供正交失败归因来对齐MAS。
AI.result: 研究表明通用效用会导致自动化工作流中智能体后验坍塌，而基于证据的对齐方法能有效改善智能体协作，构建更可靠的多智能体系统。
AI.conclusion: 证据驱动的对齐范式能够有效纠正自动化工作流中的智能体错位问题，为构建可靠的多智能体系统提供了新思路。
idea_en: Agentic Evidence Attribution (AEA): A novel alignment paradigm that improves agent posteriors using context-specific evidence to correct misaligned behavior during multi-agent collaboration.
Bayesian framework for formalizing agentic misalignment in multi-agent systems, analyzing posterior collapse caused by generic utilities in automated workflows.
Self-reflection instantiation of AEA: using internal evidence from the model itself to align agent behavior.
Weak-to-strong generalization instantiation of AEA: using external evidence on the agentic trajectory to achieve alignment.
Small evidence model for orthogonal failure attribution: a compact model that effectively aligns MAS by providing structured evidence without requiring large-scale retraining.
idea_ch: 智能体证据归因(AEA)范式：一种利用上下文特定证据改善智能体后验分布的新对齐方法，在多智能体协作过程中纠正错位行为。
基于贝叶斯框架的智能体错位形式化方法：分析了自动化工作流中通用效用导致的后验坍塌问题，为理解错位提供了数学基础。
自反思实例化：利用模型自身内部证据进行智能体对齐，实现自我纠错的协作机制。
弱到强泛化实例化：利用智能体轨迹上的外部证据进行对齐，小模型引导大模型实现更优协作。
小型证据模型正交失败归因技术：通过提供结构化正交失败归因，无需大规模重训即可有效对齐多智能体系统。

title: When Does Multi-Agent RL Improve LLM Workflows? Workflow, Scale, and Policy-Sharing Tradeoffs
summary: Multi-agent LLM workflows route inference through specialized roles to lift end-task accuracy, but jointly training those roles with reinforcement learning is unstable in ways that are poorly understood. We study when end-to-end RL training of multi-agent LLM workflows improves over their base models, comparing Shared-Policy training, where all roles update one policy, with Isolated-Policy training, where each role has its own parameters. Our experimental matrix spans Eval-Opt, Voting, and Orch-Workers workflows, math and code tasks, and three model scales (0.6B, 1.7B, 4B). We find that multi-agent RL usually improves over base models, but gains depend jointly on workflow, task, and scale, not on policy sharing alone. Isolated-Policy tends to reach higher peak accuracy yet more often falls off a terminal accuracy cliff, while Shared-Policy training does not eliminate failure; it redistributes failure into qualitatively different patterns. We then explain the strongest of these patterns through role-level gradient dynamics induced by workflow topology and policy routing: under Isolated-Policy, parallel same-role agents on shared prompts amplify per-role gradients and drive terminal degradation in Voting and Orch-Workers workflows; under Shared-Policy, asymmetric per-step gradient mass causes the shared policy to be captured by the dominant role, producing different failure signatures by task and workflow. Together, the empirical map and its underlying mechanisms show that policy sharing routes training pressure through different channels rather than offering uniform stability, making it a design choice with workflow- and task-conditional tradeoffs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多智能体LLM工作流中端到端强化学习训练的稳定性问题，比较了共享策略训练和隔离策略训练在不同工作流、任务和模型规模下的表现，发现两者各有优劣且失败模式不同，并通过梯度动力学解释了这些模式。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM工作流通过分工角色提升任务准确率，但联合训练这些角色的强化学习过程稳定性差且机制不明确。
AI.method: 在Eval-Opt、Voting和Orch-Workers三种工作流上，对数学和代码任务，在0.6B、1.7B、4B三个模型规模下，比较Shared-Policy（所有角色共享一个策略）和Isolated-Policy（每个角色独立参数）两种训练方式。
AI.result: 多智能体RL通常能提升基础模型性能，但收益取决于工作流、任务和规模的联合作用；Isolated-Policy峰值准确率更高但更易出现准确率悬崖；Shared-Policy不消除失败，而是将失败模式重新分布。通过角色级梯度动力学解释了最强模式。
AI.conclusion: 策略共享只是将训练压力导向不同渠道而非提供统一稳定性，是一种依赖于工作流和任务条件的设计选择。
idea_en: A multi-agent LLM training method that dynamically switches between Shared-Policy and Isolated-Policy based on real-time gradient monitoring, preventing gradient amplification or dominant role capture during reinforcement learning.
A role-level gradient gating mechanism for multi-agent LLM workflows that adjusts per-role gradient contributions to prevent terminal accuracy degradation during end-to-end RL training.
A workflow-topology-aware policy routing method that predicts and mitigates role-specific gradient dynamics in multi-agent LLM systems based on task type and model scale.
A diagnostic framework for detecting imminent accuracy cliffs in multi-agent RL training by monitoring per-role gradient variance and inter-role gradient alignment metrics.
A hybrid multi-agent training scheme that uses Shared-Policy for initial phases and transitions to Isolated-Policy upon convergence to combine stability with peak accuracy.
idea_ch: 基于实时梯度监控在共享策略与隔离策略之间动态切换的多智能体LLM训练方法，防止强化学习过程中的梯度放大或主导角色捕获
针对多智能体LLM工作流的角色级梯度门控机制，通过调整各角色梯度贡献防止端到端RL训练中的准确率退化
基于工作流拓扑感知的策略路由方法，根据任务类型和模型规模预测并缓解多智能体LLM系统中的角色特异性梯度动力学
通过监控角色级梯度方差和角色间梯度对齐指标检测多智能体RL训练中即将发生的准确率悬崖的诊断框架
结合共享策略（初始阶段）与隔离策略（收敛后切换）的混合多智能体训练方案，兼顾训练稳定性与峰值准确率

title: Identifying and Mitigating Systemic Measurement Bias in Production LLM Inference Benchmarks
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) transition from research environments to production deployments, evaluating their performance against strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs) has become critical. However, current evaluation methodologies suffer from severe measurement bias at scale. We demonstrate that widely used benchmarking utilities rely on single-process, asyncio-driven architectures that introduce fundamental client-side queuing bottlenecks under high concurrency. By modeling the benchmarking client as an $M/G/1$ queue, we mathematically demonstrate how the Python Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) artificially inflates Time to First Token (TTFT) and Time Per Output Token (TPOT) metrics as request rates scale. To resolve this systematic inaccuracy, we propose an unbiased, multi-process evaluation framework that effectively distributes client-side load, ensuring negligible queuing overhead. Furthermore, we formalize a composite metric, Normalized Time Per Output Token (NTPOT), to robustly amortize end-to-end latency, including prefill and scheduling delays across sequence lengths. Our empirical evaluation demonstrates that this methodology successfully isolates pure serving engine performance, enabling accurate, reproducible profiling of LLMs at production scales exceeding thousands of queries per second.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了大语言模型评估中因Python GIL导致的客户端排队瓶颈问题，提出无偏的多进程评估框架和标准化指标NTPOT，以实现生产级规模的精准性能评测。
AI.motivation: LLM从研究走向生产部署，需严格评估SLO，但现有评测方法在高并发下存在严重测量偏差，无法反映真实服务引擎性能。
AI.method: 将评测客户端建模为M/G/1队列，数学论证GIL如何人为膨胀TTFT和TPOT指标；提出无偏的多进程评估框架分散客户端负载，消除排队开销；定义复合指标NTPOT来鲁棒地摊销端到端延迟。
AI.result: 该方法成功隔离了纯服务引擎性能，支持每秒数千查询的生产级规模下进行准确、可复现的性能剖析。
AI.conclusion: 当前评测工具有系统性偏差，所提框架和指标能有效解决LLM生产环境下的评测准确性问题。
idea_en: A multi-process evaluation framework for LLM serving that eliminates client-side queuing bottlenecks caused by Python GIL by distributing load across multiple processes.
A composite metric, Normalized Time Per Output Token (NTPOT), that robustly amortizes end-to-end latency including prefill and scheduling delays across varying sequence lengths.
Mathematical modeling of LLM benchmarking clients as M/G/1 queues to analytically demonstrate measurement bias from single-process, asyncio-driven architectures.
A methodology for isolating pure serving engine performance from client-side overhead in high-concurrency LLM deployments exceeding thousands of queries per second.
idea_ch: 一种多进程LLM服务评估框架，通过跨进程分发负载消除Python GIL导致的客户端排队瓶颈
一种复合指标NTPOT（标准化每输出Token时间），鲁棒地摊销包括预填充和调度延迟在内的端到端延迟，适用于不同序列长度
将LLM基准测试客户端建模为M/G/1队列的数学方法，用于分析单进程、asyncio驱动架构带来的测量偏差
一种在高并发（每秒数千查询）LLM部署中隔离纯服务引擎性能与客户端开销的评测方法论

title: Beyond Final Answers: Auditing Trajectory-Level Hallucinations in Multi-Agent Industrial Workflows
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that reason, use tools, and act over multiple steps. Yet most hallucination benchmarks still evaluate only the final output, missing failures that originate in intermediate Thought-Action-Observation steps. We present Trajel, a dataset and evaluation framework for auditing trajectory-level hallucinations in multi-agent industrial workflows. Trajel introduces a five-type hallucination taxonomy (factual, referential, logical, procedural, and scope-based) over expert-annotated agent traces from AssetOpsBench. We benchmark supervised detection models at the subtask, trajectory, and long-context levels. Our results show that the most common failure modes are missed by existing benchmarks, that nearly half of hallucinated trajectories involve multiple types at once, and that automated detectors with high binary accuracy still misclassify the subtlest types. Trajectory-aware detection significantly outperforms standard post-hoc verification, making taxonomy-grounded evaluation necessary for safer agentic deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Trajel，一个用于审计多智能体工业工作流中轨迹级幻觉的数据集和评估框架，引入五类幻觉分类法（事实性、指代性、逻辑性、程序性和范围性），发现现有基准遗漏了最常见的失败模式，且轨迹感知检测显著优于标准事后验证。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉评估仅关注最终输出，忽略了LLM Agent在推理、使用工具和多步行动过程中的中间步骤（Thought-Action-Observation）产生的轨迹级幻觉，缺乏系统性的评估框架和分类法。
AI.method: 从AssetOpsBench收集专家标注的Agent轨迹，构建包含五类幻觉（事实、指代、逻辑、程序、范围）的分类法，并在子任务、轨迹和长上下文三个级别上基准测试有监督检测模型。
AI.result: 现有基准遗漏了最常见的失败模式；近一半幻觉轨迹同时涉及多种分类；高二元准确率的自动检测器仍会错误分类最微妙的幻觉类型；轨迹感知检测显著优于标准事后验证。
AI.conclusion: 基于分类法的轨迹级幻觉评估对于保障Agent的安全部署至关重要，轨迹感知检测是必要的手段。
idea_en: A multi-type hallucination taxonomy for agent trajectories that categorizes hallucinations into factual, referential, logical, procedural, and scope-based types, enabling systematic auditing of intermediate reasoning steps.
A trajectory-aware hallucination detection framework that evaluates hallucinations at subtask, trajectory, and long-context levels, outperforming standard post-hoc verification methods.
An expert-annotated dataset of multi-agent workflow traces (AssetOpsBench) with labeled trajectory-level hallucinations, designed for benchmarking automated detection models in industrial settings.
idea_ch: 一种多类型轨迹级幻觉分类法，将幻觉分为事实性、指代性、逻辑性、程序性和范围性五类，实现Agent中间推理步骤的系统化审计。
一种轨迹感知的幻觉检测框架，在子任务、轨迹和长上下文三个级别上评估幻觉，性能优于标准事后验证方法。
一个专家标注的多智能体工作流轨迹数据集（AssetOpsBench），包含标记的轨迹级幻觉，用于工业场景下自动化检测模型的基准测试。

title: How Well Do Models Follow Their Constitutions?
comment: 37 pages including appendix. Code, tenet lists, and full transcripts: https://github.com/ajobi-uhc/constitution-audits. Companion blog post on LessWrong/AI Alignment Forum: https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/Tk4SF8qFdMrzGJGGw/how-well-do-models-follow-their-constitutions
summary: Frontier AI developers now train models against long written behavioral specifications, such as Anthropic's constitution (Anthropic, 2025a) and OpenAI's Model Spec (OpenAI, 2025a), integrated into post-training via methods like character training (Anthropic, 2024) and deliberative alignment (Guan et al., 2024). These documents serve a governance function, but it is unclear how well models actually follow them under adversarial, multi-turn pressure similar to what they would face in real-world deployment. We propose a multi-method audit pipeline that treats each lab's published specification as an auditable target: it decomposes the specification into atomic testable tenets (205 for Anthropic, 197 for OpenAI), generates multi-turn adversarial scenarios with the Petri auditing agent (Anthropic, 2025b), runs a modified SURF-style rubric search (Murray et al., 2026) to catch shallow single-turn failures Petri misses, validates flagged transcripts against the relevant specification, and compares the findings against the lab's own published system card. Applying the pipeline across seven models per specification, we find that models follow their own lab's specification substantially better with each generation. On Anthropic's constitution, the Claude family falls from a 15.0% violation rate (Sonnet 4) to 2.0% (Sonnet 4.6); on OpenAI's Model Spec, the GPT family falls from 11.7% (GPT-4o) to 3.6% (GPT-5.2 medium reasoning), with the severity ceiling falling from 10/10 to 7/10. We cannot externally isolate whether these gains come from specification-specific training, broader post-training improvements, or evaluation awareness. Remaining failures cluster around operator-imposed personas under AI-identity questioning, irreversible action in agentic deployments, and fabricated quantitative claims with false precision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多方法审计流水线，系统评估前沿AI模型是否遵循其开发者发布的行为规范（如Anthropic的宪法和OpenAI的Model Spec），发现新一代模型违规率显著下降，但仍存在三类顽固失败模式。
AI.motivation: 前沿AI开发者将书面行为规范整合到模型后训练中，但这些规范在对抗性、多轮交互压力下是否被模型真正遵循尚不清楚，需要进行系统性审计评估。
AI.method: 构建多方法审计流水线：将规范分解为可测试的信条（Anthropic 205条、OpenAI 197条）；使用Petri审计代理生成多轮对抗场景；采用改进的SURF风格搜索捕获浅层单轮失败；对标记的对话记录进行规范验证；与实验室发布的系统卡进行对比。
AI.result: 模型逐代更好地遵循自身规范：Claude家族违规率从15.0%降至2.0%，GPT家族从11.7%降至3.6%，严重度上限从10/10降至7/10。
AI.conclusion: 无法外部隔离改进来源（规范训练、后训练改进或评估感知），剩余失败集中在：AI身份追问下的强加角色人格、代理部署中的不可逆行为、虚假定量声明的错误精度。
idea_en: A multi-method audit pipeline for decomposing written AI behavioral specifications into atomic testable tenets and generating multi-turn adversarial scenarios for specification compliance testing.
A modified SURF-style rubric search technique adapted to catch shallow single-turn specification violations that multi-turn adversarial agents might miss.
A systematic methodology for validating flagged AI transcripts against relevant behavioral specifications and comparing findings against published system cards.
An external auditing framework that treats published AI developer specifications as auditable compliance targets with quantifiable violation rates and severity metrics.
A method for identifying persistent failure modes in AI specification adherence, including operator-imposed personas, irreversible agentic actions, and fabricated quantitative claims.
idea_ch: 一种多方法审计流水线，将书面AI行为规范分解为可测试的原子信条并生成多轮对抗场景以测试规范合规性。
一种改进的SURF风格评分搜索技术，可捕获多轮对抗代理可能遗漏的浅层单轮规范违规行为。
一种系统化方法，用于验证被标记的AI对话记录与相关行为规范的符合性，并与发布的系统卡进行对比。
一种外部审计框架，将已发布的AI开发者规范视为可审计的合规目标，具备可量化的违规率和严重性指标。
一种识别AI规范遵循中持久性失败模式的方法，包括强加角色人格、不可逆代理行为和虚假定量声明。

title: Toward Enactive Artificial Intelligence
summary: In this paper, we advocate for incorporating enactive approaches to perception and cognition into artificial intelligence (AI). Enactive approaches view perception as an active, skillful engagement with the world, where agents perceive by acting and by understanding how their actions shape their experience. This contrasts with classical views that treat perception as a passive internal process in which the brain receives sensory input, processes it, and issues commands for action. Enactive views emphasize the dynamic, embodied, and interactive character of perception, grounded in the lived experience of agents embedded in their environments. We identify and develop four key enactive concepts that we find most relevant to AI: experience, action perception inseparability, autonomy, and embodiment. Much of mainstream AI, from classical rule based systems to large language models, has largely neglected these insights, treating cognition as internal processing detached from embodied interaction and intrinsic normativity. Reinforcement learning (RL), however, exhibits structural resonance with enactive principles through its emphasis on action, agent environment interaction, feedback driven adaptation, and agent centered evaluation. However, this resonance should not be taken as theoretical equivalence, as RL approximates some enactive insights, but key elements remain absent or weakly developed. Building on this analysis, we suggest a broader incorporation of enactive ideas into both mainstream AI and RL.

AI.tldr: 本文倡导将"活性认知"（enactive approaches）融入人工智能，强调感知是通过行动与环境动态互动实现的主动过程，并识别了四个核心概念：经验、行动-感知不可分离性、自主性和具身性。文章指出强化学习（RL）与活性原则存在结构共鸣，但并非理论等同，建议更广泛地将活性思想整合到AI中。
AI.motivation: 主流AI（包括大语言模型）将认知视为脱离具身互动的内部信息处理，忽略了感知的主动性和具身性，需要引入活性认知理论来弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: 识别并发展了四个关键活性概念：经验、行动-感知不可分离性、自主性和具身性；分析主流AI和强化学习与这些概念的契合程度与差距。
AI.result: 强化学习在强调行动、智能体-环境互动、反馈驱动适应和智能体中心评估方面与活性原则有结构共鸣，但关键元素（如主观经验、真正的自主性）仍然缺失或薄弱。
AI.conclusion: 应将活性思想更广泛地融入主流AI和强化学习中，以构建更具生命力和具身性的智能系统。
idea_en: A method for AI perception that integrates action-feedback loops, where an agent's perceptual state is dynamically updated based on its own actions and the resulting sensory consequences in real-time, enabling active perception rather than passive input processing.

A reinforcement learning framework enhanced with enactive autonomy mechanisms, where the agent maintains an internal normative model that evaluates experiences not just by external rewards but by intrinsic, self-generated standards of wellbeing or coherence.

An embodied AI system design where perception and action are implemented as an inseparable, mutually causal dynamical system, with sensory-motor loops forming the core computational primitive rather than separate perception and action modules.

A method for instilling 'lived experience' in AI agents through a continuous, first-person temporal stream of sensorimotor data that is self-referentially organized, allowing the agent to develop a sense of self as distinct from the environment.
idea_ch: 一种将行动-反馈回路整合到AI感知中的方法：智能体的感知状态根据自身行动和实时感官结果动态更新，实现主动感知而非被动输入处理。
一种增强活性自主性的强化学习框架：智能体维护内部规范性模型，不仅根据外部奖励评估经验，还根据内在的、自生成的福祉或一致性标准进行自我评估。
一种具身AI系统设计：感知和行动作为不可分割的、相互因果的动态系统实现，感觉-运动回路作为核心计算原语，而非独立的感知和行动模块。
一种通过连续的第一人称感觉运动数据流为AI智能体注入'经验'的方法：数据以自我参照方式组织，使智能体能够发展出区别于环境的自我意识。

title: Safety-Oriented Routing Analysis of Mixtral MoE Under Benign and Harmful Prompts
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models activate only a small subset of parameters for each token, making router behavior a central part of model computation. This paper studies routing behavior of Mixtral 8x7B-Instruct under benign and harmful prompts using two complementary signals: activation-based routing scores derived from expert selection frequencies and gradient-based scores derived from router-gate sensitivities. We analyze expert- and layer-level routing behavior and conduct expert-suppression interventions. The results show that activation-based expert usage is broad and long-tailed, whereas gradient-based importance is concentrated. At expert level, benign and harmful prompt groups remain close under both signals with modest separation. At layer level, activation-based routing is most selective around layers 8-15, while gradient-based importance is concentrated in final layers. Expert classification shows most experts are shared across benign and harmful prompts, though a limited subset shows clear group preference. Top-ranked expert sets show stronger benign-malicious overlap under gradient scores than activation scores, suggesting concentration on a common late-layer expert set. In intervention experiments, suppressing top five benign-dominant experts from activation scores reduces restricted responses from 24 to 14 over 100 prompts, while suppressing gradient-derived experts reduces them from 34 to 22 with fewer unintended reversals. Overall, safety-relevant routing in Mixtral is subtle, depth-dependent, and distributed rather than dominated by a fixed set of experts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Mixtral 8x7B-Instruct模型在良性与有害提示下的路由行为，通过激活基和梯度基两种信号分析专家选择模式，发现路由行为具有广度、长尾、深度依赖和分布式的特点，安全相关的路由并非由固定专家主导。
AI.motivation: 理解稀疏MoE语言模型中路由行为在安全方面的表现，探索良性提示与有害提示下专家选择模式的差异，以及是否可以通过干预路由行为来提升模型安全性。
AI.method: 使用两种互补信号——基于激活的路由分数（专家选择频率）和基于梯度的分数（路由门敏感性），分析Mixtral 8x7B-Instruct在专家层和层级别上的路由行为，并实施专家抑制干预实验。
AI.result: 激活基专家使用广泛且长尾，梯度基重要性集中；专家级别上良性/有害提示组差异小；激活基路由在8-15层选择性最强，梯度基重要性集中在最后层；多数专家共享于两类提示；抑制激活基前五良性主导专家将受限响应从24降至14，抑制梯度基专家从34降至22且意外反转更少。
AI.conclusion: 安全相关的路由在Mixtral中是微妙的、深度依赖的、分布式的，而非由固定专家集主导。
idea_en: A method for detecting and suppressing safety-critical routing patterns in sparse MoE language models using activation-based expert selection frequency signals.
A gradient-based router-gate sensitivity scoring technique to identify safety-relevant experts in MoE models, enabling targeted expert suppression for harmlessness alignment.
A dual-signal (activation + gradient) routing behavior analysis framework for distinguishing benign vs. harmful prompt processing pathways in MoE language models.
An expert-level intervention method that suppresses top-ranked benign-dominant experts to reduce restricted responses in MoE models while minimizing unintended behavioral reversals.
A layer-dependent routing selectivity analysis technique for identifying safety-critical layers (8-15 for activation, final layers for gradient) in MoE transformer models.
idea_ch: 一种基于激活的专家选择频率信号检测和抑制稀疏MoE语言模型中安全关键路由模式的方法
一种基于梯度的路由门敏感性评分技术，用于识别MoE模型中与安全相关的专家，实现针对性的专家抑制以提升无害性对齐
一种双信号（激活+梯度）路由行为分析框架，用于区分MoE语言模型中良性提示与有害提示的处理路径
一种专家级别干预方法，通过抑制排名靠前的良性主导专家来减少MoE模型中的受限响应，同时最小化意外行为反转
一种层级依赖的路由选择性分析技术，用于识别MoE Transformer模型中安全关键层（激活基为8-15层，梯度基为最后层）
一种基于专家分类的良性/有害提示组偏好识别方法，用于发现MoE模型中有限但具有明确组偏好的专家子集
一种结合激活基和梯度基信号的路由行为互补分析方法，提升对MoE模型内部安全机制的洞察

title: When Does Synthetic Patent Data Help? Volume-Fidelity Trade-offs in Low-Resource Multi-Label Classification
summary: We study when LLM-generated synthetic data helps low-resource multi-label patent classification, separating true synthetic value from the confound that larger augmented sets can win by volume alone. Across six open-source LLMs (3.8-12B), four real-data regimes, 64 WIPO assistive-technology labels, two generation strategies, and three classifier families, the headline BERT-for-Patents micro-F1 jump from 0.120 to 0.702 is largely volume-driven. A duplicate-to-match real-only control that resamples 165 patents to the augmented size reaches 0.678; the controlled synthetic gain is only +0.024 over this control, but +0.219 over focal-loss reweighting, the strongest non-augmentation baseline. The main finding is that fidelity metrics change meaning with scale: at extreme scarcity, MMD correlates positively with classification gain (r=+0.95), but at 1:10 the relation flips (r=-0.73; Fisher z=+6.47, p<0.001). Fixed-budget mixing finds a 20-30% real / 70-80% synthetic optimum; paraphrase scaling collapses from a 165-document seed; and shuffled mixing beats curriculum ordering, ensembling, and classifier-based filtering. Leakage controls -- label-name masking, instruction-level label removal, fine-grained evaluation, and keyword-overlap audits -- argue against label-string dependence as the main driver for BERT-for-Patents. The apparent ModernBERT collapse under label removal is traced to a Flash-Attention-2 + bf16 numerical artifact, recovering 65% of lost performance with fp32 eager attention. Finally, the same corpus that improves classification by up to +0.58 raw micro-F1 hurts a Jaccard-label-overlap retrieval proxy; even a standard-patent-only filter leaves a 26% nDCG@10 drop. Thus, synthetic patent text is task- and metric-specific, not reducible to prompt genre alone.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统分析了LLM生成的合成数据对低资源多标签专利分类的影响，发现性能提升主要来自数据量增加而非合成数据质量，并通过严格对照实验揭示了合成数据的真实增益有限。
AI.motivation: 当前低资源专利分类中，LLM合成数据的使用日益普遍，但尚不清楚性能提升是源于合成数据的独特价值还是仅仅因为数据量增加。作者旨在通过严格对照实验，将真实合成价值与体积效应分离。
AI.method: 使用6个开源LLM（3.8-12B）、4种真实数据规模、64个WIPO辅助技术标签、2种生成策略和3种分类器家族，设计"重复至匹配"的真实数据对照实验，进行规模控制、固定预算混合、泄露控制和数值稳定性验证。
AI.result: BERT-for-Patents micro-F1从0.120提升至0.702主要是由数据量驱动，重复至匹配的真实数据对照达到0.678，合成真实增益仅+0.024；MMD与分类增益的相关性在极端稀缺时为正（r=+0.95），1:10时翻转（r=-0.73）；20-30%真实/70-80%合成为最优混合比；发现了ModernBERT在Flash-Attention-2+bf16下的数值问题。
AI.conclusion: 合成专利文本对分类任务的帮助主要是数据量贡献，其真实增益有限；合成数据的效果依赖于具体任务和评估指标，不能简单归结为提示工程；并且存在数值稳定性和下游任务负迁移等重要工程问题。
idea_en: A method for controlled evaluation of synthetic data value in low-resource classification, using duplicate-to-match real-only resampling as a baseline control to isolate volume-driven gains from genuine synthetic improvement.
A fixed-budget mixing strategy for combining real and synthetic patent data, identifying an optimal 20-30% real / 70-80% synthetic composition ratio for multi-label classification.

A MMD-based scaling-aware fidelity metric that adapts its interpretation based on dataset size, with a positive-to-negative correlation flip detection mechanism for determining synthetic data utility.

A method for detecting numerical artifacts in transformer attention mechanisms (specifically Flash-Attention-2 + bf16) that cause performance collapse, with recovery via fp32 eager attention fallback.
