title: GRAIL: AI translation for scientists application workflow on satellite data
summary: Domain scientists increasingly develop Python scripts to analyze satellite imagery but they lack scalability to large-scale data. This paper demonstrates GRAIL, an agentic translation system that converts Python geospatial workflows into executable Spark-based programs without requiring scientists to learn a new framework. Rather than fine-tuning a specialized LLM model, GRAIL adapts RDPro, a Scala library for satellite data analysis, to make it LLM-ready using structured documentation, API alias functions, and repair-oriented error logs. Translation is structured as a LangGraph pipeline that decomposes code generation into explicit sections with guided inputs and outputs, enabling targeted repair without regenerating the full program. We demonstrate GRAIL on real-world geospatial workflows and showcase the correctness and scalability of the translated code.

AI.tldr: GRAIL是一个智能体翻译系统，能将Python地理空间工作流自动转换为可执行的Spark程序，无需科学家学习新框架。它通过结构化文档、API别名和修复导向的错误日志使RDPro库适配LLM，并采用LangGraph管道将代码生成分解为显式模块，实现针对性修复。
AI.motivation: 领域科学家常用Python脚本分析卫星影像，但这些脚本无法扩展到大规模数据处理，而学习Spark等分布式框架门槛过高。
AI.method: GRAIL采用三种关键方法：1) 将RDPro（Scala地理空间库）通过结构化文档、API别名函数和修复导向的错误日志改造为LLM友好；2) 构建LangGraph管道，将代码生成分解为带引导输入输出的显式模块；3) 支持针对性修复，无需重新生成完整程序。
AI.result: 在真实地理空间工作流上验证了翻译后代码的正确性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需微调专用LLM的智能翻译系统，有效降低了科学家使用大规模数据处理框架的门槛。
idea_en: An agentic translation system (e.g., GRAIL) that automatically converts Python geospatial analysis scripts into executable Spark-based distributed programs without requiring domain scientists to learn the Spark framework.

A method for adapting an existing Scala library (RDPro) for satellite data analysis to become LLM-ready through structured documentation, API alias functions, and repair-oriented error logs, eliminating the need for fine-tuning a specialized LLM model.

A LangGraph-based pipeline architecture for code translation that decomposes code generation into explicit sections with guided inputs and outputs, enabling targeted repair of individual sections without regenerating the entire program.
idea_ch: 一种智能体翻译系统（如GRAIL），可自动将Python地理空间分析脚本转换为可执行的Spark分布式程序，无需领域科学家学习Spark框架。
一种通过结构化文档、API别名函数和修复导向的错误日志，将现有的Scala卫星数据分析库（RDPro）改造为LLM友好的方法，避免了微调专用LLM模型的需求。
一种基于LangGraph管道的代码翻译架构，将代码生成分解为具有引导输入输出的显式模块，支持对单个模块进行针对性修复而无需重新生成整个程序。

title: PANDO: Efficient Multimodal AI Agents via Online Skill Distillation
summary: Recent advances in multimodal web agents often rely on increased inference-time computation, including rollout search, verifier passes, offline skill discovery, and specialist model stacks. This raises a central question: can a web agent become more efficient as it accumulates experience, rather than more expensive? We first analyze trajectories from VisualWebArena and identify three recurring sources of inefficiency: repeat-action loops, hidden discovery costs, and low prompt-cache reuse. We then introduce PANDO, a single-rollout online skill-distillation framework that maintains a structured Skill Library and combines progress reflection, confidence-based skill demotion, hierarchical routing, visual compression, and cache-aware prompting. On the full set of 910 VisualWebArena tasks, PANDO achieves a 58.3% success rate, outperforming SGV (54.0%) and our WALT reproduction (45.2%), while using 58% fewer tokens than SGV and 61% fewer tokens than WALT, without any pre-evaluation discovery budget. A 300-task ablation further shows that rules and routines provide most of the success gains, while routing, compression, and cache-aware prompting convert the larger skill library into lower marginal token cost. Finally, we introduce three trajectory-level efficiency metrics -- Action Repetition Rate, Step Overhead Ratio, and Prompt Cache Utilization -- to make efficiency visible beyond terminal success.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PANDO框架，通过在线技能蒸馏、结构化技能库、缓存感知提示等技术，使Web代理在经验积累中变得更高效而非更昂贵，在VisualWebArena上以更低token消耗达到更高成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态Web代理依赖增加推理时间计算（如rollout搜索、验证器、离线技能发现等），导致成本随经验增长而上升。作者希望探索代理能否在积累经验时变得更高效而非更昂贵。
AI.method: PANDO框架包含：(1) 结构化技能库 (Structured Skill Library)；(2) 进度反思 (Progress Reflection)；(3) 基于置信度的技能降级 (Confidence-based Skill Demotion)；(4) 层次化路由 (Hierarchical Routing)；(5) 视觉压缩 (Visual Compression)；(6) 缓存感知提示 (Cache-aware Prompting)。采用单rollout在线技能蒸馏，无需预评估发现预算。
AI.result: 在910个VisualWebArena任务上，PANDO达到58.3%成功率，优于SGV(54.0%)和WALT(45.2%)，同时token消耗比SGV少58%、比WALT少61%。300任务消融实验显示规则和例程贡献大部分成功增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化技能库和缓存感知设计，Web代理可以随经验积累变得更高效，而非仅靠增加推理计算。本文还提出了三个轨迹级效率指标：动作重复率、步骤开销比和提示缓存利用率。
idea_en: A structured skill library maintenance method for web agents that dynamically organizes discovered skills with progress reflection and confidence-based skill demotion mechanisms
A cache-aware prompting technique that optimizes prompt construction to maximize reuse of previously computed prompt caches in multimodal web agents
A hierarchical routing mechanism for web agents that selects between high-level routines and low-level atomic actions based on task complexity and confidence scores
A visual compression method for web agent trajectories that selectively compresses visual information to reduce token consumption while maintaining task performance
A single-rollout online skill distillation framework that eliminates the need for pre-evaluation discovery budgets in web agent training
Trajectory-level efficiency metrics for web agents: Action Repetition Rate, Step Overhead Ratio, and Prompt Cache Utilization, enabling systematic efficiency measurement beyond terminal success
idea_ch: 一种用于Web代理的结构化技能库维护方法，通过进度反思和基于置信度的技能降级机制动态组织已发现的技能
一种缓存感知提示技术，优化提示构建以最大化多模态Web代理中先前计算的提示缓存的复用
一种Web代理的层次化路由机制，基于任务复杂度和置信度分数在高层次例程和低层次原子动作之间进行选择
一种Web代理轨迹的视觉压缩方法，选择性压缩视觉信息以减少token消耗同时保持任务性能
一种单rollout在线技能蒸馏框架，消除Web代理训练中预评估发现预算的需求
面向Web代理的轨迹级效率度量指标：动作重复率、步骤开销比和提示缓存利用率，实现超越终端成功的系统性效率测量

title: CoRe-Code: Collaborative Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in code generation, but most methods rely on autoregressive decoding without global planning, often leading to locally coherent yet globally suboptimal solutions (e.g., failing test cases or inefficient complexity). While recent approaches such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and multi-agent systems (MAS) introduce planning, their limited role specialization and coordination hinder performance on complex tasks. To address the challenges of coordination and specialization in multi-agent code generation, we propose Collaborative Reinforcement Code (CoRe-Code), a framework for role specialized LLM agents that enhances inter-agent coordination to generate more accurate and efficient code. CoRe-Code adopts a simple Planner-Coder paradigm, where the Planner produces high-level plans and the Coder executes them to generate code. We further introduce a collaboration-aware reinforcement learning stage based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to enhance role specialization and alignment. Experiments show that CoRe-Code outperforms a wide range of existing RL-based and multi-agent methods. In addition, we demonstrate that CoRe-Code can generalize to other multi-agent frameworks (e.g., Retrieval and Debugging agents), highlighting its flexibility and scalability. We evaluate CoRe-Code on multiple benchmarks of varying difficulty using three base models. Compared to existing baselines, the results show consistent improvements in accuracy, while also achieving higher efficiency in terms of execution time and memory usage, demonstrating the effectiveness and practicality of CoRe-Code.

AI.tldr: 提出Collaborative Reinforcement Code (CoRe-Code)框架，通过Planner-Coder范式和基于GRPO的协作感知强化学习，增强多智能体LLM在代码生成中的角色专业化和智能体间协调，在准确性和效率上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码生成方法采用自回归解码缺乏全局规划，CoT和多智能体系统存在角色专业化不足和协调性差的问题，导致复杂任务生成效率低、测试失败率高。
AI.method: 采用Planner-Coder范式，Planner生成高层计划，Coder执行计划生成代码；引入基于Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)的协作感知强化学习阶段，增强角色专业化和智能体间对齐。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，使用三种基础模型，CoRe-Code在准确率、执行时间和内存使用上均优于现有RL方法和多智能体方法，并展现出良好的泛化性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: CoRe-Code通过Planner-Coder结构和GRPO强化学习，有效解决了多智能体代码生成中的角色专业化和协调问题，是一种高效实用的方法。
idea_en: A collaborative reinforcement learning framework for multi-agent code generation adopting a Planner-Coder paradigm, where Planner generates high-level plans and Coder executes code generation.
A collaboration-aware reinforcement learning method based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that enhances role specialization and inter-agent alignment in multi-agent systems.
A role-specialized LLM agent coordination mechanism that improves both code accuracy and execution efficiency (time and memory) in complex code generation tasks.
A generalizable multi-agent framework that supports integration with other agent types (e.g., Retrieval and Debugging agents) through the Planner-Coder paradigm and GRPO-based training.
idea_ch: 一种采用Planner-Coder范式的多智能体代码生成协作强化学习框架，Planner生成高层计划，Coder执行代码生成。
一种基于Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)的协作感知强化学习方法，增强多智能体系统中角色专业化和智能体间对齐。
一种角色专业化的LLM智能体协调机制，在复杂代码生成任务中同时提升代码准确性和执行效率（时间与内存）。
一种可泛化的多智能体框架，通过Planner-Coder范式和GRPO训练支持与其他智能体类型（如检索和调试智能体）集成。

title: Agent Manufacturing: Foundation-Model Agents as First-Class Industrial Entities
summary: Manufacturing has passed through four widely recognized paradigms - mechanization, electrification, programmable automation, and Smart Manufacturing - each defined by the kind of work it shifted from humans to machines. In every case, one layer of industrial work remained fundamentally human: the coordinative cognition of production, comprising the interpretive, allocative, diagnostic, negotiative, and governance work exercised by engineers, planners, and operational managers. We argue that a fifth transition is now underway in which this layer, rather than the physical or routine-cognitive layers below it, is what foundation-model-based autonomous agents primarily redistribute. We name this paradigm Agent Manufacturing and define it operationally: a manufacturing system is an instance of Agent Manufacturing when its principal coordination mechanism is reasoning performed by foundation-model agents that can interpret open-ended goals, plan over long horizons, invoke tools and machines, and negotiate with other agents and humans. This is a narrower and more falsifiable definition than the existing literature on cognitive manufacturing or Industry 5.0 provides, and it distinguishes the paradigm sharply from classical multi-agent manufacturing systems, which were autonomous only within closed protocol spaces.

AI.tldr: 论文提出第五次制造范式——Agent Manufacturing（智能体制造），其核心特征是基于基础模型（Foundation Model）的自主智能体取代人类进行生产中的协调认知工作（解释、分配、诊断、协商、治理），这与前四个范式（机械化、电气化、可编程自动化、智能制造）本质不同。
AI.motivation: 历次制造范式虽然将物理劳动和常规认知劳动从人类转移给机器，但生产的协调认知层（工程师、规划师、运营管理者的工作）始终由人类承担。本文旨在论证这一层正在被基础模型智能体重新分配，从而定义第五个制造范式。
AI.method: 通过回顾制造范式的历史演进（机械化→电气化→可编程自动化→智能制造），分析每个范式转移的人类工作类型，进而提出Agent Manufacturing的操作性定义：当制造系统的主要协调机制是基于基础模型的智能体进行推理——能够解释开放目标、长期规划、调用工具/机器、与其他智能体和人类协商——则属于该范式。
AI.result: 提出了Agent Manufacturing范式的形式化、可证伪定义，将其与现有的认知制造/工业5.0文献区分开来，并明确指出该范式与经典多智能体制造系统的本质区别：后者仅在封闭协议空间内具有自主性，而前者基于基础模型的开放推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 第五次制造范式——Agent Manufacturing——正在发生，其核心是基础模型智能体接管生产的协调认知层。该定义比现有文献更精确、更具可验证性，为未来制造系统的设计和研究提供了新方向。
idea_en: A method for autonomous manufacturing coordination where foundation-model agents interpret open-ended production goals, plan over long horizons, invoke tools/machines, and negotiate with other agents and humans without relying on closed protocol spaces.

A system architecture for Agent Manufacturing where the primary coordination mechanism is reasoning performed by foundation-model agents, replacing human engineers, planners, and operational managers in interpretive, allocative, diagnostic, negotiative, and governance tasks.

A paradigm-defining operational framework that distinguishes foundation-model-based autonomous manufacturing agents from classical multi-agent manufacturing systems by enabling open-ended goal interpretation and cross-agent negotiation beyond fixed protocols.
idea_ch: 一种基于基础模型的自主制造协调方法：智能体能够解释开放式生产目标、进行长周期规划、调用工具/机器、并与其他智能体和人类协商，无需依赖封闭协议空间。
一种智能体制造系统架构：以基础模型智能体的推理作为主要协调机制，替代人类工程师、规划师和运营管理者执行解释、分配、诊断、协商和治理等认知工作。
一种区分智能体制造与经典多智能体制造系统的操作性框架：核心创新在于基础模型智能体具备开放式目标解释能力及跨智能体协商能力，突破传统封闭协议空间的自主性限制。

title: Test-Time Deep Thinking to Explore Implicit Rules
summary: With the continuous advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), intelligent agents are becoming increasingly vital. However, these agents often fail in environments governed by implicit rules--hidden constraints that cannot be observed directly and must be inferred through interaction. This causes agents to fall into repetitive trial-and-error loops, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose Test-Time Exploration (TTExplore), a framework where a thinker component analyzes interaction history to infer these implicit rules and guide an actor. Effective exploration in this setting critically depends on the reasoning ability of the thinker. However, evaluating deep reasoning trajectories is inherently unstable and difficult, which poses a major obstacle to effective training. To overcome this issue, we introduce a novel and stable reinforcement learning pipeline. The core idea is to use accurate task-level scores as indirect rewards to bypass the difficulty of evaluating intermediate reasoning, and to retain only a single thinking node per trajectory to alleviate reward sparsity. Using this pipeline, we train a specialized 7B model, Exp-Thinker. Experiments on five text-based embodied tasks show that TTExplore equipped with Exp-Thinker improves baseline agent performance by an average of $14$-$19$ points, demonstrating the effectiveness of explicitly reasoning about implicit rules.

AI.tldr: 提出TTExplore框架，通过训练专门的Exp-Thinker模型来推理环境中的隐式规则，从而提升智能体在文本型具身任务中的表现，平均提升14-19个点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在存在隐式规则（无法直接观察、需通过交互推断的隐藏约束）的环境中经常失败，陷入重复试错循环导致任务失败。
AI.method: 提出TTExplore框架，包含thinker（分析交互历史推理隐式规则）和actor（根据推理结果行动）。核心创新是新颖的稳定强化学习流水线：使用准确的任务级分数作为间接奖励（避免评估中间推理的不稳定性），每个轨迹仅保留单个思考节点（缓解奖励稀疏性），训练出7B参数的Exp-Thinker模型。
AI.result: 在五个基于文本的具身任务上，TTExplore+Exp-Thinker将基线智能体性能平均提升14-19个点。
AI.conclusion: 明确推理隐式规则能有效提升智能体在复杂环境中的表现，所提出的稳定RL训练流水线可行且有效。
idea_en: A test-time exploration framework (TTExplore) where a thinker component analyzes interaction history to infer implicit environmental rules and guides an actor component for task execution.
A stable reinforcement learning pipeline that uses accurate task-level scores as indirect rewards to bypass the difficulty of evaluating intermediate reasoning trajectories.
A reinforcement learning training method that retains only a single thinking node per trajectory to alleviate reward sparsity in reasoning about implicit rules.
A specialized 7B language model (Exp-Thinker) trained via the stable RL pipeline to explicitly reason about implicit environmental rules in embodied tasks.
A method for improving LLM-based agent performance in text-based embodied tasks by combining explicit implicit rule reasoning with reinforcement learning.
idea_ch: 一种测试时探索框架（TTExplore），包含thinker组件（分析交互历史推断隐式规则）和actor组件（根据推断结果执行任务），用于提升智能体在隐式规则环境中的表现。
一种稳定的强化学习训练流水线，使用准确的任务级分数作为间接奖励，绕过对中间推理轨迹进行评估的困难。
一种强化学习训练方法，每个轨迹仅保留单个思考节点，缓解隐式规则推理场景中的奖励稀疏性问题。
一种通过稳定RL流水线训练得到的7B专业模型Exp-Thinker，专门用于在具身任务中显式推理隐式环境规则。
一种将显式隐式规则推理与强化学习相结合的方法，用于提升基于LLM的智能体在文本型具身任务中的表现。

title: Geo-Expert: Towards Expert-Level Geological Reasoning via Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026 AI for Science Workshop
summary: While general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) applied to Geology often hallucinate when reasoning about subsurface structures and deep-time evolution, current AI in Earth sciences predominantly targets surface remote sensing and GIS. To bridge this gap, we introduce Geo-Expert, a family of parameter-efficient geological LLMs fine-tuned on a custom-curated, high-quality instruction dataset processed using our custom instruction synthesis pipeline. We investigate the impact of model scaling and architecture by fine-tuning three base models: Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, and Gemma-3-27B, with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) method. Our extensive evaluation on a novel domain-specific benchmark, Geo-Eval, reveals that a domain-aligned 8B model can outperform open-weight 70B generalists and proprietary GPT-4o on specialized geological reasoning, while a 32B variant approaches frontier reasoning models. The optimized 8B model further offers a competitive cost-performance ratio for deployment. This work provides a reproducible recipe for democratizing scientific LLMs and establishes a baseline for geological artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Geo-Expert，一系列参数高效的地质学专用大语言模型。通过LoRA微调Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B和Gemma-3-27B，并基于自建高质量指令数据集训练。在自研基准Geo-Eval上，8B领域模型超越70B通用模型和GPT-4o，32B模型接近前沿推理模型。为地质AI提供了可复现的基线方案。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型在地质学中推理地下结构和深时演化时经常产生幻觉，而当前地球科学AI主要针对地表遥感和GIS。为弥合这一差距，需要专门的地质学LLM。
AI.method: 1) 构建自定义指令合成管道，生成高质量地质学指令数据集。2) 使用LoRA方法对Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B、Gemma-3-27B三个基座模型进行参数高效微调。3) 创建新领域专用评估基准Geo-Eval进行系统评估。
AI.result: 领域对齐的8B模型在地质推理上超越70B通用模型和GPT-4o；32B模型接近前沿推理模型；8B模型在部署上具有竞争力的性价比。
AI.conclusion: 提供了可复现的科学LLM民主化方案，为地质人工智能建立了基线。
idea_en: A custom instruction synthesis pipeline for generating high-quality, domain-specific geological training data from raw geological texts, enabling scalable creation of specialized fine-tuning datasets.
Parameter-efficient geological LLM family (Geo-Expert) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on base models of varying scales (8B-32B) for optimized geological reasoning.
A novel domain-specific benchmark (Geo-Eval) designed to evaluate geological reasoning capabilities of LLMs, covering subsurface structures and deep-time evolution.
Demonstration that a domain-aligned 8B parameter model can outperform 70B general-purpose models and GPT-4o on specialized geological reasoning tasks, enabling cost-effective deployment.
A reproducible recipe for democratizing scientific LLMs through LoRA fine-tuning on custom-curated domain instruction data, applicable beyond geology.
idea_ch: 一种自定义指令合成管道，从原始地质文本中自动生成高质量、领域专用的地质学训练数据，支持专业化微调数据集的可规模化构建。
基于LoRA的参数高效地质学大语言模型家族（Geo-Expert），在不同规模基座模型（8B-32B）上微调，实现优化的地质推理能力。
一种新型领域专用评估基准（Geo-Eval），专为评估大语言模型在地质推理方面的能力而设计，涵盖地下结构和深时演化。
展示了领域对齐的8B参数模型在专业地质推理任务上超越70B通用模型和GPT-4o，实现高性价比部署。
一种通过LoRA在自定义领域指令数据上微调来民主化科学LLM的可复现方案，可推广至地质学以外的其他科学领域。

title: Solving Combinatorial Counting Problems with Weighted First-Order Model Counting
summary: Combinatorial counting problems pervade artificial intelligence, statistics, and discrete mathematics. Whether the task is enumerating subsets, multisets, permutations, partitions, or compositions under structural and arithmetic constraints, solving it remains a stubbornly manual exercise. Closed-form derivations are powerful but brittle, while naive encodings to propositional model counting or constraint satisfaction destroy the exchangeability that makes counting tractable in the first place. We present Cofola (COmbinatorial counting LAnguage with First-Order logic), a typed declarative language whose primitives are the combinatorial objects that recur in everyday counting questions, including sets, bags, tuples, sequences, circles, partitions, and compositions, together with natural relational and arithmetic constraints over them. A denotational semantics maps every Cofola program to a well-defined combinatorial counting problem, and a three-phase compilation pipeline (preprocessing, decomposition, and symmetry-preserving encoding) reduces this problem to a weighted first-order model counting (WFOMC) instance augmented with coefficient-extraction constraints. To stay inside known domain-liftable fragments whenever possible, the encoding groups indistinguishable entities, breaks the symmetry of unordered groupings lexicographically, and encodes sequences and circles via order axioms. On a suite of representative combinatorial counting problems, ranging from textbook math problems to multi-object scenarios that the closest prior framework cannot express, Cofola produces concise specifications and a uniform solving pipeline that is practical end-to-end.

AI.tldr: Cofola是一种新型组合计数语言，将集合、排列、划分等组合对象作为语言原语，通过三阶段编译流水线自动转化为加权一阶模型计数问题，实现了组合计数问题的自动化端到端求解。
AI.motivation: 组合计数问题在AI、统计学和离散数学中广泛存在，但现有方法要么依赖脆弱的手动闭式推导，要么通过命题模型计数或约束满足的朴素编码破坏了关键的交换性，导致计数不易处理。
AI.method: 设计了一种类型化声明式语言Cofola，其原语为组合计数中常见的对象类型（集合、多重集、元组、序列、圆排列、划分、组合等），支持关系和算术约束。采用指称语义将每个Cofola程序映射为良定义的组合计数问题。三阶段编译管线：预处理（类型检查、约束规范化）、分解（将高层组合结构分解为基本组件）、对称保持编码（通过分组不可区分实体、字典序打破无序分组对称性、序公理编码序列/圆排列）将问题转化为WFOMC实例。
AI.result: 在从教科书数学问题到多对象场景的代表性组合计数问题集上，Cofola产生了简洁的规格说明和统一的求解管线，实现了端到端的实用性，且能表达之前框架无法表达的问题。
AI.conclusion: Cofola作为一种新型声明式计数语言，通过一阶逻辑和对称性保持编码，使得组合计数问题的求解从手动推导变为自动化端到端流程，在广泛问题上兼具简洁性和实用性。
idea_en: A typed declarative counting language (Cofola) that uses combinatorial objects (sets, bags, tuples, sequences, circles, partitions, compositions) as primitives with relational and arithmetic constraints, automatically compiling them to weighted first-order model counting (WFOMC) instances.

A three-phase compilation pipeline (preprocessing, decomposition, symmetry-preserving encoding) that transforms high-level combinatorial counting programs into WFOMC instances while preserving exchangeability.
A symmetry-preserving encoding method that groups indistinguishable entities, breaks unordered grouping symmetry via lexicographic ordering, and encodes sequences and circles using order axioms.
A coefficient-extraction constraint augmented WFOMC method that extends traditional weighted first-order model counting to handle coefficient-bearing combinatorial counting problems.

A unified end-to-end solving pipeline for combinatorial counting that automates previously manual closed-form derivations across a wide range of problems from textbook exercises to multi-object scenarios.
idea_ch: 一种基于类型化声明式语言的组合计数系统：将集合、多重集、元组、序列、圆排列、划分、组合等组合对象作为语言原语，配合关系和算术约束，自动编译为加权一阶模型计数实例。
一种三阶段编译流水线（预处理-分解-对称保持编码）：将高层组合计数程序自动转化为WFOMC实例，通过分组不可区分实体、字典序打破无序分组的对称性、以及使用序公理编码序列和圆排列来保持对称性。
一种对称性保持编码方法：对无序分组（如集合、多重集）采用字典序约束打破对称性，对序列和圆排列使用序公理编码，从而保持交换性不丢失。
一种系数提取约束增强的加权一阶模型计数方法：在传统WFOMC基础上引入系数提取约束，使得可处理带系数/系数的组合计数问题。
一种组合计数问题的统一求解管线：将以往需要手动推导的封闭式组合计数问题（从教科书数学题到多对象场景）自动转化为可计算的一阶逻辑模型计数问题并求解。

title: Clustering as Reasoning: A $k$-Means Interpretation of Chain-of-Thought Graph Learning
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has shown promise in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) on text-attributed graphs (TAGs). This work reframes CoT-based graph learning through the principle of clustering as reasoning, offering a $k$-means interpretation of how iterative reasoning operates over graph-structured data. We observe that existing graph CoT methods rely on disjoint architectures and fixed graph representations, limiting step-by-step semantic-topological interaction and interpretability. To overcome this limitation, we propose a unified framework named KCoT that integrates CoT reasoning with graph representation learning. Our key theoretical result reveals a formal mathematical correspondence between a Transformer block and the $k$-means algorithm, allowing reasoning to be interpreted as iterative assignment and update steps. Based on this insight, we introduce a Semantic Discriminating Prompt that explicitly formulates these steps as structured CoT reasoning, together with a structure-grounded alignment strategy to fuse topological priors with evolving thought-conditioned representations. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods, validating clustering as a principled mechanism for CoT-based graph learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KCoT框架，将CoT推理与图表示学习统一，通过k-means聚类解释迭代推理过程，并引入语义判别提示和结构对齐策略，在文本属性图任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图CoT方法依赖分离的架构和固定的图表示，限制了逐步语义-拓扑交互和可解释性，缺乏统一的推理机制。
AI.method: KCoT框架：(1) 理论证明Transformer块与k-means算法的数学对应关系，将推理解释为迭代分配和更新步骤；(2) 引入语义判别提示(SDP)将推理步骤形式化为结构化CoT；(3) 结构对齐策略融合拓扑先验与演化中的思维表征。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试上一致优于现有最先进方法，验证了聚类作为CoT图学习的基础机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 聚类可以作为图结构数据上CoT推理的原则性机制，KCoT统一了语义与拓扑交互，提升了可解释性和性能。
idea_en: Patent Idea 1: A method that formally establishes a mathematical correspondence between a Transformer block and the k-means algorithm, enabling iterative reasoning to be interpreted as assignment and update steps for graph-structured data.

Patent Idea 2: A Semantic Discriminating Prompt mechanism that explicitly formulates iterative clustering steps (assignment and update) as structured Chain-of-Thought reasoning steps for text-attributed graphs.
Patent Idea 3: A structure-grounded alignment strategy that fuses topological priors with evolving thought-conditioned representations during CoT reasoning on graphs.

Patent Idea 4: A unified framework (KCoT) integrating Chain-of-Thought reasoning with graph representation learning, where reasoning steps correspond to iterative clustering assignments and centroid updates.
Patent Idea 5: A clustering-as-reasoning paradigm for graph learning, where node assignments to reasoning clusters are iteratively refined based on both semantic and topological information.
idea_ch: 专利思路1：一种建立Transformer块与k-means算法之间正式数学对应关系的方法，将图结构数据上的迭代推理解释为分配和更新步骤。
专利思路2：一种语义判别提示机制，将迭代聚类步骤（分配和更新）显式形式化为文本属性图上的结构化思维链推理步骤。
专利思路3：一种结构对齐策略，在图上的思维链推理过程中将拓扑先验与演化的思维表征相融合。
专利思路4：一种统一框架(KCoT)，将思维链推理与图表示学习集成，其中推理步骤对应于迭代聚类分配和质心更新。
专利思路5：一种聚类即推理的图学习范式，其中节点到推理聚类的分配基于语义和拓扑信息进行迭代优化。

title: Inverting the Shield: Systematically Generating Safety Tests from Policy Specifications
comment: Accepted to the 64th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL 2026)
summary: The widespread integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) necessitates rigorous and systematic safety evaluation. Existing paradigms either rely on constructed benchmarks to assess safety from predefined perspectives, or employ dynamic red-teaming to probe potential vulnerabilities. While effective, these approaches face challenges, as they depend heavily on expert domain knowledge, offer limited systematic guarantees, and are vulnerable to rapid obsolescence. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel framework POLARIS that brings the rigor of specification-based software testing to AI safety. POLARIS first compiles unstructured natural-language policies into First-Order Logic (FOL) representations, establishing a traceable link between high-level rules and concrete test cases. This formalization enables the construction of a Semantic Policy Graph, where complex policy violation scenarios are encoded as traversable paths. By systematically exploring this graph, POLARIS uncovers compositional violation patterns, which are then instantiated into executable natural-language test queries, enabling coverage-driven and reproducible safety testing. Experiments demonstrate that POLARIS achieves higher policy coverage and attack success counts compared to established baselines. Crucially, by bridging formal methods and AI safety, POLARIS provides a principled, automated approach to ensuring LLMs adhere to safety-critical policies with verifiable traceability. We release our code at https://github.com/huac-lxy/POLARIS.

AI.tldr: POLARIS是一个将规范驱动软件测试的严谨性引入AI安全的框架，通过将自然语言政策形式化为FOL逻辑表示，构建语义策略图，系统探索策略违规模式，实现高覆盖、可重复的LLM安全测试。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全评估方法依赖专家知识、缺乏系统保证且易过时，需要一种更严谨、自动化、可追溯的安全测试方法。
AI.method: 1) 将非结构化自然语言策略编译为一阶逻辑(FOL)表示；2) 构建语义策略图(Semantic Policy Graph)编码复杂违规场景为可遍历路径；3) 系统遍历图发现组合违规模式；4) 实例化为可执行的自然语言测试查询。
AI.result: 相较于现有基线方法，POLARIS实现了更高的政策覆盖率和攻击成功次数。
AI.conclusion: POLARIS通过桥接形式化方法与AI安全，提供了一种有原则的、自动化的方法，确保LLM遵循安全关键策略，并具有可验证的可追溯性。
idea_en: A method for converting unstructured natural-language safety policies into First-Order Logic (FOL) representations to establish traceable links between high-level rules and concrete test cases.
A Semantic Policy Graph construction technique that encodes complex policy violation scenarios as traversable paths for systematic safety testing.
A coverage-driven approach to exploring compositional violation patterns in policy graphs for automated test case generation.
A system that bridges formal specification-based software testing with AI safety verification for Large Language Models.
idea_ch: 一种将非结构化自然语言安全策略编译为一阶逻辑(FOL)表示的方法，建立高层规则与具体测试用例之间的可追溯链接
一种语义策略图构建技术，将复杂策略违规场景编码为可遍历路径，用于系统性安全测试
一种覆盖驱动的策略图组合违规模式探索方法，实现自动化测试用例生成
一种将形式化规范软件测试与AI安全验证相结合的LLM安全评估系统

title: TaBIIC2: Interactive Building of Ontological Taxonomies using Weighted Self-Organizing Maps
summary: Ontologies represent the conceptual knowledge of a domain. At the core of an ontology is the taxonomy of concepts and subconcepts that represent specific entities, which can be complex to build. In many cases, information is available in the form of records describing the characteristics of relevant entities, i.e., tabular data. Identifying patterns and similarities in such data can serve as a basis for identifying concepts and organizing them. However, doing so manually can be challenging, and purely automatic approaches, such as agglomerative clustering or relying on a large language model to analyze the data, can leave the user with overwhelming results and little control. In this paper, we describe a tool that enables the progressive and interactive construction of a taxonomy of concepts by identifying clusters as well as their intentional definitions. To do so, we rely on weighted self-organizing maps as a clustering method because they enable the creation of an arbitrary number of clusters that are distinct with respect to the distributions of values of specific characteristics of the clustered entities. We show that, by integrating this mechanism and others for rapidly creating concepts that group together instances from tabular data, this tool represents a middle ground between purely manual analysis and automatic methods for building ontological taxonomies.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种基于加权自组织映射的交互式工具，用于从表格数据中渐进式构建本体分类体系，实现了手动分析与自动方法之间的平衡。
AI.motivation: 本体分类体系的构建复杂耗时，纯手动分析困难，纯自动方法（如层次聚类或大语言模型）结果过多且用户难以控制，缺乏交互性。
AI.method: 提出一种工具，利用加权自组织映射（Weighted Self-Organizing Maps）作为聚类方法，能够根据实体特征值分布创建任意数量的不同聚类，并支持用户逐步交互式地构建分类体系及概念内涵定义。
AI.result: 该工具在手动分析与自动方法之间取得了平衡，支持快速从表格数据中创建概念分组，实现渐进式的本体分类体系构建。
AI.conclusion: 加权自组织映射结合交互式机制是构建本体分类体系的有效中间方案，既保留了用户控制权，又提高了构建效率。
idea_en: A method for interactive taxonomy construction from tabular data using weighted self-organizing maps (WSOM) that generates clusters based on value distributions of entity characteristics
A system that enables progressive ontology building by allowing users to iteratively identify clusters and define their intensional definitions through an interactive interface
A hybrid approach combining weighted self-organizing maps with manual refinement for semi-automatic ontological taxonomy creation from structured data
A technique for creating arbitrary numbers of distinct clusters from tabular data by weighting feature distributions in self-organizing maps
An interactive tool that bridges fully manual analysis and fully automatic methods for building ontological taxonomies from record-based data
idea_ch: 一种基于加权自组织映射（WSOM）从表格数据交互式构建分类体系的方法，根据实体特征值分布生成聚类
一种支持用户逐步迭代识别聚类并定义其内涵定义（intensional definitions）的渐进式本体构建系统
一种将加权自组织映射与人工精炼相结合的半自动本体分类体系构建技术
一种通过加权特征分布来自组织映射中生成任意数量不同聚类的技术
一种桥接纯手动分析与全自动方法的交互式工具，用于从记录型数据构建本体分类体系

title: ProActor: Timing-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Task Scheduling Agents
summary:
Proactive task-oriented agents must autonomously anticipate user needs, identify actionable opportunities, and trigger software actions at appropriate moments - fundamentally shifting from reactive systems that await explicit instructions. However, existing approaches lack generalizable end-to-end solutions for measuring and optimizing such anticipatory behaviors.
  This paper introduces ProActor, a unified framework for conversational task scheduling that integrates: (1) a domain-agnostic automated annotation methodology that enables scalable proactiveness reinforcement learning (RL) by generating full opportunity time windows instead of rigid point labels, (2) systematic proactiveness metrics capturing both timing quality and reference action alignment, and (3) RL optimization using GRPO with various reward designs. Our insight is that RULER-based rewards with proactiveness rubrics are crucial for improving timing quality, and that proactiveness optimization enabled by stage-aware composite rewards is key to balancing timing quality and reference action alignment.
  Timing-aware RL requires extensive exploration, demanding efficient infrastructure. We develop ART-F, an adaptive framework combining request-adaptive inference clusters with DDP-based training on single-node multi-GPU systems, enabling LoRA training of 4-bit Qwen2.5-14B-ProActor-Q4 with 4-8x speedups. Experiments on two newly auto-annotated datasets demonstrate significant improvements in proactive timing while maintaining action consistency comparable to state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines. Ablations validate the effectiveness of distinct composite reward variations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProActor框架，通过强化学习（GRPO）和RULER奖励机制，实现对话式任务调度中主动代理的时序优化。同时开发ART-F推理加速框架，在单节点多GPU系统上实现4-8倍速度提升，在自动标注数据集上取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 现有任务驱动型代理缺乏可泛化的端到端解决方案来量化和优化主动行为，传统系统只能被动等待用户指令，无法自主预测用户需求并在适当时机触发操作。
AI.method: (1) 域无关的自动标注方法，生成完整机会时间窗口而非刚性点标签；(2) 系统化的主动度量指标，涵盖时序质量和参考动作对齐；(3) 基于GRPO的RL优化，采用RULER奖励和阶段感知复合奖励；(4) ART-F自适应推理加速框架，结合请求自适应推理集群和DDP训练。
AI.result: 在自动标注数据集上，主动时序显著提升，动作一致性达到SOTA基线水平。4位Qwen2.5-14B模型实现4-8倍训练加速，消融实验验证了不同复合奖励变体的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于RULER的奖励和阶段感知复合奖励对提升时序质量和平衡动作对齐至关重要，ART-F框架有效解决了时序RL的探索效率瓶颈。
idea_en: A domain-agnostic automated annotation method for generating full opportunity time windows for proactive reinforcement learning in task-oriented agents.
A RULER-based reward mechanism with proactiveness rubrics specifically designed to improve timing quality in conversational task scheduling.
A stage-aware composite reward system that balances timing quality and reference action alignment during reinforcement learning optimization.
ART-F: an adaptive framework combining request-adaptive inference clusters with DDP-based training on single-node multi-GPU systems for efficient timing-aware RL.
A systematic proactiveness metric framework capturing both timing quality and reference action alignment for evaluating proactive agent behaviors.
idea_ch: 一种域无关的自动化标注方法，为任务导向型代理生成完整的机会时间窗口，用于主动行为强化学习训练。
基于RULER的奖励机制，结合主动行为评分标准，专门用于提升对话式任务调度中的时序质量。
阶段感知复合奖励系统，在强化学习优化过程中平衡时序质量和参考动作对齐。
ART-F自适应推理加速框架，结合请求自适应推理集群和单节点多GPU系统的DDP训练，实现时序感知RL的高效训练。
一种系统化的主动行为度量框架，同时捕获时序质量和参考动作对齐度，用于评估代理主动行为。

title: Noise-Robust Financial Numerical Entity Attribute Tagging
summary: Financial Numerical Entity (FNE) understanding aims to recover the meaning of numerical mentions in financial reports. Existing studies primarily focus on concept name prediction and face two important limitations. First, labels derived from inline XBRL may contain errors because filings are usually prepared manually. Second, other important FNE attributes, such as reporting-time relation, measurement scale, and accounting sign, are less emphasized. We propose \textbf{NO}ise-\textbf{R}obust Tagging for Rich Financial Numerical Entity \textbf{A}ttributes (\textsc{NORA}) to address these gaps. NORA uses task-aware instance-specific weighting to attenuate the influence of noisy labels during training, and we further propose the Neighborhood Prior-adjusted KNN (NPK) filtering method for more reliable evaluation on real-world noisy test sets. In addition, we construct a large-scale benchmark containing 6.6 million instances with multi-attribute labels and filing metadata. Experiments show that \textsc{NORA} performs strongly compared with state-of-the-art noisy-label baselines, including Co-teaching, Mixup, SSR, and SelfMix. Moreover, NORA is robust under both unfiltered and noise-filtered test settings. It achieves the best Accuracy, Macro F1, and Weighted F1 for concept name and time-relation prediction, while remaining competitive on scale and sign prediction. These results demonstrate the value of jointly modeling rich FNE attributes while accounting for label noise in real-world financial filings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NORA框架，用于金融数值实体理解，通过噪声鲁棒标签处理和邻域优先KNN过滤方法，在6.6百万实例的大规模基准上联合预测概念名称、时间关系、计量尺度和会计符号等多属性，有效应对真实世界财务申报中的标签噪声问题。
AI.motivation: 现有金融数值实体理解研究主要关注概念名称预测，存在两大局限：一是从内联XBRL提取的标签因人工填报而包含错误噪声；二是其他重要的FNE属性（如报告时间关系、计量尺度、会计符号）被忽视。
AI.method: 提出NORA框架：1) 任务感知的实例特定权重（task-aware instance-specific weighting）来减弱噪声标签在训练中的影响；2) 邻域优先调整KNN（NPK）过滤方法，用于在真实噪声测试集上进行更可靠的评估；3) 构建包含660万实例、多属性标签和申报元数据的大规模基准数据集。
AI.result: NORA在概念名称和时间关系预测上取得了最优的Accuracy、Macro F1和Weighted F1，在尺度和符号预测上也具有竞争力。在未过滤和噪声过滤两种测试设置下均表现鲁棒，优于Co-teaching、Mixup、SSR、SelfMix等最新噪声标签基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模丰富的FNE属性并考虑真实财务申报中的标签噪声，能显著提升金融数值实体理解的性能，验证了噪声鲁棒多属性建模在实际金融场景中的价值。
idea_en: A task-aware instance-specific weighting method for noisy label attenuation in financial numerical entity tagging, where each training instance receives dynamically adjusted weights based on its label reliability across multiple FNE attributes.

Neighborhood Prior-adjusted KNN (NPK) filtering method for reliable evaluation on real-world noisy test sets, combining neighborhood prior knowledge with k-nearest neighbors to filter unreliable labels.

Multi-attribute joint tagging framework for Financial Numerical Entities that simultaneously predicts concept name, reporting-time relation, measurement scale, and accounting sign in a single unified model.

A large-scale benchmark with 6.6 million instances containing multi-attribute labels and filing metadata specifically designed for training and evaluating noise-robust financial numerical entity understanding systems.
idea_ch: 一种任务感知的实例特定权重方法，用于金融数值实体标注中的噪声标签衰减，每个训练实例根据其在多个FNE属性上的标签可靠性获得动态调整的权重。
邻域优先调整KNN（NPK）过滤方法，结合邻域先验知识与K近邻算法对真实世界噪声测试集中的不可靠标签进行过滤，实现更可靠的模型评估。
金融数值实体多属性联合标注框架，在单一统一模型中同时预测概念名称、报告时间关系、计量尺度和会计符号四个关键属性。
包含660万实例的大规模多属性标签与申报元数据基准数据集，专门用于训练和评估噪声鲁棒的金融数值实体理解系统。

title: Energy Shields for Fairness
summary:
Runtime fairness is not a one-time constraint but a dynamic property evaluated over a sequence of decisions.
  To ensure fairness at runtime, it is necessary to account for past decisions, information neglected by conventional, static classifiers.
  Traditional fairness shields enforce runtime fairness abruptly,
  by intervening \emph{deterministically} whenever a sequence of decisions violates the target for a running fairness measure. This motivates our \emph{main conceptual contribution: \textbf{energy shields}.}
  An energy shield is a novel, lightweight, adaptive controller that monitors a sequence of decisions and intervenes \emph{probabilistically} to ensure runtime fairness smoothly, by utilizing physics-inspired energy functions to nudge the sequence toward fairness:
  the more unfair the decisions, the stronger the nudging force becomes. This makes energy shields the \emph{\textbf{first}} fairness shields to provide both \emph{short-term safety and long-term liveness guarantees}.
  Safety ensures that the running fairness measure stays within a running target interval with high probability,
  and liveness ensures that the limit of the fairness measure lies within the limit target interval.
  Intuitively, the short-term specifies the tolerated fairness values and the long-term specifies the desired fairness values.
  We also provide a synthesis procedure for constructing the least intrusive energy shield for a given target specification, and demonstrate its efficiency experimentally.
  We evaluate our energy shields against existing fairness shields through the lens of short- and long-term fairness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出能量护盾（Energy Shields），一种基于概率干预的轻量级自适应控制器，通过物理启发的能量函数平滑地推动运行时公平性，同时提供短期安全性和长期活跃性保证。
AI.motivation: 传统公平性护盾通过确定性干预强制公平，忽略了过去决策对运行时公平性的影响，且无法同时保证短期安全性和长期活跃性。
AI.method: 提出能量护盾概念，利用物理启发的能量函数监测决策序列并进行概率性干预：不公平程度越高，干预力度越强。同时提供了最小侵入性护盾的合成过程。
AI.result: 实验表明能量护盾在短期公平性和长期公平性方面均优于现有公平性护盾。
AI.conclusion: 能量护盾是首个能同时提供短期安全性（运行公平性指标高概率保持在目标区间内）和长期活跃性（公平性极限落在目标区间内）的公平性护盾。
idea_en: A probabilistic runtime fairness enforcement method using physics-inspired energy functions that adaptively adjust intervention strength based on cumulative unfairness of past decisions.

A dual-guarantee fairness shield system architecture that simultaneously provides short-term safety (running fairness within target interval with high probability) and long-term liveness (limit of fairness measure within target interval).
A least-intrusive energy shield synthesis procedure that minimizes intervention while satisfying specified fairness constraints, using optimization techniques to tune energy function parameters.

A real-time fairness monitoring and intervention system that uses energy potential to probabilistically override decisions, where the override probability is proportional to the accumulated fairness violation energy.
idea_ch: 一种基于物理启发能量函数的概率性运行时公平性强制方法，根据过去决策的累积不公平度自适应调整干预强度。
一种双保障公平性护盾系统架构，同时提供短期安全性（运行公平性指标高概率保持在目标区间内）和长期活跃性（公平性度量极限落在目标区间内）。
一种最小侵入性能量护盾综合过程，通过优化技术调整能量函数参数，在满足指定公平性约束的同时最小化干预。
一种实时公平性监测与干预系统，使用能量势能概率性地覆盖决策，覆盖概率与累积不公平违规能量成正比。

title: Towards Multi-Turn Dialog Systems for Industrial Asset Operations and Maintenance
summary: Industrial asset operations and maintenance question answering is inherently multi-turn, iterative, and highly dependent on external tool invocation. However, the conventional plan-execute single-agent architecture exhibits clear limitations in maintaining cross-turn context, and reusing intermediate results. In this paper, we present a multi-turn dialog system designed for industrial scenarios based on a supervisor-specialist multi-agent architecture. To alleviate tool invocation bottlenecks, the system incorporates structured artifact reuse, dynamic replanning, and parallel tool execution. Evaluation results show that our system achieves better response quality compared with the baseline, with planning effectiveness increasing by 54.5% and task completion improving by 37.8%. System profiling further shows that cross-turn artifact reuse effectively reduces redundant tool invocation, decreasing the tool-time share from 47.3% to 26.3% and making turns 2-5 approximately 4.2x faster than the first turn.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向工业场景的监督者-专家多智能体多轮对话系统，通过结构化工件复用、动态重规划和并行工具执行，显著提升了规划效果和任务完成率，并将工具调用时间占比从47.3%降至26.3%。
AI.motivation: 工业资产运维问答具有多轮、迭代和高度依赖外部工具调用的特点，传统计划-执行单智能体架构在跨轮上下文保持和中间结果复用方面存在明显局限。
AI.method: 采用监督者-专家多智能体架构，引入结构化工件复用、动态重规划和并行工具执行机制，以缓解工具调用瓶颈。
AI.result: 与基线相比，规划效果提升54.5%，任务完成度提升37.8%；工具调用时间占比从47.3%降至26.3%，第2-5轮比第一轮快约4.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 监督者-专家多智能体架构结合工件复用与动态重规划，能够有效提升工业多轮对话系统的性能和效率。
idea_en: A supervisor-specialist multi-agent architecture for multi-turn dialog in industrial asset operations and maintenance, where a supervisor agent coordinates multiple specialist agents to handle complex tool-invocation tasks.
Structured artifact reuse mechanism that captures and reuses intermediate results across dialog turns to reduce redundant tool invocations in multi-turn conversations.
Dynamic replanning strategy that adjusts the execution plan in real-time based on intermediate feedback during multi-turn industrial question answering.
Parallel tool execution method that enables simultaneous invocation of multiple tools to reduce overall response latency in industrial O&M dialog systems.
idea_ch: 一种面向工业资产运维多轮对话的监督者-专家多智能体架构，通过监督者智能体协调多个专家智能体处理复杂的工具调用任务。
结构化工件复用机制，在多轮对话中捕获和复用中间结果，减少冗余工具调用。
动态重规划策略，根据多轮工业问答过程中的中间反馈实时调整执行计划。
并行工具执行方法，在工业运维对话系统中同时调用多个工具以减少整体响应延迟。

title: Mitigating Object Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models through Region-Aware Attention Recalibration
summary: The generation of factually incorrect objects, commonly known as object hallucination, remains a persistent challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Current approaches to address this issue - ranging from expensive data-driven fine-tuning and high-latency contrastive decoding to rigid attention head truncation - frequently compromise either computational efficiency or the continuity of the model's feature space. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a novel, training-free inference strategy that operates as a region-aware adaptive weighting mechanism to dynamically correct semantic drift without relying on abrupt heuristic truncations. By computing an outlier-resistant statistical midpoint across various attention heads, we establish a stable anchor for reliable visual representations. We then utilize the inter-head disagreement mapped across regions to dynamically determine intervention budgets, gently suppressing hallucination-inducing attention paths through a continuous penalty modulation. This recalibration process effectively rectifies visual-semantic misalignments while fully preserving generative fluency and language priors. Comprehensive evaluations on standard multimodal benchmarks, including CHAIR, POPE, and MME, reveal that our strategy substantially curtails both instance- and sentence-level hallucinations. The results demonstrate state-of-the-art performance against contemporary baselines, confirming our method's efficiency and algorithmic robustness. Our code will be public.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的区域感知自适应加权推理策略，通过计算注意力头的抗异常统计中点作为稳定锚点，并利用跨头分歧动态调整干预预算，以连续惩罚调制方式抑制对象幻觉，在保持生成流畅性的同时显著减少多模态大模型中的视觉语义错位。
AI.motivation: LVLMs中的对象幻觉问题尚未被有效解决，现有方法（数据驱动的微调、对比解码、注意力头截断）要么计算成本高，要么破坏特征空间连续性。
AI.method: 1) 计算各注意力头的抗异常统计中点（outlier-resistant statistical midpoint）作为稳定视觉锚点；2) 利用跨头分歧（inter-head disagreement）按区域动态映射干预预算；3) 通过连续惩罚调制（continuous penalty modulation）温和抑制幻觉诱导的注意力路径。
AI.result: 在CHAIR、POPE、MME等基准测试中，该方法在实例级和句子级幻觉抑制上达到最优性能，且效率高、无需训练。
AI.conclusion: 该训练免费的推理策略在不牺牲生成流畅性和语言先验的前提下，有效纠正了视觉-语义错位，实现了鲁棒且高效的幻觉抑制。
idea_en: A training-free, region-aware adaptive weighting inference strategy that uses outlier-resistant statistical midpoint across attention heads as a stable visual anchor to dynamically correct semantic drift in LVLMs.

A method for dynamically determining intervention budgets by mapping inter-head disagreement across regions, enabling gentle suppression of hallucination-inducing attention paths via continuous penalty modulation.
A continuous penalty modulation mechanism that rectifies visual-semantic misalignments while fully preserving generative fluency and language priors without abrupt heuristic truncations.
idea_ch: 一种免训练的、区域感知的自适应加权推理策略，通过计算各注意力头的抗异常统计中点作为稳定视觉锚点，动态纠正多模态大模型中的语义漂移。
一种通过跨区域映射注意力头分歧来动态确定干预预算的方法，利用连续惩罚调制温和抑制诱发幻觉的注意力路径。
一种连续惩罚调制机制，在不诉诸突然启发式截断的前提下，纠正视觉-语义错位并完整保留生成流畅性和语言先验的方法。

title: NeurIPS: Neuro-anatomical Inductive Priors for Sphere-based Brain Decoding
summary: Current fMRI decoders face a performance-fidelity trade-off where efficient ID encoders outperform geometrically faithful surface-based models. We argue this is partly driven by inefficient surface tokenization and the failure to use anatomy as a predictive signal. We present NeurIPS, a framework that improves surface-based decoding by reframing anatomical variation from a nuisance to a powerful inductive prior. NeurIPS unites two innovations: a Selective ROI Spherical Tokenizer (SRST) for efficient geometric encoding, and a Structure-Guided Mixture of Experts (SG-MoE) that explicitly models individual anatomy using cortical features. On the Natural Scenes Dataset, NeurIPS establishes a new state-of-the-art for surface decoders and achieves performance comparable to strong 1D baselines. This is achieved with unprecedented efficiency, as the model converges dramatically faster (10 vs. 600 epochs). This efficiency enables rapid adaptation to new subjects using only 20% of data and ensures robust scalability as the training cohort is expanded. Ablations provide causal evidence that these gains are driven by the model's use of cortical features, not by memorizing subject IDs. By leveraging anatomical priors, NeurIPS provides a principled and scalable path toward robust, generalizable brain decoding.

AI.tldr: NeurIPS是一个表面解码框架，通过将解剖变异从噪声转化为归纳先验，结合选择性ROI球形分词器和结构引导的专家混合模型，在自然场景数据集上实现了与1D基线相当的性能，且收敛速度极快（10轮vs 600轮）。
AI.motivation: 当前fMRI解码器面临性能-保真度权衡：高效的1D编码器性能优于几何保真的表面模型。作者认为这源于低效的表面分词化以及未能将解剖结构作为预测信号使用。
AI.method: NeurIPS框架包含两个创新：(1) 选择性ROI球形分词器(SRST)，实现高效几何编码；(2) 结构引导的专家混合模型(SG-MoE)，使用皮层特征显式建模个体解剖结构。
AI.result: 在自然场景数据集上达到表面解码器SOTA，性能与强1D基线相当。收敛速度极快（10轮 vs 600轮），仅用20%数据即可快速适应新受试者，训练队列扩展时具有鲁棒可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用解剖先验，NeurIPS为鲁棒、可泛化的脑解码提供了一条原理性且可扩展的路径。消融实验证明性能提升源于皮层特征的使用，而非记忆受试者ID。
idea_en: A Selective ROI Spherical Tokenizer (SRST) for efficient geometric encoding of brain surface data
A Structure-Guided Mixture of Experts (SG-MoE) that explicitly models individual anatomy using cortical features
Reframing anatomical variation from a nuisance variable to a powerful inductive prior for brain decoding
A surface-based decoding framework achieving 60x faster convergence (10 vs 600 epochs) compared to traditional methods
Rapid subject adaptation mechanism using only 20% of training data via anatomical priors
idea_ch: 一种选择性ROI球形分词器(SRST)，用于脑表面数据的高效几何编码
一种结构引导的专家混合模型(SG-MoE)，利用皮层特征显式建模个体解剖结构
将解剖变异从噪声变量重新定义为脑解码的强大归纳先验的方法
一种表面解码框架，相比传统方法实现60倍收敛加速（10轮 vs 600轮）
利用解剖先验仅使用20%训练数据即可快速适应新受试者的机制

title: Privacy-Preserving Local Language Models for Longitudinal Data Retrieval in Chronic Dermatologic Disease: Implementation in Pemphigus Patients
summary: Chronic dermatologic diseases such as pemphigus require long-term follow-up, generating extensive longitudinal clinical documentation that is difficult to review comprehensively during routine visits and increasing clinician workload as well as the risk of missing critical historical information. We evaluated whether a locally deployed, privacy-preserving small language model (SLM) could retrieve structured clinical features and generate longitudinal summaries from long-term dermatology follow-up records. In this retrospective case series, thirty pemphigus patients contributed 541 visit notes that were aggregated into full longitudinal records (89,336 words); 56 clinically relevant features were annotated by two expert dermatologists. The locally deployed SLM (Qwen3 4B Thinking 2507) was queried with each complete record to retrieve 56 features and generate one final report summaries. Across 1,680 feature retrieval tasks, mean accuracy was 82.25%. Dermatologists' ratings of AI-generated summaries were high for overall quality (8.23-8.47), clinical accuracy (7.93-8.20), and usefulness (8.47-8.50), with no significant inter-evaluator differences and an overall preference for AI summaries in 53.3% of evaluations. These findings suggest that privacy-preserving, locally deployed SLMs can outperform medical experts and reliably generate clinically meaningful longitudinal summaries. SLMs may support clinical decision-making when integrated with appropriate oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了本地部署的隐私保护小语言模型（Qwen3 4B）在从长期皮肤科随访记录中提取结构化临床特征并生成纵向摘要的能力，在30名天疱疮患者的541份就诊记录（89,336词）中，特征提取准确率达82.25%，AI摘要质量评分高（8.23-8.50），53.3%的评估中AI摘要优于人工摘要。
AI.motivation: 慢性皮肤病（如天疱疮）需要长期随访，产生大量纵向临床记录，常规诊疗中难以全面回顾，增加了医生工作负荷和遗漏关键历史信息的风险。
AI.method: 回顾性病例系列研究，纳入30名天疱疮患者的541份就诊记录（89,336词），由两名皮肤科专家标注56个临床相关特征。使用本地部署的Qwen3 4B Thinking SLM处理完整记录，检索56个特征并生成最终报告摘要。评估特征检索准确率，并由皮肤科医生对AI生成摘要进行质量、临床准确性和实用性评分。
AI.result: 在1,680个特征检索任务中，平均准确率为82.25%。皮肤科医生对AI摘要的整体质量评分8.23-8.47，临床准确性7.93-8.20，实用性8.47-8.50，评估者间无显著差异，53.3%的评估中AI摘要优于人工摘要。
AI.conclusion: 隐私保护的本地部署小语言模型能够可靠地生成临床有意义的纵向摘要，在适当的监督下可支持临床决策。
idea_en: A privacy-preserving small language model locally deployed for structured clinical feature extraction from longitudinal dermatology records
Method for generating longitudinal clinical summaries from chronic disease follow-up records using small language models with high accuracy
Automated 56-feature retrieval system from pemphigus clinical notes using locally deployed SLM
AI-based clinical decision support system integrating longitudinal patient history summarization for chronic dermatologic diseases
Privacy-compliant medical record analysis pipeline using small language models without cloud data transmission
idea_ch: 一种本地部署的隐私保护小语言模型，用于从纵向皮肤科记录中提取结构化临床特征
基于小语言模型从慢性病随访记录生成纵向临床摘要的方法
利用本地部署SLM从天疱疮临床笔记中自动检索56项特征的系统
整合纵向患者历史摘要的AI临床决策支持系统，适用于慢性皮肤病
