title: AION: Next-Generation Tasks and Practical Harness for Time Series
comment: Project page and code are available at https://github.com/ztxtech/aion
summary: Time series research is moving beyond fixed forecasting benchmarks toward realistic tasks that combine prediction, contextual reasoning, tool use, and structured decision support. Most benchmarks are built around clean data and short evaluation loops; agents alone may miss temporal constraints, evidence checks, or review before finalizing outputs. We first formalize next-generation time series tasks as three-component tuples consisting of a task file, a workspace, and a validation interface. We then present AION, a time series harness built from six component groups: agents, skills, rules, memory, evaluation, and protocols. In this harness, we use three design principles: temporal grounding, temporal knowledge-grounded reasoning, and reliability mechanisms such as post-experiment analysis and layered review. A Kaggle Store Sales case study shows that the harness produces more detailed process traces, more artifacts, and more review steps than the same base agent operating in OpenCode direct build mode. Taken together, these results argue for a paradigm shift from fixed tasks to realistic ones under real-world constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出下一代时间序列任务的形式化定义（任务文件+工作空间+验证接口），并构建AION框架，通过智能体、技能、规则、记忆、评估和协议六大组件，实现时间约束、知识推理和可靠性保障，推动时间序列研究从固定基准向真实世界约束任务转变。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列基准大多基于干净数据和短评估循环，缺乏对时间约束、证据检查、审查机制等真实世界需求的考虑，需要新的框架来支撑面向现实约束的时间序列任务。
AI.method: 将下一代时间序列任务形式化为三元组（任务文件、工作空间、验证接口），构建AION框架包含六大组件组：智能体、技能、规则、记忆、评估和协议，并基于三个设计原则：时间锚定、时间知识推理、可靠性机制（事后分析与分层审查）。
AI.result: Kaggle商店销售案例研究表明，相比OpenCode直接构建模式，AION框架产生了更详细的过程追踪记录、更多的工件和更多的审查步骤。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持从固定任务向真实世界约束任务的范式转变。
idea_en: A time series task formalization method as a three-component tuple (task file, workspace, validation interface) enabling structured decision support with temporal constraints.
A multi-component agent harness architecture (AION) with six component groups: agents, skills, rules, memory, evaluation, and protocols for time series analysis.
Temporal grounding mechanism that enforces time constraints and evidence checking in agent-based time series reasoning.
Layered review and post-experiment analysis reliability mechanisms for time series prediction and decision support systems.
A temporal knowledge-grounded reasoning method that combines prediction with contextual reasoning and tool use in time series tasks.
idea_ch: 一种将时间序列任务形式化为三元组（任务文件、工作空间、验证接口）的方法，在时间约束下实现结构化决策支持。
一种基于六大组件组（智能体、技能、规则、记忆、评估和协议）的AION多组件智能体框架架构，用于时间序列分析。
一种时间锚定机制，在基于智能体的时间序列推理中强制执行时间约束和证据检查。
一种分层审查与事后分析的可靠性保障机制，用于时间序列预测与决策支持系统。
一种时间知识推理方法，在时间序列任务中结合预测、上下文推理和工具使用。

title: Evolutionary Enhanced Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Cooperative Air Combat
summary: As modern air combat evolves toward beyond-visual-range (BVR) multi-aircraft cooperative engagements, autonomous decision-making for unmanned combat aerial vehicles (UCAVs) faces significant challenges due to high-dimensional state spaces, discrete action commands, and strongly adversarial dynamic environments. To overcome the limitations of existing multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) methods in such settings, namely insufficient exploration efficiency, low sample utilization, and poor policy generalization, we propose Adversarial Curriculum and Evolutionary-enhanced Multi-agent Proximal Policy Optimization (ACE-MAPPO), a hybrid learning framework that integrates evolutionary algorithms with MAPPO. Specifically, a genetic soft update mechanism is introduced to enhance population diversity and mitigate convergence to local optima. An evolutionary-augmented prioritized trajectory replay strategy is further employed to improve the utilization of sparse high-value samples. In addition, an adversarial evolutionary curriculum learning mechanism is designed to enable adaptive training with progressively increasing difficulty. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms MAPPO and other baseline algorithms in terms of training stability, convergence speed, and win rate, validating its effectiveness in multi-aircraft cooperative air combat scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出ACE-MAPPO混合学习框架，将进化算法与MAPPO结合，解决多无人机协同空战中的高维状态空间、离散动作和强对抗动态环境挑战，在训练稳定性、收敛速度和胜率方面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有MARL方法在超视距多机协同空战中面临探索效率不足、样本利用率低和策略泛化能力差的问题。
AI.method: 提出ACE-MAPPO框架，包含：(1) 遗传软更新机制增强种群多样性；(2) 进化增强的优先级轨迹回放策略提高稀疏高价值样本利用率；(3) 对抗进化课程学习机制实现难度渐进的自适应训练。
AI.result: 实验证明ACE-MAPPO在训练稳定性、收敛速度和胜率方面优于MAPPO及其他基线算法。
AI.conclusion: ACE-MAPPO框架在多机协同空战场景中有效提升了决策性能，为UCAV自主决策提供了可行方案。
idea_en: A genetic soft update mechanism that maintains population diversity in multi-agent reinforcement learning by applying evolutionary algorithms to periodically update agent network parameters, preventing premature convergence to local optima.

An evolutionary-augmented prioritized trajectory replay strategy that ranks and selectively replays sparse high-value experience trajectories based on evolutionary fitness scores, improving sample efficiency in multi-agent air combat scenarios.

An adversarial evolutionary curriculum learning mechanism that dynamically generates increasingly difficult training scenarios by evolving opponent strategies, enabling adaptive skill progression for multi-agent systems.

A hybrid learning framework (ACE-MAPPO) that seamlessly integrates evolutionary algorithms with Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization for beyond-visual-range multi-aircraft cooperative combat decision-making.
idea_ch: 一种遗传软更新机制：通过进化算法定期更新智能体网络参数，维持多智能体强化学习中的种群多样性，防止过早收敛到局部最优解。
一种进化增强的优先级轨迹回放策略：基于进化适应度评分对稀疏高价值经验轨迹进行排名和选择性重放，提高多智能体空战场景中的样本利用效率。
一种对抗进化课程学习机制：通过进化对手策略动态生成难度递增的训练场景，实现多智能体系统的自适应技能进阶训练。
一种混合学习框架(ACE-MAPPO)：将进化算法与多智能体近端策略优化无缝集成，用于超视距多机协同空战决策。

title: RECTOR: Priority-Aware Rule-Based Reranking for Compliance-Aware Autonomous Driving Trajectory Selection
summary:
Autonomous driving stacks must pick one trajectory from a multi-modal candidate set; choosing by model confidence ignores safety, traffic-law, and comfort constraints. We present \textsc{RECTOR} (Rule-Enforced Constrained Trajectory Orchestrator), a post-generation reranking layer that scores candidates against a tiered rulebook (Safety~$\succ$~Legal~$\succ$~Road~$\succ$~Comfort) via differentiable proxies and a scene-conditioned applicability mechanism, then selects with a deterministic $\varepsilon$-lexicographic rule that preserves cross-tier priority by construction -- without retraining the predictor.
  On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset \texttt{validation\_interactive} split (43{,}219 augmented instances, $K{=}6$), under Protocol~B (28-rule proxy catalog, oracle applicability) rule-aware selection cuts Safety+Legal violations from 28.58\% to 20.42\% and Total from 40.32\% to 32.41\% versus confidence-only on the same candidates. A uniform-weight weighted-sum baseline matches binary compliance on this benchmark -- the empirical lift comes from rule-aware ranking, while the lexicographic guarantee is the structural differentiator no weight calibration can replicate. Under adversarial confidence corruption, confidence-only selection fails in 100\% of scenarios while both rule-aware selectors reject the injected mode in $\sim$96\%. All figures are proxy-evaluator results (not a safety certificate), open-loop, 5\,s horizon, U.S.\ rules, validation split.

AI.tldr: RECTOR是一个后处理重排序层，通过分层规则手册（安全>法律>道路>舒适）和可微分代理，对多模态轨迹候选集进行规则感知排序，采用ε-词典选择规则保证跨层级优先级，无需重新训练预测器。在Waymo数据集上，相比纯置信度选择，将安全+法律违规从28.58%降至20.42%。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶堆栈需要从多模态候选集中选取一条轨迹，仅凭模型置信度选择忽略了安全性、交通法规和舒适性约束。
AI.method: 提出RECTOR框架，包含：1) 分层规则手册（Safety > Legal > Road > Comfort）；2) 可微分代理规则评分；3) 场景条件化的规则适用性机制；4) 确定性ε-词典选择规则，保证跨层级优先级。
AI.result: 在Waymo Open Motion Dataset验证集上，规则感知选择将Safety+Legal违规从28.58%降至20.42%，总违规从40.32%降至32.41%。在对抗性置信度攻击下，纯置信度选择100%失败，而规则感知选择~96%成功拒绝恶意模式。
AI.conclusion: 规则感知的词典排序能有效提升轨迹选择的安全性，且无需重新训练预测器；词典保证是加权求和基线无法复现的结构性差异化优势。
idea_en: A post-generation trajectory reranking layer that scores candidates against a tiered rulebook (Safety > Legal > Road > Comfort) using differentiable proxy functions, enabling rule-aware selection without retraining the predictor.
A scene-conditioned applicability mechanism that dynamically determines which rules from the rulebook are applicable in a given traffic scenario, improving ranking relevance.
A deterministic epsilon-lexicographic selection rule that preserves cross-tier priority by construction, providing a structural guarantee that weight-calibrated weighted-sum methods cannot replicate.
An adversarial confidence corruption defense mechanism via rule-aware selection, achieving ~96% rejection rate of injected malicious modes compared to 0% for confidence-only selection.
idea_ch: 一种后生成轨迹重排序层，通过分层规则手册（安全>法律>道路>舒适）和可微分代理函数对候选轨迹评分，无需重新训练预测器即可实现规则感知的轨迹选择
一种场景条件化的规则适用性机制，可动态判断规则手册中各规则在特定交通场景中的适用性，提高排序相关性
一种确定性ε-词典选择规则，通过构造方式保证跨层级优先级，提供加权求和权重校准方法无法复现的结构性保障
一种基于规则感知选择的对抗性置信度攻击防御机制，对注入恶意模式的拒绝率达~96%，而纯置信度选择的拒绝率为0%

title: Trust but Verify: Prover-Verifier Deliberation for Selective LLM Prediction
summary: Reliably knowing when a language model is correct is almost as important as being correct. We introduce prover-verifier deliberation (PVD), an inference-time protocol grounded in interactive proof theory, as a mechanism for selective prediction: the protocol produces both an answer and a structured confidence verdict, allowing a system to report high-confidence answers while abstaining on uncertain cases. In each dialogue, a prover defends a candidate answer through checkable sub-claims while a verifier issues targeted challenges and returns \textsc{Accept}, \textsc{Challenge}, or \textsc{Reject}. Because frozen language models are imperfect provers and verifiers operating over a noisy channel, formal soundness and completeness guarantees do not transfer; instead, we characterize the protocol empirically through its coverage-precision behavior. Our main experiment uses Claude Sonnet 4.6 as prover and Claude Haiku 4.5 as verifier on GPQA Diamond. Questions accepted with no answer revision, which we call Accept + No Change (ANC), are reported as the high-confidence subset; we evaluate this subset by its precision and coverage. ANC separates reliable from unreliable answers, yielding a $\sim$30pp HC-Prec gap over the non-ANC complement. Robustness experiments with GPT and Gemini pairings show that high HC-Prec can transfer across model families, while verifier strictness and domain competence largely determine the size of the selection gap. On Humanity's Last Exam, weaker prover-verifier pairings can collapse or invert the ANC signal, illustrating a practical failure mode when the verifier operates outside its effective region. Comparisons with self-consistency, universal self-consistency, multi-agent debate, and Reflexion suggest that prover-verifier deliberation supplies a distinct argument-defensibility signal for selective prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出Prover-Verifier Deliberation（PVD）协议，通过交互式证明理论实现选择性预测，让语言模型在推理过程中通过证明者-验证者对话产生答案和置信度判定，在高置信度下输出答案，不确定时弃权。
AI.motivation: 可靠地判断语言模型何时正确与正确本身几乎同等重要，现有方法缺乏结构化的置信度判定机制。
AI.method: 基于交互式证明理论设计PVD协议：证明者通过可核查的子主张辩护候选答案，验证者发出针对性挑战并返回Accept/Challenge/Reject判定。对未经答案修改即被接受的样本（ANC）报告为高置信度子集。
AI.result: 在GPQA Diamond上，ANC子集与非ANC子集间HC-Prec差距约30pp；跨模型族（GPT、Gemini）的高HC-Prec可迁移；验证者严格性和领域能力决定选择差距大小。
AI.conclusion: PVD为选择性预测提供了一种独特的论证-可辩护性信号，存在验证者超出有效区域时信号崩溃的失败模式。
idea_en: Prover-Verifier Deliberation protocol leveraging interactive proof theory for selective prediction in language models, where a prover defends answers through checkable sub-claims and a verifier issues targeted challenges with Accept/Challenge/Reject verdicts.

Inference-time confidence verdict system that produces both an answer and a structured confidence judgment, enabling selective prediction by reporting high-confidence answers while abstaining on uncertain cases.

Accept No Change (ANC) metric as a high-confidence subset selector, where questions accepted without answer revision are identified as reliable predictions with measurable precision-coverage tradeoffs.
Cross-model family robustness mechanism for selective prediction, demonstrating that high HC-Prec signals can transfer across GPT and Gemini model families when used as prover-verifier pairings.
Verifier effective region detection method to prevent signal collapse or inversion in prover-verifier deliberation, identifying failure modes when the verifier operates outside its domain competence.
idea_ch: 基于交互式证明理论的证明者-验证者审议（PVD）协议，通过证明者用可核查子主张辩护答案、验证者发出针对性挑战并返回Accept/Challenge/Reject判定，实现语言模型的选择性预测。
推理时置信度判定系统，同时输出答案和结构化置信度判定，对高置信度答案进行报告而对不确定案例弃权，提高系统可靠性。
Accept No Change（ANC）指标作为高置信度子集选择器，将未经答案修改即被接受的样本识别为可靠预测，并具有可衡量的精度-覆盖率权衡特性。
跨模型族鲁棒性选择性预测机制，证明当使用GPT和Gemini作为证明者-验证者对时，高HC-Prec信号可在不同模型族间迁移。
验证者有效区域检测方法，防止证明者-验证者审议中的信号崩溃或反转，识别验证者在超出其领域能力范围运行时的失败模式。

title: Beyond the Frontier: Stochastic Backtracking for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional compute to explore multiple solution trajectories. The key challenge is to maximize accuracy while minimizing the total number of generated tokens during reasoning. Recent PRM-guided methods score intermediate prefixes to steer this search, but most are frontier-only: they keep only the current active prefixes and irreversibly prune or resample away the rest using noisy PRM scores. This can cause premature commitment, diversity collapse, and the loss of prefixes that still admit correct continuations. We introduce stochastic backtracking over a persistent pool of historical prefixes, allowing test-time compute to revisit previously generated states instead of only expanding the current frontier. To make this efficient, we propose two complementary mechanisms. Subpool Selection strengthens greedy PRM-guided search by applying Top-N selection within random subpools, giving historical prefixes a chance to bypass over-scored frontier candidates. Power Backtrack Sequential Monte Carlo extends SMC-style resampling to the persistent pool using powered PRM scores and mixture-corrected weights. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model scales, our methods consistently achieve higher accuracy per token count, and the same level of accuracy using only a fraction of the token count in comparison to strong PRM-guided baselines, demonstrating that persistent-pool stochastic backtracking provides a simple and effective way to improve the accuracy-token trade-off in test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于持久化历史前缀池的随机回溯方法，通过子池选择和幂回溯SMC两种机制，在测试时推理中实现更好的准确率- Token数量权衡，相比传统PRM引导的前沿搜索方法，能以更少的Token达到相同或更高的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有PRM引导的测试时扩展方法仅保留当前活跃前缀，使用噪声PRM分数不可逆地剪枝或重采样，导致过早承诺、多样性崩溃，丢失可能包含正确后续路径的历史前缀。
AI.method: 提出两个互补机制：1) 子池选择(Subpool Selection)：在随机子池内进行Top-N选择，给历史前缀绕过过高评分前沿候选的机会；2) 幂回溯顺序蒙特卡洛(Power Backtrack SMC)：扩展SMC重采样到持久化池，使用幂化PRM分数和混合校正权重。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准和不同模型规模上，该方法在相同Token数量下获得更高准确率，或在相同准确率下仅需少量Token，优于强PRM引导基线。
AI.conclusion: 持久化池的随机回溯提供了一种简单有效的方式，改善测试时扩展中的准确率-Token数量权衡。
idea_en: A stochastic backtracking method for test-time scaling in language model reasoning that maintains a persistent pool of historical prefixes, allowing the model to revisit previously generated states instead of only expanding the current frontier.
A Subpool Selection mechanism that strengthens greedy PRM-guided search by applying Top-N selection within random subpools, enabling historical prefixes to bypass over-scored frontier candidates.

A Power Backtrack Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) method that extends SMC-style resampling to a persistent pool using powered PRM scores and mixture-corrected weights for improved test-time reasoning efficiency.
A test-time compute framework that optimizes the accuracy-token trade-off by combining persistent historical prefix pools with stochastic backtracking for language model reasoning.
idea_ch: 一种用于语言模型推理测试时扩展的随机回溯方法，维护一个持久化的历史前缀池，使模型能够回访先前生成的中间状态，而不仅限于扩展当前前沿路径。
一种子池选择机制，通过在随机子池内进行Top-N选择来增强贪婪PRM引导的搜索，使历史前缀有机会绕过被过度评分的前沿候选。
一种幂回溯顺序蒙特卡洛方法，将SMC重采样扩展到持久化前缀池，使用幂化PRM分数和混合校正权重，提高测试时推理效率。
一种结合持久化历史前缀池与随机回溯的测试时计算框架，优化语言模型推理中准确率与生成Token数量之间的权衡。

title: Representation Without Control: Testing the Realization Effect in Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as behavioral simulators, but it remains unclear when their outputs reflect human-like cognitive mechanisms rather than prompt-sensitive surface patterns. We study this question through the realization effect, a well-characterized finding in behavioral economics in which risk-taking differs systematically after paper versus realized gains and losses. We evaluate LLM behavior at three levels: prompt-only behavioral sensitivity, linear readout of internal representations, and causal control via activation steering. Prompt-only results show systematic condition sensitivity, but the directional pattern does not reproduce human realization-effect predictions. Gemma's residual stream contains a linearly decodable realization-status signal at layer 18 that generalizes to held-out prompts. Steering along this direction does not, however, reliably shift downstream risk choices, a null result that holds across positive scales and in a negative sign-symmetry run. Behavioral sensitivity, latent readout, and causal control are three distinct properties that do not automatically co-occur, and successful latent readout is insufficient evidence that a model behaviorally relies on a representation during downstream decision-making.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在行为模拟中的认知机制真实性，通过行为经济学中的"实现效应"（realization effect）实验，发现LLM的提示敏感性、内部表征线性解码和因果控制三个层面的表现并不一致：模型虽能解码"实现状态"信号，但因果干预无法改变风险决策行为。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM的行为输出是否反映人类认知机制，还是仅对提示敏感的浅层模式，需要区分行为敏感性、内部表征可读性与因果控制三种性质是否自动共存。
AI.method: 在行为经济学"实现效应"框架下，从三个层次评估LLM：1) 纯提示的行为敏感性测试；2) 对残差流内部表征的线性探针（linear readout）；3) 通过激活引导（activation steering）进行因果控制。
AI.result: 1) 纯提示条件下表现出系统性条件敏感性，但方向模式与人类实现效应预测不一致；2) Gemma模型第18层残差流中存在可线性解码的"实现状态"信号，且泛化到未见过提示；3) 沿该方向进行激活引导无法可靠改变下游风险选择，该零结果在正向尺度和负向对称实验中均稳定。
AI.conclusion: 行为敏感性、潜在表征可读性和因果控制是三种不同属性，不会自动共存。成功解码内部表征并不足以证明模型在行为上依赖该表征进行决策。
idea_en: A method for evaluating whether large language models exhibit human-like cognitive mechanisms by testing at three distinct levels: prompt-only behavioral sensitivity, linear readout of internal representations, and causal control via activation steering, with the finding that successful latent readout is insufficient evidence for behavioral reliance.

A technique for linearly decoding a 'realization-status' signal from the residual stream of a large language model (specifically Gemma at layer 18) that generalizes to held-out prompts, enabling detection of latent cognitive-like states.

A causal control framework using activation steering along a decoded representation direction to test whether an internal signal causally influences downstream decision-making, yielding a null result that distinguishes latent representation from behavioral reliance.

A method for systematically comparing prompt-only behavioral patterns against human behavioral economics predictions (realization effect) to identify discrepancies between surface-level sensitivity and genuine cognitive mechanism replication.
idea_ch: 一种三级评估方法，通过纯提示行为敏感性、内部表征线性解码和激活引导因果控制三个层次，检验大语言模型是否展现人类认知机制，发现成功解码内部表征不足以证明行为依赖。
一种从大语言模型残差流中线性解码'实现状态'信号的技术（Gemma模型第18层），该信号可泛化到未见提示，实现对潜在类认知状态的检测。
一种利用激活引导沿解码表征方向进行因果控制的框架，测试内部信号是否因果影响下游决策行为，该零结果区分了潜在表征与行为真实依赖。
一种系统比较纯提示行为模式与人类行为经济学预测（实现效应）的方法，用于识别表面敏感性与真正认知机制复制之间的差异。

title: SimuWoB: Simulating Real-World Mobile Apps for Fast and Faithful GUI Agent Benchmarking
summary: Mobile GUI agents powered by large language models have progressed rapidly, creating urgent needs for realistic and comprehensive evaluation. Existing benchmarks prioritize reproducibility but are often limited to open-source apps or file-operation tasks for the difficulty of constructing rewards on real applications, leaving a gap between benchmark settings and real-world usage. Moreover, most benchmarks focus on basic grounding and navigation, with limited coverage of complex, long-horizon interactions. To address these limitations, we introduce SimuWoB, a fully synthetic benchmark for mobile GUI agents with 120 challenging tasks spanning diverse types and difficulty levels. We build a robust virtual environment generation framework that synthesizes high-fidelity tasks and environments, and automatically provides valid rewards for each task. Each environment is deployed as a backend-free webpage accessible via URL, enabling efficient and reproducible evaluation. We conduct comprehensive experiments on several state-of-the-art mobile GUI agents. The average success rate is only 27.92%, dropping to 17.82% on long-horizon tasks, which reveals substantial weaknesses in current agents under complex scenarios. Evaluation result comparison with real-world sample tasks demonstrate that agent assessments based on our synthetic environment generalize well. We further provide diagnostic insights across key capability dimensions and discuss implications for future mobile GUI agent development.

AI.tldr: SimuWoB是一个完全合成的移动GUI代理基准测试平台，包含120个挑战性任务，通过合成环境生成框架提供可重复、高保真的评估，实验显示当前最先进代理的平均成功率仅27.92%，长程任务成功率更低至17.82%。
AI.motivation: 现有移动GUI代理基准测试存在两大局限：一是大多局限于开源应用或文件操作任务，难以在真实应用上构建奖励机制，导致基准测试与实际使用存在差距；二是多数基准测试聚焦基础定位和导航，对复杂、长程交互的覆盖有限。
AI.method: 构建了一个稳健的虚拟环境生成框架，能够合成高保真任务和环境，并为每个任务自动提供有效奖励。每个环境部署为可通过URL访问的无后端网页，实现高效且可重复的评估。
AI.result: 对多个最先进移动GUI代理进行了全面实验，平均成功率仅27.92%，长程任务成功率降至17.82%。与真实世界样本任务的评估结果对比表明，基于合成环境的代理评估具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 当前移动GUI代理在复杂场景下存在显著弱点，SimuWoB提供了诊断性洞察和能力维度分析，为未来移动GUI代理开发提供了重要启示。
idea_en: A fully synthetic virtual environment generation framework that automatically creates high-fidelity mobile GUI tasks with built-in reward mechanisms, eliminating the dependency on real-world applications for benchmarking.

A backend-free webpage deployment method for synthetic mobile GUI environments, where each environment is accessible via URL, enabling efficient and reproducible evaluation without complex infrastructure.
A synthetic benchmark system that automatically generates valid rewards for each task in the generated environment, solving the reward construction difficulty on real applications.
A multi-dimensional diagnostic evaluation framework for mobile GUI agents that assesses capabilities across different complexity levels, particularly long-horizon task performance.
idea_ch: 一种全合成虚拟环境生成框架，可自动创建高保真移动GUI任务并内置奖励机制，消除了基准测试对真实世界应用的依赖
一种无后端的网页部署方法，每个合成移动GUI环境可通过URL访问，实现无需复杂基础设施的高效可重复评估
一种自动为合成环境中的每个任务生成有效奖励的基准测试系统，解决了真实应用上奖励构建困难的问题
一种针对移动GUI代理的多维度诊断评估框架，可评估不同复杂度级别（特别是长程任务）的能力表现

title: SpecAlign: A Semantic Alignment Framework for SystemVerilog Assertion Generation
summary: Existing Large Language Model (LLM) approaches to SystemVerilog Assertion (SVA) generation primarily focus on syntactic validity and formal verification outcomes, while semantic alignment between generated assertions and natural language specifications remains difficult to quantify. As a result, hallucinated or misaligned SVAs can reduce confidence and increase debugging efforts in the absence of golden RTL. This paper presents SpecAlign, a framework for semantic evaluation and refinement of LLM-generated SVAs. SpecAlign introduces two iterative alignment loops that assess both natural language properties and SVAs against the design specification using entailment-based classification. We improve alignment decisions by generating multiple reasoning paths using chain-of-thought prompting and aggregating them via a self-consistency voting mechanism. Misaligned assertions are analyzed to generate actionable feedback for refinement. We further define a quantitative alignment score to measure semantic consistency across iterations. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecAlign effectively detects semantic inconsistencies and improves assertion alignment without relying on golden RTL, providing a scalable complement to traditional formal verification evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: SpecAlign是一个用于评估和优化LLM生成的SystemVerilog断言语义对齐的框架，通过两阶段迭代对齐循环和自一致性投票机制，在不依赖黄金RTL的情况下提升断言与自然语言规范的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成SVA的方法主要关注语法有效性和形式验证结果，但生成的断言与自然语言规范之间的语义对齐难以量化，导致幻觉或错位断言降低可信度并增加调试工作。
AI.method: 提出SpecAlign框架，包含两个迭代对齐循环，利用基于蕴含的分类评估自然语言属性和SVA与设计规范的对齐性；通过链式思维提示生成多条推理路径，并采用自一致性投票机制聚合结果；对错位断言进行分析并生成可操作反馈用于优化；定义定量对齐分数来跨迭代衡量语义一致性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明SpecAlign能有效检测语义不一致性，并在不依赖黄金RTL的情况下提升断言对齐质量，可作为传统形式验证评估指标的可扩展补充。
AI.conclusion: SpecAlign为LLM生成的SVA提供了一种无需黄金RTL的语义对齐评估与优化方法，有效解决了语义不一致的量化难题，提高了断言生成的可靠性。
idea_en: A two-stage iterative alignment loop framework for evaluating semantic consistency between LLM-generated SystemVerilog assertions and natural language specifications using entailment-based classification
A self-consistency voting mechanism that aggregates multiple chain-of-thought reasoning paths to improve alignment decisions for generated assertions
A quantitative alignment score metric that measures semantic consistency across iterations for assertion evaluation without golden RTL
A method for generating actionable feedback from misaligned assertions by analyzing semantic discrepancies through entailment classification
idea_ch: 一种基于蕴含分类的两阶段迭代对齐循环框架，用于评估LLM生成的SystemVerilog断言与自然语言规范之间的语义一致性
一种自一致性投票机制，通过聚合多条链式思维推理路径来改善生成断言的语义对齐决策
一种无需黄金RTL的定量对齐分数指标，用于跨迭代衡量断言生成的语义一致性
一种通过蕴含分类分析语义差异，从错位断言中生成可操作反馈用于优化的方法

title: DarkForest: Less Talk, Higher Accuracy for Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems improve reasoning by combining outputs from multiple agents, but interaction-heavy methods can introduce error propagation and high communication overhead. When agents exchange raw responses or reasoning traces, incorrect intermediate reasoning may be adopted and amplified, leading to confident but wrong consensus; multi-round communication also increases token consumption, latency, and inference cost. In this paper, we propose a controlled-communication coordination framework named DarkForest. DarkForest first keeps agents independent, so each agent produces an answer without seeing the others' outputs. It then parses the raw responses into structured candidate records, groups semantically equivalent candidates into clusters, and estimates a calibrated belief distribution over these clusters using agent reliability, confidence, parse quality, support-pattern reliability, and independence corrections. A coordinator receives only policy-permitted evidence from this belief state with controlled communication. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that DarkForest achieves leading overall quality, improves the strongest baseline by up to 30.7\% on benchmark metrics, and reduces token consumption by up to $6.5\times$ compared with communication-heavy baselines.

AI.tldr: DarkForest提出了一种受控通信协调框架，通过让智能体独立推理、将输出解析为结构化记录、聚类语义等价候选、基于多维度估计校准信念分布，再由协调器接收策略允许的证据，在减少通信开销的同时提升推理质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多智能体LLM的推理方法中，智能体之间交互过度（如交换原始响应或推理痕迹），导致错误传播（错误中间推理被采纳并放大）和高通信开销（token消耗大、延迟高、推理成本高），亟需一种既能利用多智能体多样性的优势，又能避免上述问题的有效协调机制。
AI.method: 1) 保持智能体独立，各自产生答案而不见他人输出；2) 将原始响应解析为结构化候选记录；3) 对语义等价的候选进行聚类；4) 利用智能体可靠性、置信度、解析质量、支持模式可靠性、独立性校正等多个维度估计校准的信念分布；5) 协调器仅从信念状态接收策略允许的证据，实现受控通信。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准测试上，DarkForest实现了领先的整体质量，在基准指标上比最强基线提升了最多30.7%，与通信密集型基线相比，token消耗减少了最多6.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 受控通信的多智能体LLM协调框架DarkForest，通过结构化信念估计和策略性通信限制，可在大幅降低通信成本的同时提升推理质量，有效解决了错误传播和通信开销问题。
idea_en: A controlled-communication coordination framework for multi-agent LLM systems that keeps agents independent during initial reasoning, preventing error propagation from raw response or reasoning trace exchange.
A method for parsing raw LLM responses into structured candidate records and performing semantic equivalence clustering to group similar answers.
A calibrated belief distribution estimation model that integrates agent reliability, confidence, parse quality, support-pattern reliability, and independence corrections to assess candidate quality.
A policy-permitted evidence selection mechanism where a coordinator receives only controlled, limited evidence from the belief state rather than full raw agent outputs.
A multi-agent reasoning architecture that simultaneously reduces token consumption (up to 6.5x) and improves reasoning accuracy (up to 30.7%) compared to communication-heavy baselines.
idea_ch: 一种用于多智能体LLM系统的受控通信协调框架，初始推理阶段保持各智能体独立，避免因交换原始响应或推理迹而导致的错误传播
一种将LLM原始响应解析为结构化候选记录并进行语义等价聚类的方法，实现对相似答案的归并处理
一种校准信念分布估计模型，综合智能体可靠性、置信度、解析质量、支持模式可靠性和独立性校正等多维度因素评估候选质量
一种策略允许的证据选择机制，协调器仅从信念状态接收受控的有限证据，而非完整的原始智能体输出
一种同时显著降低token消耗（最高6.5倍）并提升推理准确率（最高30.7%）的多智能体推理架构

title: Boosting Inference with Guided Reasoning: Stochastic Exploration for Recursive Models
comment: Presented at the proceedings of the ICML 2026 Workshop on Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling (SPIGM)}, Seoul, South Korea. 2026
summary: Recent work on recursive architectures has shown that tiny neural networks can be surprisingly powerful on structured reasoning tasks. The trick is to model reasoning trajectories with a latent dynamical system. We argue that the inference-time behaviour of these architectures is best understood as approximate inference over latent reasoning trajectories, with deterministic recursion as the one-particle, zero-noise limit. We make this view operational through guided stochastic exploration: stochastic perturbations of the reasoning dynamics propose neighbouring trajectories, and the model's existing early-stopping head reweights them online. The framework yields three label-free diagnostics: local stability, guide alignment, and cloud-token entropy. These predict, from inference traces alone, whether the procedure will help and which of its outputs to trust. On Sudoku-Extreme it lifts exact-solve accuracy from $85.9\%$ to $98.0\%$ without retraining; on Maze-Hard the diagnostics flag a misaligned guide, as validation performance later confirms. The same machinery thus characterises both when recursive reasoning has room to improve at the trajectory level and when the model's internal guide can recover it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过随机扰动和重加权机制改进递归神经网络的推理过程，在无需重新训练的情况下显著提升结构化推理任务（如数独、迷宫）的性能，并引入三种无标签诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 现有递归架构虽在小网络结构化推理任务上表现惊人，但其推理时行为本质上是确定性递归，缺乏对潜在推理轨迹的随机探索能力，导致在困难实例上性能受限。
AI.method: 通过随机扰动推理动力学来探索邻近轨迹，并利用模型已有的早停头在线重加权这些轨迹，实现引导式随机探索。同时提出三种无标签诊断指标：局部稳定性、引导对齐度和云令牌熵。
AI.result: 在Sudoku-Extreme上，精确求解准确率从85.9%提升至98.0%而无需重新训练；在Maze-Hard上，诊断指标成功识别出引导未对齐问题，与后续验证性能一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架既能表征递归推理在轨迹层面是否有改进空间，也能判断模型内部引导是否能够恢复正确推理。
idea_en: A method for improving recursive neural network inference by applying stochastic perturbations to reasoning trajectories and reweighting them using the model's existing early-stopping head, without requiring retraining.
A set of three label-free diagnostic metrics (local stability, guide alignment, cloud-token entropy) that predict whether stochastic trajectory exploration will improve inference performance.
A guided stochastic exploration framework that treats deterministic recursion as a zero-noise limit of approximate inference over latent reasoning trajectories.
An online trajectory reweighting mechanism that leverages the model's built-in early-stopping head to dynamically weight perturbed reasoning paths.
idea_ch: 一种无需重新训练即可改进递归神经网络推理的方法：通过对推理轨迹施加随机扰动，并利用模型已有的早停头对扰动轨迹进行在线重加权。
三种无标签诊断指标（局部稳定性、引导对齐度、云令牌熵），用于预测随机轨迹探索是否能提升推理性能。
一种引导式随机探索框架，将确定性递归视为潜在推理轨迹上的近似推断的零噪声极限。
一种在线轨迹重加权机制，利用模型内置的早停头动态加权被扰动的推理路径。

title: Meta-Agent: From Task Descriptions to Verified Multi-Agent Systems
summary: AI agents are increasingly used to solve complex, multi-step tasks, but existing multi-agent frameworks remain brittle as workflows grow in scale and depth. Small errors at intermediate stages can propagate through agent interactions, while insufficient grounding and weak verification mechanisms further limit reliability. We present Meta-Agent, a two-phase framework that automatically constructs and executes specialized multi-agent systems from natural-language task descriptions. In the construction phase, a task planner decomposes a problem into a directed acyclic graph of agent specifications with explicit input/output contracts and verification criteria. A web search module grounds each specification with external evidence, and a code generation module produces system prompts and tool configurations. A construction-time verification stage then validates generated artifacts and triggers targeted regeneration when failures are detected. In the execution phase, a coordinator dispatches subtasks across the agent graph while execution-time verification gates intermediate outputs. We further introduce a three-level error attribution mechanism that distinguishes local, upstream, and structural failures, enabling targeted recovery strategies ranging from localized retries to partial re-execution and re-decomposition. We evaluate Meta-Agent across coding, contextual learning, and open-ended reasoning tasks. Experiments against strong multi-agent baselines and ablation studies demonstrate consistent improvements in task success rate, error recovery, and workflow stability. The results highlight the importance of tightly integrating planning, grounding, and verification for building reliable multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了Meta-Agent两阶段框架，自动构建和执行专门的多智能体系统，通过任务分解、网络搜索增强、代码生成、构建时和执行时验证以及三级错误归因机制，提升多智能体工作流的可靠性和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI多智能体框架在处理复杂多步任务时存在脆弱性：中间阶段的小错误会通过智能体交互传播扩大，缺乏足够的知识支撑和弱的验证机制进一步限制了可靠性。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1）构建阶段——任务规划器将问题分解为有向无环图结构的智能体规范（含输入/输出合约和验证标准），网络搜索模块进行外部证据验证，代码生成模块产生系统提示和工具配置，构建时验证检测失败并触发针对性重新生成；2）执行阶段——协调器分配子任务，执行时验证对中间输出进行门控检查；三级错误归因机制区分局部、上游和结构性失败，实现从局部重试到部分重新执行和重新分解的定向恢复策略。
AI.result: 在编码、上下文学习和开放式推理任务上，与强多智能体基线和消融实验相比，在任务成功率、错误恢复和工作流稳定性方面表现出持续改进。
AI.conclusion: 紧密集成规划、知识增强和验证对于构建可靠的多智能体系统至关重要。
idea_en: A two-phase multi-agent system construction framework that automatically decomposes natural-language task descriptions into a directed acyclic graph of agent specifications with explicit input/output contracts and verification criteria.

A construction-time verification stage that validates generated artifacts (system prompts, tool configurations) and triggers targeted regeneration when failures are detected in multi-agent workflow construction.

A three-level error attribution mechanism that distinguishes local, upstream, and structural failures in multi-agent systems, enabling differentiated recovery strategies including localized retries, partial re-execution, and re-decomposition.
An execution-time verification gating mechanism that validates intermediate outputs during multi-agent coordination, preventing error propagation across the agent graph.
A web search grounding module integrated into multi-agent system construction that grounds each agent specification with external evidence to improve reliability.
A code generation module for automated production of system prompts and tool configurations from agent specifications during multi-agent system construction.
idea_ch: 一种两阶段多智能体系统构建框架，自动将自然语言任务描述分解为具有显式输入/输出合约和验证标准的有向无环图智能体规范结构
一种构建时验证机制，对自动生成的多智能体工件（系统提示、工具配置）进行实时验证，检测失败时触发针对性重新生成
一种三级错误归因机制，区分多智能体系统中的局部故障、上游故障和结构性故障，支持差异化恢复策略（局部重试、部分重新执行、重新分解）
一种执行时验证门控机制，在多智能体协调过程中对中间输出进行验证，防止错误在智能体图中传播
一种集成到多智能体系统构建中的网络搜索知识增强模块，用外部证据为每个智能体规范提供支撑
一种从智能体规范自动生成系统提示和工具配置的代码生成模块

title: FrontierOR: Benchmarking LLMs' Capacity for Efficient Algorithm Design in Large-Scale Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for optimization modeling and solver-code generation, yet practical operations research and optimization problems often require a harder capability: designing scalable algorithms that exploit problem structure and outperform direct formulation-and-solve baselines. Existing benchmarks are limited to small or simplified examples far below real-world scale and complexity. We introduce FrontierOR, among the first benchmarks to systematically evaluate LLM-based efficient algorithm design for realistic large-scale optimization problems. FrontierOR includes 180 tasks derived from methodologically diverse papers published in top-tier operations research venues, each with standardized instances and a hidden, expert-verified evaluation suite. We evaluate seven LLMs spanning frontier, cost-effective, and open-source models both in one-shot and test-time evolution settings. The results reveal that frontier models still struggle to move from executable formulations to efficient optimization algorithms: the strongest one-shot model outperforms Gurobi in only 31% of cases in both solution quality and computational efficiency, and even strong coding agents with test-time evolution achieve only 50% on selected hard tasks. FrontierOR establishes a practical evaluation platform for LLM-based optimization algorithm design, which enables future LLMs and agents to be systematically tested on whether they can move beyond correct formulation toward a feasible, high-quality, and efficient algorithm. Our FrontierOR Benchmark is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/efficient-opt-bench-F03D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FrontierOR基准，用于系统评估大语言模型在现实大规模优化问题中设计高效算法的能力，测试表明前沿模型仍难以从可执行公式化转向高效优化算法。
AI.motivation: 现有基准局限于小规模或简化示例，远低于真实世界的规模和复杂度，缺乏对LLM设计可扩展优化算法能力的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建了包含180个任务的FrontierOR基准，任务源自运筹学顶级期刊论文，配备标准化实例和隐藏的专家验证评估套件，在一次性生成和测试时进化两种设置下评估7种LLM。
AI.result: 最强一次性模型在求解质量和计算效率上仅31%的情况优于Gurobi；即使是带测试时进化的强编码agent，在精选困难任务上也仅达到50%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: FrontierOR为基于LLM的优化算法设计建立了实用的评估平台，前沿模型目前仍难以从正确的公式化转向可行、高质量且高效的算法。
idea_en: LLM-based automatic discovery of problem-specific decomposition structures for large-scale optimization problems
Test-time evolutionary framework that iteratively refines LLM-generated optimization algorithms using expert-verified hidden evaluation suites
Hybrid approach combining LLM formulation generation with learned algorithm scaffolding heuristics for scalable optimization
idea_ch: 基于LLM自动发现大规模优化问题的特定问题分解结构的方法
利用专家验证隐藏评估套件迭代优化LLM生成优化算法的测试时进化框架
结合LLM公式生成与学习算法启发式支架的混合可扩展优化方法

title: LipoAgent: Coordinating Fine-Tuned LLM Agents for Safer Lipid Design
summary: Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) are among the most clinically mature platforms for nucleic acid delivery, yet designing lipids that are both effective and biologically safe remains a major bottleneck. In practical screening, toxicity is a decision-level constraint: if a lipid is toxic, its efficiency prediction is clinically irrelevant. We propose LipoAgent, a safety-aware multi-agent LLM framework for lipid discovery. LipoAgent combines domain-specific finetuning with a conditional prediction objective that enforces toxicity as a prerequisite for efficiency prediction, and further improves reliability via multi-agent verification with lightweight human oversight when disagreement persists. Across multiple foundation models, LipoAgent achieves an average 32% relative improvement in mRNA transfection efficiency prediction compared with other reported models for lipid design. Wet-lab validation confirms that virtual screening rankings reliably translate to biological transfection outcomes. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/SAI-Lab-NYU/LipoAgent.git.

AI.tldr: LipoAgent是一个安全感知的多智能体LLM框架，用于脂质发现。它通过条件预测将毒性作为效率预测的前提，并结合多智能体验证，在mRNA转染效率预测上平均提升32%，湿实验验证了虚拟筛选排名与生物学结果的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 脂质纳米颗粒（LNPs）是核酸递送中最成熟的临床平台之一，但设计既有效又生物安全的脂质仍是一个重大瓶颈。在实际筛选中，毒性是决策级约束：如果脂质有毒，其效率预测在临床上毫无意义。现有方法未能有效将毒性作为效率预测的先决条件。
AI.method: 提出LipoAgent框架，结合领域特定微调与条件预测目标（将毒性作为效率预测的前提），并通过多智能体验证（在存在分歧时加入轻量级人工监督）提高可靠性。在多个基础模型上进行评估。
AI.result: 在多个基础模型上，LipoAgent在mRNA转染效率预测方面相比其他脂质设计模型平均提升32%。湿实验验证确认虚拟筛选排名可靠地转化为生物转染结果。
AI.conclusion: LipoAgent通过安全感知的条件预测和多智能体验证，实现了更可靠、更安全的脂质发现，虚拟筛选结果与生物学实验结果高度一致，代码已开源。
idea_en: A safety-aware multi-agent LLM framework for lipid discovery that uses conditional prediction where toxicity assessment is enforced as a prerequisite for efficiency prediction, ensuring only non-toxic lipids are evaluated for transfection performance.
A multi-agent verification mechanism for lipid screening that incorporates lightweight human oversight only when disagreements persist among LLM agents, balancing automation with reliability.
Domain-specific fine-tuning of large language models for lipid design with a cascaded prediction pipeline that first filters by toxicity threshold before predicting mRNA transfection efficiency.
idea_ch: 一种安全感知的多智能体LLM脂质发现框架，采用条件预测机制，将毒性评估作为效率预测的强制执行前提，确保仅对无毒脂质进行转染性能评估。
一种用于脂质筛选的多智能体验证机制，仅在LLM智能体之间存在持续分歧时引入轻量级人工监督，平衡自动化与可靠性。
面向脂质设计的领域特定大语言模型微调方法，采用级联预测管线，先通过毒性阈值筛选，再预测mRNA转染效率。

title: Whose Alignment? Comparing LLM Process Alignment Across Diverse Organizational Decision Contexts
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Pluralistic Alignment Workshop
summary: Aligning AI systems with organizational decision-making is typically framed as a single-target problem: make the model behave like the organization. We argue this framing obscures a deeper pluralistic challenge. We rely on a decision-policy capturing method to measure process alignment: whether an LLM weights information as the organization does, not merely whether it reaches the same conclusions. Applying this method to ECHR Article 6 decisions, process alignment strongly predicts output accuracy (r = 0.85, p < .001) and externalization substantially improves alignment for poorly-aligned models. Applying it to German consumer credit decisions, this relationship collapses (r = 0.15, p = .60): interventions produce inconsistent effects and the benchmark encodes potentially discriminatory historical patterns. This contrast is itself a pluralistic alignment finding: in contested domains, high process alignment is neither achievable via externalization nor unconditionally desirable. Output agreement alone cannot distinguish a model that has internalized an organizational policy from one that merely approximates its outcomes; process-level measurement is a necessary component of any pluralistic alignment evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种衡量AI系统与组织决策过程对齐的方法（过程对齐），而非仅关注结果对齐。通过对ECHR Article 6和德国消费信贷两个案例的分析，发现过程对齐在高规范领域能准确预测输出准确性，但在存在争议的领域（如信贷）则失效，揭示了多元对齐的必要性。
AI.motivation: 传统的AI对齐被简化为单一目标问题（让模型模仿组织行为），忽视了组织内部存在的多元价值和争议。作者认为需要从过程层面（模型如何加权信息）而非仅结果层面衡量对齐。
AI.method: 使用决策策略捕获方法（decision-policy capturing method）测量过程对齐——即LLM是否像组织一样对信息进行加权，而不仅仅看是否得出相同结论。应用于ECHR第6条判决和德国消费信贷两个场景进行对比分析。
AI.result: 在ECHR场景中，过程对齐与输出准确性高度相关（r=0.85, p<.001）；外部化（externalization）显著改善了低对齐模型。在德国消费信贷场景中，该关系消失（r=0.15, p=0.60），干预效果不一致，且基准数据编码了潜在的歧视性历史模式。
AI.conclusion: 结果一致不能区分模型是内化了组织策略还是仅仅近似了结果。过程层面的测量是多元对齐评估的必要组成部分；在存在争议的领域，高过程对齐既不可通过外部化实现，也并非无条件可取。
idea_en: A decision-policy capturing method for measuring process alignment of LLMs with organizational decision-making, which evaluates how models weight information rather than merely whether they reach the same conclusions.
An externalization technique that improves process alignment for poorly-aligned models by making implicit decision policies explicit.
A pluralistic alignment evaluation framework that distinguishes between output agreement and process-level alignment, applicable across different regulatory and ethical domains.

A method for detecting potentially discriminatory historical patterns embedded in organizational benchmark data by comparing process alignment metrics across contested vs. uncontested decision domains.
idea_ch: 一种用于衡量LLM与组织决策过程对齐的决策策略捕获方法，评估模型如何对信息进行加权而非仅仅看是否得出相同结论。
一种外部化技术，通过将隐式决策策略显式化，显著改善低对齐模型的过程对齐水平。
一种多元对齐评估框架，区分结果一致性与过程级对齐，适用于不同监管和伦理领域。
一种通过比较争议与非争议决策领域的过程对齐指标，检测组织基准数据中潜在歧视性历史模式的方法。

title: AI Cartography: Mapping the Latent Landscape of AI Benchmark Ecosystems
summary: While aggregate leaderboard scores drive AI development, they contain substantial measurement noise whose sources and magnitudes remain unquantified, making it unclear when rankings reflect genuine capability differences versus evaluation artifacts. We introduce a framework for measuring the latent landscape in AI benchmark ecosystems. Applying Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) and Generalizability Theory to 4,000+ models from the Open LLM Leaderboard, we decompose sources of ranking variance and establish: (1) structures assumed in current reporting practice underestimate the strength of relationships between benchmarks; (2) evidence of local dependence among leaderboard items, undermining uses of benchmarks as measurement instruments under current scoring systems; (3) contributor metadata explains more rank-relevant variance ($\approx9\%$) than architecture or deployment categories in this context; (4) a manifest-score "scaling law" slope has low reliability ($R_β=0.53$); by contrast, the latent general-factor size slope is highly stable across ecosystem controls ($R_g=0.97$). We are able to provide unique insights into benchmark dynamics, such as which benchmarks are a function of LLM size and which can be oppositely impacted by post-training practices. We provide actionable diagnostics to determine how benchmark rankings can be trusted and how benchmark design can be improved.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种框架，利用验证性因子分析和概化理论分解AI基准测试中的测量噪声，发现当前排行榜评分结构存在缺陷，并揭示了潜在能力因子比表面分数更稳定可靠。
AI.motivation: 当前的AI模型排行榜虽然驱动着AI发展，但其中包含大量未量化的测量噪声，导致排名可能反映评估伪影而非真实能力差异，亟需系统性的分析框架来区分真实能力与噪声。
AI.method: 运用验证性因子分析（CFA）和概化理论（Generalizability Theory），对Open LLM Leaderboard上4000+模型进行分解，分析排名方差的来源，构建AI基准生态系统的潜在能力景观测量框架。
AI.result: (1)当前报告结构低估了基准间的关联强度；(2)排行榜项目存在局部依赖，削弱了评分系统的测量有效性；(3)贡献者元数据解释的排名方差(~9%)超过架构或部署类别；(4)显式分数"尺度律"斜率信度低(Rβ=0.53)，而潜在通用因子斜率高度稳定(Rg=0.97)。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能提供关于基准动态的独特见解（如哪些基准与模型大小相关、哪些受后训练影响），并提供可操作的诊断方法来判断基准排名的可信度及改进基准设计。
idea_en: Method for decomposing measurement noise in AI benchmark rankings using Confirmatory Factor Analysis and Generalizability Theory to separate genuine capability differences from evaluation artifacts.
System for detecting local dependence among benchmark items to assess validity of leaderboard scoring as a measurement instrument.
Framework using contributor metadata as explanatory variable for ranking variance in AI model evaluations, revealing ~9% variance contribution.
Technique for calculating a stable latent general-factor size slope (Rg=0.97) as a more reliable alternative to manifest-score scaling law slopes.
Diagnostic tool for determining trustworthiness of benchmark rankings and identifying which benchmarks are size-dependent vs. post-training-affected.
idea_ch: 一种利用验证性因子分析和概化理论分解AI基准排名测量噪声的方法，将真实能力差异与评估伪影分离。
一种检测基准项目间局部依赖性的系统，用于评估排行榜评分作为测量工具的有效性。
一种利用贡献者元数据作为AI模型评估排名方差解释变量的框架，可贡献约9%的方差解释度。
一种计算稳定的潜在通用因子斜率（Rg=0.97）的技术，作为显式分数尺度律斜率的更可靠替代方案。
一种用于判断基准排名可信度并识别哪些基准依赖模型大小、哪些受后训练影响的诊断工具。

title: Context-CoT: Enhancing Context Learning via High-Quality Reasoning Synthesis
summary: While LLMs excel at reasoning over prompts using static pretrained knowledge, they struggle significantly with context learning-the ability to dynamically extract, internalize, and apply new knowledge from complex, task-specific contexts. Recent evaluations on the CL-Bench reveal a critical capability gap: frontier models solve only 17.2% of context-dependent tasks on average.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLMs在上下文学习（Context Learning）方面存在严重能力缺陷——前沿模型仅能解决17.2%的上下文依赖任务，并提出这一静态预训练知识与动态上下文知识融合的瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 当前LLMs擅长利用静态预训练知识进行推理，但在动态提取、内化和应用复杂任务特定上下文中的新知识方面表现极差，存在严重的能力鸿沟。
AI.method: 通过CL-Bench评估基准对前沿LLMs进行上下文学习能力测试，量化模型在需要从上下文中动态获取并应用知识的任务上的表现。
AI.result: 前沿模型在上下文依赖任务上的平均解决率仅为17.2%，表明当前LLMs在上下文学习方面存在严重缺陷。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在上下文学习能力上存在关键瓶颈，亟需新的技术方案来增强模型从复杂任务上下文中动态提取和应用新知识的能力。
idea_en: A context-knowledge fusion mechanism that dynamically extracts task-specific knowledge from complex contexts and integrates it into LLM reasoning via a dedicated memory module.
An adaptive context learning architecture that separates static pretrained knowledge from dynamic context knowledge, enabling selective activation based on task requirements.
A context-to-knowledge distillation pipeline that converts unstructured task-specific contexts into structured internal representations for more effective LLM learning.
A dual-path reasoning framework combining static knowledge path (pretrained) and dynamic context path (extracted from current task context) with learnable gating.
idea_ch: 一种上下文知识融合机制，从复杂任务上下文中动态提取特定知识并通过专用记忆模块集成到LLM推理中
一种自适应上下文学习架构，将静态预训练知识与动态上下文知识分离，根据任务需求选择性激活
一种上下文到知识的蒸馏管道，将非结构化任务上下文转换为结构化内部表示以增强LLM学习效果
一种双路径推理框架，结合静态知识路径（预训练）和动态上下文路径（从当前任务上下文提取）并配备可学习门控机制

title: Second Guess: Detecting Uncertainty Through Abstention and Answer Stability in Small Language Models
summary: Large language models often generate confident but incorrect answers rather than abstaining when uncertain. This problem is particularly acute for small language models (SLMs), where computational constraints and autonomous operation amplify the need for reliable uncertainty detection. We propose _Second Guess_, a lightweight, parameter-free prompting technique for abstention in multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) that is well-suited for SLMs. Our key empirical insight is that models which truly know an answer will select it consistently, while uncertain models exhibit unstable behavior when an ``I don't know'' option is added. Evaluated on four open models (2B-8B parameters) and four benchmarks, Second Guess achieves the highest composite risk improvement of 10.81\%. Notably, it maintains an 8\% composite risk improvement on fine-tuned models where entropy-based methods degrade, and improves most for lower-performing models. All code and results required to reproduce this work is available in https://github.com/Mystic-Slice/second-guess

AI.tldr: 提出Second Guess轻量级提示技术，通过添加"我不知道"选项并观察模型答案一致性来判断不确定性，适用于小语言模型的多选题问答任务。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常生成自信但错误的答案而非在不确定时弃权，小语言模型受计算资源限制，更需要可靠的不确定性检测机制。
AI.method: Second Guess是一种无参数提示技术：在多选题问答中增加"我不知道"选项，通过观察模型是否一致选择相同答案来判断其真实确定性——真正知道答案的模型会稳定选择，不确定的模型行为不稳定。
AI.result: 在4个开源模型(2B-8B参数)和4个基准测试上，Second Guess实现了10.81%的复合风险改进；在微调模型上保持8%改进（熵方法在此场景下降级）；对低性能模型改进最为显著。
AI.conclusion: Second Guess是一种轻量级、参数无关的有效弃权策略，特别适合小语言模型，在计算受限场景下优于传统熵基不确定性检测方法。
idea_en: A parameter-free prompting technique for abstention in multiple-choice question answering that adds an 'I don\'t know' option and detects model uncertainty by observing answer selection inconsistency across multiple queries.
A method for small language models to autonomously detect knowledge boundaries without additional training or parameter tuning, using response stability as a proxy for confidence.
A composite risk improvement metric tailored for evaluating abstention strategies in resource-constrained language models.
idea_ch: 一种用于多选题问答的免参数提示弃权技术，通过添加'我不知道'选项并观察多次查询中答案选择的不一致性来检测模型不确定性。
一种让小型语言模型无需额外训练或参数调优即可自主检测知识边界的方法，利用回答稳定性作为置信度的代理指标。
一种专为资源受限语言模型中弃权策略评估设计的复合风险改进度量方法。

title: Towards end-to-end LLM-based censoring-aware survival analysis
summary:
Objective: Survival analysis is central to medical prediction, yet large language models (LLMs) are rarely used as end-to-end survival models because censoring prevents straightforward supervised fine-tuning. Here we present LLMSurvival, a framework that enables censoring-aware survival analysis with unmodified LLMs operating directly on tabular clinical data.
  Materials and Methods: LLMSurvival reformulates time-to-event prediction as pairwise ranking among comparable subjects, and derives test-time risk by aggregating comparisons against anchor individuals from the training cohort.
  Results: Across two clinical tasks (ICU mortality prediction in MIMIC-IV and fragility fracture prediction in a NewYork-Presbyterian/Weill Cornell Medicine cohort), LLMSurvival improves overall concordance over Cox proportional hazards modeling by 3.1% for ICU mortality and 0.5% for fracture risk, 2.1% on average for ICU mortality and 2.8% for fracture risk over three established deep learning survival models.
  Discussion: The results show that survival modeling with censoring can be made compatible with LLM fine-tuning through comparison-based reformulation. The framework demonstrates high portability and superior performance over expert curated scores like SAPS-II and FRAX scores across diverse clinical context. Furthermore, the framework supports local deployment, as compact, publicly available base models provide sufficient performance.
  Conclusion: The LLMSurvival framework serves as a proof of concept for an integrated, censoring-conscious approach to survival analysis via LLMs.

AI.tldr: LLMSurvival是一个将生存分析转化为成对排序任务、使未修改的大语言模型能够直接处理表格临床数据并考虑删失的框架，在ICU死亡率和骨折风险预测任务上优于Cox比例风险模型和多种深度学习生存模型。
AI.motivation: 生存分析是医学预测的核心，但因删失（censoring）问题导致大语言模型难以直接进行端到端监督微调，现有方法无法充分利用LLM的能力处理表格化临床数据进行生存分析。
AI.method: 将时间-事件预测重新表述为可比较患者之间的成对排序问题，在测试阶段通过聚合与训练队列中锚定个体的比较结果来推导风险评分，使LLM能够以删失感知的方式进行生存分析。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV ICU死亡预测和纽约长老会/威尔康奈尔医学中心骨折风险预测两个临床任务上，LLMSurvival相比Cox比例风险模型在一致性上分别提升3.1%和0.5%，相比三种深度学习生存模型平均提升2.1%和2.8%，且优于SAPS-II和FRAX等专家评分。
AI.conclusion: 通过比较重写框架，删失感知的生存建模可与LLM微调兼容，该框架具有高可移植性，支持本地部署，紧凑型公开基础模型即可提供足够性能，为基于LLM的集成删失感知生存分析提供了概念验证。
idea_en: A method for censoring-aware survival analysis using unmodified large language models by reformulating time-to-event prediction as pairwise ranking among comparable subjects.
A test-time risk aggregation technique that derives survival risk scores by comparing a test subject against multiple anchor individuals from the training cohort.
Integration of LLM fine-tuning with pairwise comparison-based survival modeling to enable end-to-end survival analysis on tabular clinical data.
A framework for local deployment of compact, publicly available LLMs as survival analysis models, achieving superior performance over expert-curated clinical scores.
idea_ch: 一种通过将时间-事件预测重新表述为可比较对象间成对排序任务，使未修改的大语言模型能够进行删失感知生存分析的方法。
一种测试阶段风险聚合技术，通过将测试对象与训练队列中多个锚定个体进行比较来推导生存风险评分。
将LLM微调与基于成对比较的生存建模相结合的框架，实现端到端地在表格化临床数据上进行生存分析。
一种支持本地部署紧凑型公开LLM作为生存分析模型的技术框架，性能优于专家临床评分系统。

title: CODESKILL: Learning Self-Evolving Skills for Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents produce rich trajectories while solving software-engineering tasks. To enable agent self-evolution, these trajectories can be distilled into reusable procedural skills that compactly encode experience to guide future behavior. However, existing skill construction and maintenance methods often rely on fixed prompts and heuristic update rules, leaving it unclear how knowledge should be selected, abstracted, and maintained to best serve downstream agents. We propose CODESKILL, an LLM-based framework that reformulates skill extraction and skill-bank maintenance as a learnable management policy. CODESKILL extracts multi-granularity procedural skills from coding-agent trajectories, evolves skills with new experience, and maintains a compact skill bank for future task solving. We train CODESKILL with reinforcement learning, using a hybrid reward that combines dense rubric-based skill-quality feedback with sparse verifiable execution feedback from the frozen downstream agent. Experiments on EnvBench, SWE-Bench Verified, and Terminal-Bench 2 show that CODESKILL improves average pass rate by 9.69 over the no-skill baseline and by 4.01 over the strongest prompt-based or memory baseline, while maintaining the skill bank at a stable size during iterative construction.

AI.tldr: 提出CODESKILL框架，用强化学习从编码智能体轨迹中提取可复用过程技能，并动态维护技能库，显著提升下游任务解决效果。
AI.motivation: 现有技能构建方法依赖固定提示和启发式更新规则，缺乏对知识如何选择、抽象和维护以最佳服务下游智能体的明确机制。
AI.method: 基于LLM的CODESKILL框架，将技能提取和技能库维护转化为可学习的管理策略。从编码智能体轨迹中提取多粒度过程技能，用新经验进化技能，并通过强化学习训练，结合基于评分标准的密集技能质量反馈和冻结下游智能体的稀疏可验证执行反馈。
AI.result: 在EnvBench、SWE-Bench Verified和Terminal-Bench 2上，CODESKILL相比无技能基线平均提升9.69%通过率，相比最强的基于提示或记忆基线提升4.01%，同时技能库在迭代构建中保持稳定规模。
AI.conclusion: 将技能提取和维护建模为可学习策略，结合强化学习优化，是提升编码智能体自我进化能力的有效方法。
idea_en: A reinforcement learning-based framework (CODESKILL) for extracting multi-granularity procedural skills from coding-agent trajectories, where skill extraction and skill-bank maintenance are formulated as a learnable management policy.
A hybrid reward mechanism for training skill management policy that combines dense rubric-based skill-quality feedback with sparse verifiable execution feedback from the frozen downstream agent.
An iterative skill bank maintenance method that evolves skills with new experience while keeping the skill bank at a stable size during construction.
A learnable multi-granularity procedural skill extraction method from coding-agent trajectories that goes beyond fixed prompts and heuristic update rules.
idea_ch: 一种基于强化学习的CODESKILL框架，将技能提取和技能库维护建模为可学习的管理策略，从编码智能体轨迹中提取多粒度过程技能。
一种混合奖励机制，结合基于评分标准的密集技能质量反馈与来自冻结下游智能体的稀疏可验证执行反馈，用于训练技能管理策略。
一种迭代式技能库维护方法，能够在用新经验进化技能的同时，保持技能库在构建过程中规模稳定。
一种超越固定提示和启发式更新规则的可学习多粒度过程技能提取方法，从编码智能体轨迹中提取可复用知识。

title: Security of OpenClaw Agents: Fundamentals, Attacks, and Countermeasures
summary: The rapid evolution of large language model (LLM)-driven autonomous agents has given rise to OpenClaw, a new class of open-source agent frameworks that operate as continuously running, skill-augmented systems with persistent memory, multi-channel interaction, and high degrees of autonomy. Such capabilities enable OpenClaw agents to autonomously execute complex, multi-step tasks and interact seamlessly with external applications, but simultaneously introduce a substantially enlarged attack surface. In particular, the combination of high-privilege operations and persistent memory exposes OpenClaw agents to various emerging threats, including skill poisoning, cognitive manipulation, multi-agent cascading failures, and supply-chain vulnerabilities. In this survey, we present a comprehensive study of the security landscape of OpenClaw agents. We first examine the general architecture and key characteristics that distinguish OpenClaw agents from traditional AI agent systems. We categorize existing security and privacy threats into a layered framework and analyze how vulnerabilities arise during agent reasoning, action execution, and external interaction. Representative defense mechanisms are also reviewed to draw the current defense landscape. Finally, several unresolved issues related to the reliability and trustworthiness of OpenClaw ecosystems are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文对OpenClaw——一类由大语言模型驱动、具备持续运行、技能增强、持久记忆和多通道交互能力的开源智能体框架——的安全态势进行了全面研究，分析了其因高权限操作和持久记忆而暴露的扩大的攻击面，包括技能投毒、认知操纵、多智能体级联故障和供应链漏洞等新兴威胁。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM驱动的自主智能体快速发展，OpenClaw这类开源智能体框架因其持续运行、技能增强、持久记忆和多通道交互等特性而获得广泛关注，但这些特性也带来了显著扩大的攻击面。现有研究缺乏对这一新兴智能体系统安全态势的系统性梳理和分类。
AI.method: 本文采用综述研究方法，首先分析OpenClaw智能体的通用架构和关键特征，随后将安全与隐私威胁分类为分层框架，分析推理、行动执行和外部交互过程中的漏洞，并评述代表性防御机制。
AI.result: 识别出OpenClaw智能体的核心安全威胁包括技能投毒、认知操纵、多智能体级联故障和供应链漏洞，并构建了分层安全威胁框架和当前防御机制图谱。
AI.conclusion: OpenClaw生态系统在可靠性和可信度方面仍存在若干未解决的问题，需要进一步研究以应对其独特的安全挑战。
idea_en: A method for detecting and mitigating skill poisoning attacks in continuously running LLM-driven autonomous agents by monitoring behavioral anomalies in skill execution sequences
A cognitive manipulation defense system for open-source agent frameworks that employs input sanitization and context validation to prevent adversarial prompt injection
A multi-agent cascading failure isolation mechanism that detects and contains failure propagation across interconnected autonomous agents in real-time
A supply-chain vulnerability scanner specifically designed for open-source agent frameworks that verifies the integrity and provenance of third-party skill modules
A persistent memory integrity verification system for autonomous agents that detects unauthorized modifications to long-term memory stores
A privilege-aware execution sandbox that dynamically restricts high-privilege operations in open-source agent frameworks based on risk assessment of the current task context
idea_ch: 一种通过监测技能执行序列中的行为异常来检测和缓解持续运行的LLM驱动自主智能体技能投毒攻击的方法
一种针对开源智能体框架的认知操纵防御系统，通过输入净化和上下文验证来防止对抗性提示注入
一种多智能体级联故障隔离机制，可实时检测并遏制跨互联自主智能体的故障传播

title: A Signal-Language Foundation Model for Broad-Spectrum Cardiovascular Assessment from Routine Electrocardiography
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) is central to cardiovascular care, but conventional AI models are often restricted to common arrhythmias and may generalize poorly across populations or clinically subtle diseases. We developed ECG Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (ECGCLIP), a signal-language contrastive learning framework that aligns ECG waveforms with expert diagnostic reports. ECGCLIP was pre-trained on 2,837,962 ECG studies from 1,324,856 patients and evaluated on a held-out internal test set plus nine independent external cohorts comprising about 1.5 million ECGs. Evaluation covered 89 downstream tasks, including 45 ECG diagnoses, 39 echocardiographic targets, and 5 rare cardiac diseases, using PRAUC as the primary metric. ECGCLIP consistently improved performance over random initialization and Merl-R18 baselines. On the internal test set, ECGCLIP-R34 achieved strong performance for atrial fibrillation (PRAUC 0.900) and ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (PRAUC 0.383), with robust generalization across all external cohorts. It also improved low-prevalence and diagnostically elusive diseases, including Ebstein anomaly, constrictive pericarditis, dextrocardia, and cardiac amyloidosis, with internal PRAUC values of 0.253, 0.175, 0.121, and 0.201, respectively. ECGCLIP was data efficient, matching or exceeding full-dataset baseline performance with only 10% of training data. Feature visualization and saliency analysis suggested clinically meaningful representations aligned with established electrocardiographic criteria. These findings indicate that large-scale ECG-report contrastive pre-training can expand routine ECG interpretation beyond common arrhythmias toward broad cardiovascular assessment and opportunistic screening of echocardiographic and rare conditions.

AI.tldr: ECGCLIP是一个将心电图波形与专家诊断报告进行对比学习的信号-语言预训练框架，在大规模数据上训练后，不仅能识别常见心律失常，还能检测罕见心脏病和超声心动图异常，且数据效率高。
AI.motivation: 传统AI心电图模型局限于常见心律失常，泛化能力差，难以检测临床罕见或诊断困难的疾病。
AI.method: 提出ECGCLIP，一种信号-语言对比学习框架，将ECG波形与专家诊断报告对齐，在约284万份ECG研究上进行预训练。
AI.result: 在89个下游任务中表现优异，包括45种ECG诊断、39种超声心动图目标和5种罕见心脏病，仅需10%训练数据即可达到或超越全量基线性能。
AI.conclusion: 大规模ECG-报告对比预训练可扩展常规心电图解读能力，从常见心律失常拓展到广泛的心血管评估和罕见疾病的筛查。

Signal-language contrastive pre-training for ECG interpretation that works with only 10% of training data
Cross-modal ECG-report alignment enabling detection of rare cardiac diseases like Ebstein anomaly, constrictive pericarditis, and cardiac amyloidosis
ECG-based opportunistic screening method for echocardiographic abnormalities using contrastive learned representations
Data-efficient ECG diagnostic system that achieves full-dataset performance with fraction of training data through contrastive pre-training

title: ATWL: A Formal Language for Representing, Comparing, and Reusing Visual Analytics Workflows
summary: Visual analytics (VA) workflows are inherently complex, involving data transformation, feature engineering, visual representation, and human interpretation. They are typically described in unstructured prose, hindering systematic comparison, reuse of proven strategies, and training of novices. We present Artifact-Transform Workflow Language (ATWL), a domain-agnostic, declarative language that formally represents VA workflows by capturing their structure and underlying analytical intent. ATWL is built upon a modular ontology of eight artifact types (entities, features, arrangements, visualisations, patterns, models, knowledge, specifications) and transforms characterised by standardised intents (e.g., define-unit, characterise, contextualise, abstract). To show that formalisation effort need not impede adoption, we extract workflows from research papers through supervised interaction with LLM agents, reducing the human role to review and refinement. Using this process, we constructed a library of seventeen ATWL workflows from published VA papers. Cross-workflow analysis reveals structural regularities -- a recurrent meta-structure, recurring motifs, reusable building blocks, diverse iterative strategies, and cross-domain equivalences -- that remain invisible in prose. We further evaluate practical utility through a controlled experiment in which the same LLM addressed two analytical problems with the library supplied either as original papers or as ATWL representations. Both forms enabled useful recommendations, but the formal representation systematically added explicit iteration structure, typed data flow, fragment-level adaptation provenance, and compactness supporting scaling beyond what prose libraries can fit in an LLM's context. ATWL enables a transition from narrative descriptions to formally represented, comparable, and reusable analytical knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ATWL（Artifact-Transform Workflow Language），一种领域无关的声明式语言，用于形式化表示可视化分析工作流的结构和分析意图，并通过LLM代理从论文中半自动提取工作流，实现了跨工作流的结构化比较、模式发现和实用评估。
AI.motivation: 可视化分析工作流通常用非结构化散文描述，难以进行系统比较、复用已有策略和培训新手，缺乏统一的形式化表示方法。
AI.method: 提出ATWL语言，基于八种制品类型（实体、特征、排列、可视化、模式、模型、知识、规范）和标准化意图的变换构建模块化本体；通过监督式LLM代理交互从论文中提取工作流，人类仅负责审查和精炼。
AI.result: 构建了17个ATWL工作流库；跨工作流分析发现了重复出现的元结构、主题、可复用构建块、多样化迭代策略和跨领域等价性；控制实验表明ATWL表示比原文在迭代结构、类型化数据流、片段级适应溯源和上下文紧凑性方面更优。
AI.conclusion: ATWL使可视化分析知识从叙事描述转变为形式化、可比较、可复用的表示，有助于工作流的系统分析、复用和规模化应用。
idea_en: A domain-agnostic declarative language (ATWL) for formally representing visual analytics workflows using modular ontology of artifact types and standardized transform intents
A supervised LLM agent interaction method for semi-automatically extracting formal workflow representations from unstructured research paper prose
A meta-structure and recurring motif discovery system for cross-workflow analysis of visual analytics pipelines
A compact formal representation that enables explicit iteration structure and typed data flow for visual analytics workflows, supporting scaling beyond LLM context limits
idea_ch: 一种基于模块化制品类型本体和标准化变换意图的领域无关声明式语言（ATWL），用于形式化表示可视化分析工作流
一种监督式LLM代理交互方法，可从非结构化的研究论文散文中半自动提取形式化工作流表示
